text: The ESA sample(s) shall be clearly and indelibly marked with the manufacturer's trade name or mark and the type designation.
quote: The sample(s) shall be clearly and indelibly marked with the manufacturer's trade name or mark and the type designation.
test_case: Inspect each ESA sample (lamps, parking sensors, radar if supplied) for a legible, indelible trade name/mark and type designation; pass if both are present.

text: ESA which are brought to the market as replacement parts do not need a type approval only if they are obviously marked as a replacement part by an identification number and if they are identical and from the same manufacturer as the corresponding original equipment.
quote: ESA which are brought to the market as replacement parts do not need a type approval if they are obviously marked as a replacement part
condition: Applies if the ESAs of the bumper are placed on the market as replacement parts without their own type approval.
test_case: Check replacement ESA for a replacement-part identification number and compare with original equipment for identity and same manufacturer; pass if all conditions met.

text: In case an ESA is (part of) a light source, the applicant shall specify the approval number according to Regulation No. 37, Regulation No. 99 or Regulation No. 128 granted to this ESA, or provide a test report by a designated Technical Service stating that this ESA is not mechanically interchangeable with any light source according to Regulation No. 37, Regulation No. 99 or Regulation No. 128.
quote: In case of an ESA is (part of) a light source, the applicant shall: (a) Specify the approval number according to Regulation No. 37
condition: Applies if the LED light sources/modules of the fog lamps or direction indicators are submitted as an ESA that is (part of) a light source.
test_case: Check documentation for an R37/R99/R128 approval number or a Technical Service report on non-interchangeability; pass if one is present.

text: For components sold as aftermarket equipment intended for installation in motor vehicles and not related to immunity related functions, a declaration shall be issued by the manufacturer that the ESA fulfils the requirements of this Regulation and in particular the limits defined in paragraphs 6.5., 6.6., 6.7., 6.8. and 6.9.
quote: In this case a declaration shall be issued by the manufacturer that the ESA fulfils the requirements of this Regulation
condition: Applies only if the assembly or its ESAs are sold as aftermarket equipment not related to immunity related functions.
test_case: Verify a manufacturer declaration exists stating compliance with paragraphs 6.5 to 6.9 limits; pass if present and supported by test evidence.

text: ESAs which are intentional RF transmitters, which have not received type approval in conjunction with a vehicle manufacturer, shall be supplied with suitable installation guidelines.
quote: ESAs, which are intentional RF transmitters, which have not received type approval in conjunction with a vehicle manufacturer, shall be supplied with suitable installation guidelines.
condition: Applies if the front radar sensor (intentional RF transmitter) is part of the delivered assembly and not approved in conjunction with a vehicle manufacturer.
test_case: Verify that installation guidelines are supplied with the radar ESA; pass if guidelines covering installation are provided.

text: The representative ESA system(s) shall fulfil the requirements of paragraph 6. and, if applicable, paragraph 7. of this Regulation for type approval to be granted.
quote: If the representative ESA system(s) fulfil(s) the requirements of paragraph 6. and, if applicable, paragraph 7. of this Regulation, type approval shall be granted.
test_case: Review ESA test reports against paragraph 6 (and 7 if applicable) requirements; pass if all are met.

text: In case an ESA is (part of) a light source and the documentation as specified in paragraph 3.2.10. is missing, approval of this ESA according to Regulation No. 10 shall not be granted.
quote: In case of an ESA is (part of) a light source and if the documentation as specified in paragraph 3.2.10. above is missing
condition: Applies if an LED light source/module ESA is (part of) a light source.
test_case: Confirm that the paragraph 3.2.10 documentation is available for light-source ESAs before approval; pass if present.

text: The electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) conforming to a type approved under this Regulation shall have an approval mark described in paragraph 5.3. affixed to it, except that no marking is required for electrical/electronic systems built into vehicles which are approved as units.
quote: An approval mark described in paragraph 5.3. below shall be affixed to every ESA conforming to a type approved under this Regulation.
test_case: Inspect each approved ESA for an affixed approval mark per paragraph 5.3; pass if present (or ESA is part of a vehicle approved as a unit).

text: The international approval mark shall comprise a circle containing the letter "E", followed by the distinguishing number of the country granting the approval.
quote: A circle containing the letter "E", followed by the distinguishing number of the country granting the approval.
test_case: Inspect the approval mark for a circle enclosing 'E' and the country number; pass if correct.

text: The international approval mark shall comprise the number of this Regulation, followed by the letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the circle specified in paragraph 5.3.1.
quote: The number of this Regulation, followed by the letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the circle
test_case: Inspect the approval mark for '10R-' followed by the approval number to the right of the circle; pass if correct.

text: The electrical/electronic system(s) or ESA(s) shall be designed, constructed and fitted in such a way as to enable the vehicle, in normal conditions of use, to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
quote: A vehicle and its electrical/electronic system(s) or ESA(s) shall be designed, constructed and fitted in such a way as to enable the vehicle
test_case: Review design and EMC test results of the bumper ESAs installed in the vehicle; pass if the vehicle complies in normal use.

text: A vehicle fitted with the assembly shall be tested for radiated emissions and for immunity to radiated disturbances.
quote: A vehicle shall be tested for radiated emissions and for immunity to radiated disturbances.
condition: Applies only if the bumper is approved as part of a vehicle installation rather than as a separate ESA.
test_case: Verify vehicle test reports include radiated emissions and radiated immunity; pass if performed and passed.

text: The ESA(s) shall be tested for radiated and conducted emissions, for immunity to radiated and conducted disturbances.
quote: ESA(s) shall be tested for radiated and conducted emissions, for immunity to radiated and conducted disturbances.
test_case: Verify test reports cover radiated and conducted emissions and radiated and conducted immunity for each ESA; pass if all four are tested and passed.

text: Before testing, a test plan shall be prepared in conjunction with the manufacturer, which contains at least mode of operation, stimulated function(s), monitored function(s), pass/fail criterion(criteria) and intended emissions.
quote: the Technical Service shall prepare a test plan in conjunction with the manufacturer, which contains at least mode of operation, stimulated function(s)
test_case: Check the ESA test plan contains mode of operation, stimulated and monitored functions, pass/fail criteria and intended emissions; pass if all included.

text: The electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type (LED lamps/control gear, ultrasonic parking sensors, and radar if supplied) shall be measured by the method described in Annex 7.
quote: The electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 7.
test_case: Check the test report confirms broadband radiated emission measurement per Annex 7 for each ESA.

text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the ESA broadband limits shall be 62 to 52 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz.
quote: the limits shall be 62 to 52 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically
test_case: Measure broadband emissions per Annex 7 in 30-75 MHz; pass if below the logarithmically decreasing 62-52 dBµV/m limit.

text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the ESA broadband limits shall be 52 to 63 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 6 to this Regulation.
quote: 52 to 63 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz
test_case: Measure broadband emissions per Annex 7 in 75-400 MHz; pass if below the 52-63 dBµV/m limit of Appendix 6.

text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band the ESA broadband limit remains constant at 63 dB microvolts/m.
quote: In the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band the limit remains constant at 63 dB microvolts/m.
test_case: Measure broadband emissions per Annex 7 in 400-1,000 MHz; pass if below 63 dBµV/m.
merged: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band the ESA narrowband limit remains constant at 53 dB microvolts/m.

text: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured broadband values, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limits.
quote: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured values, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limits.
test_case: Compare all measured broadband values with the 6.5.2.1 limits; pass if all are below.
merged: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured narrowband value, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limits.
On the ESA representative of its type, the measured broadband values, expressed in dBµV/m, shall be below the type approval limits.

text: The narrowband electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 8.
quote: The electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 8.
test_case: Check the test report confirms narrowband radiated emission measurement per Annex 8.
merged: The electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 7.

text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the ESA narrowband limits shall be 52 to 42 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz.
quote: the limits shall be 52 to 42 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically
test_case: Measure narrowband emissions per Annex 8 in 30-75 MHz; pass if below the 52-42 dBµV/m limit.

text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the ESA narrowband limits shall be 42 to 53 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 7.
quote: 42 to 53 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz
test_case: Measure narrowband emissions per Annex 8 in 75-400 MHz; pass if below the 42-53 dBµV/m limit of Appendix 7.

text: The emission of transient conducted disturbances of the ESA representative of its type on 12/24 V supply lines shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 7637-2 as described in Annex 10 for the levels given in Table 1.
quote: The emission of ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 7637-2 as described in Annex 10
test_case: Check the report confirms ISO 7637-2 transient emission testing per Annex 10.

text: The maximum allowed positive pulse amplitude of transient conducted emission of the ESA shall be +75 V for vehicles with 12 V systems and +150 V for vehicles with 24 V systems, as given in Table 1.
quote: Polarity of pulse amplitude Vehicles with 12 V systems Vehicles with 24 V systems Positive +75 V +150 V
test_case: Measure positive transient pulses per ISO 7637-2; pass if amplitude ≤ +75 V (12 V) / +150 V (24 V).
merged: The maximum allowed negative pulse amplitude of transient conducted emission of the ESA shall be -100 V for vehicles with 12 V systems and -450 V for vehicles with 24 V systems, as given in Table 1.

text: The immunity to electromagnetic radiation of the ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) chosen from those described in Annex 9.
quote: The immunity to electromagnetic radiation of the ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) chosen from those described in Annex 9.
test_case: Check the report confirms radiated immunity testing using Annex 9 method(s).

text: The immunity to electromagnetic radiation of the ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) as described in Annex 9 with the test severity in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band given in Table 2a and the minimum test level over the whole 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band given in Table 2b.
quote: Test severity in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band are given in Table 2a. Test severity for the minimum test Level
test_case: Verify the applied test levels against Tables 2a and 2b in the report.

text: For the ALSE method, the ESA shall be tested at 30 V/m in over 90 per cent and a minimum of 25 V/m over the whole of the 80 to 2,000 MHz frequency range, and at 10 V/m in over 90 per cent and a minimum of 8 V/m over the whole of the 2,000 to 6,000 MHz frequency range, as given in Tables 2a and 2b.
quote: Frequency range above 2 GHz Not applicable Not applicable Not applicable 2,000 to 6,000 MHz 2,000 to 6,000 MHz Test level above 2 GHz
condition: ALSE method chosen
test_case: If ALSE is used, verify fields of 30/25 V/m (80-2,000 MHz) and 10/8 V/m (2-6 GHz) with no degradation.

text: For the stripline method, the ESA shall be tested at 60 V/m in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range and at a minimum of 50 V/m over the whole 20 to 400 MHz frequency range, as given in Tables 2a and 2b.
quote: Stripline TEM cell BCI ALSE Reverberation chamber Frequency range below 2 GHz 20 to 400 MHz ... 60 V/m
condition: Stripline method chosen
test_case: If stripline is used, verify field ≥60 V/m over >90% and ≥50 V/m over all of 20-400 MHz with no degradation.

text: For the TEM cell method, the ESA shall be tested at 75 V/m in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 200 MHz frequency range and at a minimum of 62,5 V/m over the whole 20 to 200 MHz frequency range, as given in Tables 2a and 2b.
quote: Stripline TEM cell BCI ALSE Reverberation chamber Frequency range below 2 GHz 20 to 400 MHz 20 to 200 MHz
condition: TEM cell method chosen
test_case: If TEM cell is used, verify field ≥75 V/m over >90% and ≥62.5 V/m over all of 20-200 MHz.

text: For the BCI method, the ESA shall be tested at 60 mA in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range and at a minimum of 50 mA over the whole 20 to 400 MHz frequency range, as given in Tables 2a and 2b.
quote: Test level below 2 GHz 60 V/m 75 V/m 60 mA 30 V/m 21 V/m
condition: BCI method chosen
test_case: If BCI is used, verify current ≥60 mA over >90% and ≥50 mA over all of 20-400 MHz.

text: For the reverberation chamber method, the ESA shall be tested at 21 V/m in over 90 per cent and a minimum of 18 V/m over the whole of the LUF to 2,000 MHz frequency range, and at 7 V/m in over 90 per cent and a minimum of 6 V/m over the whole of the 2,000 to 6,000 MHz frequency range, as given in Tables 2a and 2b.
quote: Test level above 2 GHz Not applicable Not applicable Not applicable 10 V/m 7 V/m
condition: Reverberation chamber method chosen
test_case: If reverberation chamber is used, verify fields of 21/18 V/m (LUF-2,000 MHz) and 7/6 V/m (2-6 GHz).

text: Where an ESA does not include an electronic oscillator with an operating frequency greater than 9 kHz, it shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.6.2. and with Annex 8.
quote: does not include an electronic oscillator with an operating frequency greater than 9 kHz, it shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.3.2. or 6.6.2.
condition: ESA has no electronic oscillator with operating frequency > 9 kHz
test_case: Review circuit documentation; if no oscillator >9 kHz, narrowband test may be waived.

text: While tests are performed in accordance with Annex 9, the ESA representative of its type shall be considered as complying with immunity requirements if there is no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions".
quote: shall be considered as complying with immunity requirements if, during the tests performed in accordance with Annex 9, there shall be no degradation
test_case: Monitor lamp output and sensor functions during Annex 9 testing; pass if no degradation of immunity related functions.

text: The immunity of ESA representative of this type shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 16750-2 for starting profile and ISO 7637-2 for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b, as described in Annex 10, with the test levels given in Tables 3a and 3b.
quote: The immunity of ESA representative of this type shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 16750-2 for starting profile and ISO 7637-2
test_case: Check the report confirms ISO 16750-2 and ISO 7637-2 immunity testing per Annex 10.

text: The starting profile shall be tested according to the functional status classification as defined in ISO 16750-1.
quote: Starting profile shall be tested according to the functional status classification as defined in ISO 16750-1.
test_case: Verify starting-profile results are classified per ISO 16750-1.

text: The Functional Performance Status Classification (FPSC) as in ISO 7637-1 shall be applied for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b.
quote: Functional Performance Status Classification (FPSC) as in ISO 7637-1 shall be applied for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b.
test_case: Verify pulse results are classified using ISO 7637-1 FPSC.

text: For pulse 1, the ESA shall meet immunity test level -75 V (12V system) or -450 V (24V system) for 500 pulses with FPSC III for functions related to immunity and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity as specified in Table 3b.
quote: 1 -75 V -450 V 500 pulses III III
test_case: Apply pulse 1 at specified level for 500 pulses; pass if FPSC III achieved.
merged: For pulse 2a, the ESA shall meet immunity test level +37 V (12V system) or +37 V (24V system) for 500 pulses with FPSC I for functions related to immunity and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity as specified in Table 3b.

For pulse 2b, the ESA shall meet immunity test level +10 V (12V system) or +20 V (24V system) for 10 pulses with FPSC II for functions related to immunity and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity as specified in Table 3b.

For pulse 3b, the ESA shall meet immunity test level +75 V (12V system) or +150 V (24V system) for 1 h with FPSC I for functions related to immunity and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity as specified in Table 3b.

text: For pulse 3a, the ESA shall meet immunity test level -112 V (12V system) or -150 V (24V system) for 1 h with FPSC I for functions related to immunity and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity as specified in Table 3b.
quote: 3a -112 V -150 V 1 h I III
test_case: Apply pulse 3a for 1 h; pass if FPSC I (immunity related) / III achieved.

text: For the 12 V system starting profile (ISO 16750-2, test level II, 10 pulses), an ESA that shall be operational during engine start phases shall reach functional status class B if it performs immunity-related functions and class D if it does not, and any other ESA shall reach class C, as given in Table 3a; the starting profile applies only to ESAs that may be installed in vehicles with an internal combustion engine started by a 12 V / 24 V starter motor.
quote: Starting profile II II 10 pulses (for ESA which shall be operational during engine start phases) C (for other ESA)
condition: Vehicle with ICE started by 12 V starter motor
test_case: Apply starting profile level II, 10 pulses; pass if required functional status class is reached.
merged: For the 24 V system starting profile (ISO 16750-2, test level II, 10 pulses), an ESA that shall be operational during engine start phases shall reach functional status class B if it performs immunity-related functions and class D if it does not, and any other ESA shall reach class C, as given in Table 3a; the starting profile applies only to ESAs that may be installed in vehicles with an internal combustion engine started by a 12 V / 24 V starter motor.

text: ESAs with no immunity related functions need not be tested for immunity to radiated disturbances and shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.8. and with Annex 9 to this Regulation.
quote: ESAs with no immunity related functions need not be tested for immunity to radiated disturbances and shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.8.
condition: ESA has no immunity related functions
test_case: Review function analysis; if no immunity related functions, radiated immunity test may be waived.

text: ESAs that are not switched, contain no switches or do not include inductive load need not be tested for transient conducted emission and shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.7.
quote: ESAs that are not switched, contain no switches or do not include inductive load need not be tested for transient conducted emission
condition: ESA is not switched, contains no switches or has no inductive load
test_case: Review design; if criteria met, transient emission test may be waived.

text: The loss of function of receivers during the immunity test, when the test signal is within the receiver bandwidth (RF exclusion band) as specified in the harmonized international EMC standard, does not necessarily lead to fail criteria.
quote: The loss of function of receivers during the immunity test, when the test signal is within the receiver bandwidth (RF exclusion band)
condition: Radar sensor (receiver) is part of the delivered assembly
test_case: Check exclusion bands are defined per harmonized standard for the radar receiver.

text: RF transmitters shall be tested in the transmit mode.
quote: RF transmitters shall be tested in the transmit mode.
condition: Front radar sensor is part of the delivered assembly
test_case: Verify the radar is operated in transmit mode during EMC testing.

text: Spurious emissions of RF transmitters are subject to this Regulation, while wanted emissions within the necessary bandwidth and out of band emissions are disregarded.
quote: Wanted emissions (e.g. from RF transmitting systems) within the necessary bandwidth and out of band emissions are disregarded
condition: Front radar sensor is part of the delivered assembly
test_case: Check spurious emissions of the radar are below limits, excluding necessary bandwidth and OOB emissions.

text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the ESA broadband limits shall be 62 to 52 dBµV/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz, and 52 to 63 dBµV/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 6, and in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band the limit remains constant at 63 dBµV/m.
quote: the limits shall be 62 to 52 dBµV/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz
condition: Only if an ESA in the bumper assembly is used in the configuration 'REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid'.
test_case: Perform Annex 7 broadband emission measurement from 30 to 1,000 MHz and compare the spectrum against the 62-52 / 52-63 / 63 dBµV/m limit line.

text: In the frequency range 30-75 MHz, the broadband electromagnetic radiation emitted by the electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) shall not exceed the limit E (dBµV/m) = 62 - 25.13 log (F/30), measured with a 120 kHz bandwidth (see paragraphs 6.5.2.1. and 7.10.2.1.).
quote: Limit E (dBµV/m) at frequency F (MHz) for a 120 kHz bandwidth 30-75 MHz 75-400 MHz 400-1,000 MHz E = 62 - 25.13 log (F/30)
test_case: Measure ESA broadband radiated emissions per Annex 7 from 30-75 MHz with 120 kHz bandwidth; pass if all values are at or below 62 - 25.13 log (F/30) dBµV/m.
merged: In the frequency range 400-1,000 MHz, the broadband electromagnetic radiation emitted by the electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) shall not exceed the limit E = 63 dBµV/m, measured with a 120 kHz bandwidth (see paragraphs 6.5.2.1. and 7.10.2.1.).

text: In the frequency range 75-400 MHz, the broadband electromagnetic radiation emitted by the electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) shall not exceed the limit E (dBµV/m) = 52 + 15.13 log (F/75), measured with a 120 kHz bandwidth (see paragraphs 6.5.2.1. and 7.10.2.1.).
test_case: Measure ESA broadband radiated emissions from 75-400 MHz with 120 kHz bandwidth; pass if all values are at or below 52 + 15.13 log (F/75) dBµV/m.

text: In the frequency range 30-75 MHz, the narrowband electromagnetic radiation emitted by the electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) shall not exceed the limit E (dBµV/m) = 52 - 25.13 log (F/30), measured with a 120 kHz bandwidth (see paragraph 6.6.2.1.).
quote: Limit E (dBµV/m) at frequency F (MHz) for a 120 kHz bandwidth 30-75 MHz 75-400 MHz 400-1,000 MHz E = 52 - 25.13 log (F/30)
test_case: Measure ESA narrowband radiated emissions per Annex 8 from 30-75 MHz with 120 kHz bandwidth; pass if all values are at or below 52 - 25.13 log (F/30) dBµV/m.
merged: In the frequency range 75-400 MHz, the narrowband electromagnetic radiation emitted by the electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) shall not exceed the limit E (dBµV/m) = 42 + 15.13 log (F/75), measured with a 120 kHz bandwidth (see paragraph 6.6.2.1.).

In the frequency range 400-1,000 MHz, the narrowband electromagnetic radiation emitted by the electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) shall not exceed the limit E = 53 dBµV/m, measured with a 120 kHz bandwidth (see paragraph 6.6.2.1.).

text: For an ESA powered by LV, a 5 µH / 50 Ω AN as defined in Figure 1 shall be used.
quote: For an ESA powered by LV, a 5 µH / 50 Ω AN as defined in Figure 1 shall be used.
test_case: Review the test setup/report to confirm a 5 µH / 50 Ω AN per Figure 1 was used for the LV-powered ESA.

text: For an ESA powered by LV, the AN(s) shall be mounted directly on the ground plane.
quote: The AN(s) shall be mounted directly on the ground plane.
test_case: Inspect test setup photos/report to confirm the AN(s) are mounted directly on the ground plane.

text: For an ESA powered by LV, the grounding connection of the AN(s) shall be bonded to the ground plane.
quote: The grounding connection of the AN(s) shall be bonded to the ground plane.
test_case: Inspect test setup to confirm the AN grounding connection is bonded to the ground plane.

text: For an ESA powered by LV, measurement ports of AN(s) shall be terminated with a 50 Ω load.
quote: Measurement ports of AN(s) shall be terminated with a 50 Ω load.
test_case: Inspect test setup to confirm AN measurement ports are terminated with 50 Ω loads.

text: The AN impedance ZPB shall be within a tolerance of ± 20 % of the characteristic shown in Figure 2 in the measurement frequency range of 0,1 MHz to 100 MHz, measured between the terminals P and B with a 50 Ω load on the measurement port and with terminals A and B short circuited.
quote: The AN impedance ZPB (tolerance ± 20 %) in the measurement frequency range of 0,1 MHz to 100 MHz is shown in Figure 2.
test_case: Check AN calibration record shows ZPB within ±20 % of Figure 2 from 0,1 MHz to 100 MHz.

text: The approval mark affixed to the ESA (Model A, see paragraph 5.2.) shall have the dimension a of at least 6 mm.
quote: Model A (See paragraph 5.2. of this Regulation) a = 6 mm min The above approval mark affixed to a vehicle or ESA
condition: Applies only if the ESAs in the assembly (lamps, parking sensors, ECU, radar) are approved as ESAs under UN R10 and carry the approval mark.
test_case: Measure the approval mark on the ESA label and check that dimension a is at least 6 mm and the layout matches Model A of Annex 1.

text: When the bumper assembly is tested as installed on the vehicle in the "50 km/h mode" vehicle immunity test with the direction indicator on the driver's side ON, the front direction indicator shall not show a frequency change (lower than 0.75 Hz or greater than 2.25 Hz).
quote: Direction indicator on driver's side ON Frequency change (lower than 0.75 Hz or greater than 2.25 Hz).
condition: Only if the bumper assembly is assessed at vehicle level under Annex 6, not as a separate ESA.
test_case: During the Annex 6 vehicle immunity test in 50 km/h mode, monitor the driver's-side indicator flash frequency; pass if it stays within 0.75 Hz to 2.25 Hz.

text: When the bumper assembly is tested as installed on the vehicle in the "50 km/h mode" vehicle immunity test with the direction indicator on the driver's side ON, the front direction indicator shall not show a duty cycle change (lower than 25 per cent or greater than 75 per cent).
quote: Duty cycle change (lower than 25 per cent or greater than 75 per cent).
condition: Only if the bumper assembly is assessed at vehicle level under Annex 6, not as a separate ESA.
test_case: During the Annex 6 vehicle immunity test in 50 km/h mode, monitor the indicator duty cycle; pass if it stays within 25 % to 75 %.

text: During the vehicle immunity test, all other equipment which can be switched ON by the driver or passengers shall be OFF.
quote: All other equipment which can be switched ON by the driver or passengers shall be OFF.
condition: Bumper ESAs are assessed as installed in the M1 vehicle (vehicle-level immunity test)
test_case: Review the test set-up record and confirm that all driver/passenger switchable equipment not under test was OFF.

text: The vehicle exterior and the passenger compartment shall be monitored to determine whether the requirements of Annex 6 are met (e.g. by using video camera(s), a microphone, etc.).
quote: The vehicle exterior and the passenger compartment shall be monitored to determine whether the requirements of this Annex are met
condition: Bumper ESAs are assessed as installed in the M1 vehicle (vehicle-level immunity test)
test_case: Verify that the exterior (including the front fog lamps and direction indicators) was monitored by camera during exposure and that no failure was observed.

text: Only non-perturbing equipment shall be used while monitoring the vehicle during the immunity test.
quote: Only non-perturbing equipment shall be used while monitoring the vehicle.
condition: Bumper ESAs are assessed as installed in the M1 vehicle (vehicle-level immunity test)
test_case: Check the test report and confirm that the monitoring equipment (cameras, microphones) is declared non-perturbing.

text: For category M vehicles, the reference point at which the field strength shall be established shall be defined according to ISO 11451-2.
quote: For categories M, N, O, T, R and S vehicles according to ISO 11451-2.
condition: Bumper ESAs are assessed as installed in the M1 vehicle (vehicle-level immunity test)
test_case: Check in the test report that the reference point was defined per ISO 11451-2.

text: The vehicle shall be exposed to electromagnetic radiation in the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency ranges in vertical polarization.
quote: The vehicle shall be exposed to electromagnetic radiation in the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency ranges in vertical polarization.
condition: Bumper ESAs are assessed as installed in the M1 vehicle (vehicle-level immunity test)
test_case: Perform the radiated immunity test from 20 to 6,000 MHz with vertical polarization and confirm no degradation of immunity related functions.

text: In the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range, the test signal modulation shall be AM (amplitude modulation), with 1 kHz modulation and 80 per cent modulation depth, if not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and vehicle manufacturer.
quote: AM (amplitude modulation), with 1 kHz modulation and 80 per cent modulation depth in the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range
condition: Bumper ESAs are assessed as installed in the M1 vehicle (vehicle-level immunity test)
test_case: Verify the signal generator settings show AM 1 kHz, 80 % depth over 20-400 MHz.

text: In the 2,700 to 3,100 MHz frequency range, the test signal modulation shall be PM2 (pulse modulation type 2), Ton 3 µs, period 3,333 µs, if not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and vehicle manufacturer.
quote: PM2 (pulse modulation type 2), Ton 3 µs, period 3,333 µs in the 2,700 to 3,100 MHz frequency range
condition: Bumper ESAs are assessed as installed in the M1 vehicle (vehicle-level immunity test)
test_case: Verify the signal generator settings show PM2 Ton 3 µs, period 3,333 µs over 2,700-3,100 MHz.

text: In the 380 to 2,700 MHz and the 3,100 to 6,000 MHz frequency ranges, the test signal modulation shall be PM3 (pulse modulation type 3), Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs, if not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and vehicle manufacturer.
quote: PM3 (pulse modulation type 3), Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs in the 380 to 2,700 MHz and the 3,100 to 6,000 MHz
condition: Bumper ESAs are assessed as installed in the M1 vehicle (vehicle-level immunity test)
test_case: Verify the signal generator settings show PM3 Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs over 380-2,700 MHz and 3,100-6,000 MHz.

text: The substitution method according to ISO 11451-1 shall be used to establish the test field conditions.
quote: The substitution method according to ISO 11451-1, shall be used to establish the test field conditions.
condition: Bumper ESAs are assessed as installed in the M1 vehicle (vehicle-level immunity test)
test_case: Check that the test report documents field calibration by the ISO 11451-1 substitution method.

text: The vehicle shall be positioned with the centre line of the vehicle on the vehicle reference point or line.
quote: The vehicle shall be positioned with the centre line of the vehicle on the vehicle reference point or line.
condition: Bumper ESAs are assessed as installed in the M1 vehicle (vehicle-level immunity test)
test_case: Check the set-up photos showing the vehicle centre line on the reference point/line, facing the antenna (front bumper ESAs illuminated).

text: If not otherwise stated in Annex 7, the test measuring broadband electromagnetic emissions from the ESA shall be performed according to CISPR 25.
quote: If not otherwise stated in this Annex the test shall be performed according CISPR 25.
test_case: Review the broadband radiated emission test report and confirm the test was performed according to CISPR 25.
merged: If not otherwise stated in Annex 8, the test of radiated narrowband electromagnetic emissions from the ESA shall be performed according to CISPR 25.

text: During the radiated broadband emission test, the ESA under test shall be in normal operation mode, preferably in maximum load.
quote: The ESA under test shall be in normal operation mode, preferably in maximum load.
test_case: Check the test report that the LED lamps and parking sensors were operated in normal operation mode, preferably at maximum load, during measurement.
merged: During the radiated narrowband emission tests, the ESA under test shall be in normal operation mode, preferably in maximum load.

text: For an ESA other than one involved in "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid", the radiated broadband emission test shall be performed according to the ALSE method described in Clause 6.4 of CISPR 25.
quote: For ESA other than involved in "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid" the test shall be performed according to the ALSE method
test_case: Verify the test report documents the ALSE method per CISPR 25 Clause 6.4 for the bumper ESAs.

text: In the ambient measurement, the extraneous noise or signal shall be at least 6 dB below the limits of interference given in paragraph 6.5.2.1. of this Regulation, except for intentional narrowband ambient transmissions.
quote: the extraneous noise or signal shall be at least 6 dB below the limits of interference given in paragraph 6.5.2.1. of this Regulation
test_case: Compare the ambient scan with the paragraph 6.5.2.1 limits; pass if ambient is at least 6 dB below the limits (excluding intentional narrowband transmissions).
merged: In the ambient measurement, the extraneous noise or signal shall be at least 6 dB below the limits of interference given in paragraph 6.6.2.1. of this Regulation, except for intentional narrowband ambient transmissions.

text: To ensure that there is no extraneous noise or signal of a magnitude sufficient to affect materially the measurement, ambient measurements shall be taken before or after the main test.
quote: measurements shall be taken before or after the main test.
test_case: Check that the test report contains an ambient measurement taken before or after the main ESA test.
merged: To ensure that there is no extraneous noise or signal of a magnitude sufficient to affect materially the measurement, ambient measurements shall be taken before or after the main narrowband emission test.

text: The radiated broadband emission limits for the ESA apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or open area test site (OATS).
quote: The limits apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE)
test_case: Verify the measured emissions cover 30 to 1,000 MHz and stay below the applicable limits across the whole range.

text: If peak detectors are used for the radiated broadband emission measurement of the ESA, a correction factor of 20 dB as defined in CISPR 12 shall be applied to the quasi-peak limits given in paragraphs 6.5. and 7.10.
quote: If peak detectors are used a correction factor of 20 dB as defined in CISPR 12 shall be applied.
condition: Peak detector used for measurement
test_case: Check the test report that a 20 dB correction factor was applied when peak detection was used.

text: The radiated broadband emission measurements shall be performed with a spectrum analyser or a scanning receiver using the parameters defined in Table 1 and Table 2.
quote: The measurements shall be performed with a spectrum analyser or a scanning receiver. The parameters to be used are defined in Table 1 and Table 2.
test_case: Review instrument settings in the report against Tables 1 and 2.
merged: The narrowband emission measurements shall be performed with a spectrum analyser or a scanning receiver, using the parameters defined in Tables 1 and 2.

text: For a spectrum analyser in the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz, the peak detector shall use an RBW at -3 dB of 100/120 kHz with a minimum scan time of 100 ms/MHz, and the quasi-peak detector shall use an RBW at -6 dB of 120 kHz with a minimum scan time of 20 s/MHz, as given in Table 1.
quote: 30 to 1,000 100/120 kHz 100 ms/MHz 120 kHz 20 s/MHz
condition: Spectrum analyser used for measurement
test_case: Check spectrum analyser RBW and scan time settings in the report against Table 1.

text: If a spectrum analyser is used for peak measurements, the video bandwidth shall be at least three times the resolution bandwidth (RBW).
quote: If a spectrum analyser is used for peak measurements, the video bandwidth shall be at least three times the resolution bandwidth (RBW).
condition: Spectrum analyser used for peak measurements
test_case: Verify VBW ≥ 3 × RBW in the recorded analyser settings.
merged: If a spectrum analyser is used for peak measurements, the video band width shall be at least three times the resolution band width (RBW).

text: FFT-based measuring instruments shall continuously record and evaluate the signal during the measurement time.
quote: FFT-based measuring instruments shall continuously record and evaluate the signal during the measurement time.
condition: FFT-based instrument used for measurement
test_case: Confirm the FFT instrument was operated in continuous recording/evaluation mode.
merged: If FFT-based measuring instruments are used, they shall continuously record and evaluate the signal during the measurement time.

text: If using FFT-based instruments, the minimum measurement time shall be 1 s per analysis frequency band (in real-time mode) of the FFT instrument.
quote: If using FFT-based instruments, the minimum measurement time shall be 1 s per analysis frequency band (in real-time mode)
condition: FFT-based instrument used for measurement
test_case: Verify the recorded measurement time is at least 1 s per FFT analysis band.
merged: If using FFT-based instruments, the minimum measurement time shall be 1 s per analysis frequency band (in real-time mode) of the FFT instrument.

text: For a scanning receiver in the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz, the peak detector shall use a BW at -6 dB of 120 kHz, a maximum step size of 60 kHz and a minimum dwell time of 5 ms, and the quasi-peak detector shall use a BW at -6 dB of 120 kHz, a maximum step size of 60 kHz and a minimum dwell time of 1 s, as given in Table 2.
quote: 30 to 1,000 120 kHz 60 kHz 5 ms 120 kHz 60 kHz 1 s
condition: Scanning receiver used for measurement
test_case: Check receiver bandwidth, step size and dwell time in the report against Table 2.

text: The test of the ESA shall be performed at the intervals specified in the CISPR 12 standard throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz, or alternatively at the 14 frequencies giving the highest emission levels within each of the 14 frequency bands when accredited manufacturer data for the whole band are provided, to confirm that the ESA meets the requirements of Annex 7.
quote: The Technical Service shall perform the test at the intervals specified in the CISPR 12 standard throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz.
test_case: Review the frequency points tested against CISPR 12 intervals or the 14-band method and confirm compliance with limits.

text: Unless otherwise specified, the configuration with the LV harness closer to the antenna shall be tested.
quote: Unless otherwise specified the configuration with the LV harness closer to the antenna shall be tested.
test_case: Check the test setup photos/description that the LV harness was placed closest to the antenna.

text: The phase centre of the antenna shall be in line with the centre of the longitudinal part of the wiring harnesses for frequencies up to 1,000 MHz.
quote: The phase centre of the antenna shall be in line with the centre of the longitudinal part of the wiring harnesses for frequencies up to 1,000 MHz.
test_case: Verify in the setup documentation that the antenna phase centre aligns with the harness centre.

text: In the event that the limit is exceeded during the test, investigations shall be made to ensure that this is due to the ESA and not to background radiation.
quote: In the event that the limit is exceeded during the test, investigations shall be made to ensure that this is due to the ESA
test_case: For any limit exceedance, check the report documents investigation distinguishing ESA emission from background.

text: The maximum of the readings relative to the limit (horizontal/vertical polarization) in each of the 14 frequency bands shall be taken as the characteristic reading at the frequency at which the measurements were made.
quote: The maximum of the readings relative to the limit (horizontal/vertical polarization) in each of the 14 frequency bands shall be taken as the characteristic reading
test_case: Verify the report evaluates the maximum of horizontal/vertical readings per band as the characteristic reading and compares it to the limit.
merged: The maximum of the readings relative to the limit (horizontal/vertical polarisation) in each of the 14 frequency bands shall be taken as the characteristic reading at the frequency at which the measurements were made.

text: The radiated narrowband emission test of the ESA shall be performed according to the ALSE method described in paragraph 6.4. of CISPR 25.
quote: The test shall be performed according to ALSE method described in paragraph 6.4. of CISPR 25.
test_case: Verify that the test setup in the report matches the CISPR 25 paragraph 6.4 ALSE arrangement.

text: If an open area test site (OATS) is used as an alternative to an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE), the OATS shall comply with the requirements of CISPR 16-1-4.
quote: an open area test site (OATS) which complies with the requirements of CISPR 16-1-4 may be used
condition: Only if an OATS is used instead of an ALSE.
test_case: If OATS was used, check the site validation evidence for CISPR 16-1-4 compliance.
merged: If an open area test site (OATS) is used as an alternative to an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE), the OATS shall comply with the requirements of CISPR 16-1-4.

text: The narrowband emission limits shall apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or open area test site (OATS).
quote: The limits apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or open area test site (OATS).
test_case: Verify that the ESA emissions measured from 30 to 1,000 MHz are below the paragraph 6.6.2.1 narrowband limits across the whole range.

text: The narrowband emission measurements of the ESA shall be performed with an average detector.
quote: Measurements shall be performed with an average detector.
test_case: Check the receiver settings in the report and confirm the average detector was used.

text: When a spectrum analyser is used in the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz, the average detector measurement shall use an RBW at -3 dB of 100/120 kHz and a minimum scan time of 100 ms/MHz, as given in Table 1.
quote: Table 1 Spectrum analyser parameters Frequency range MHz Average detector RBW at -3 dB Minimum scan time 30 to 1,000 100/120 kHz 100 ms/MHz
condition: Only if a spectrum analyser is used.
test_case: Verify that the spectrum analyser settings in the report are RBW 100/120 kHz at -3 dB and scan time of at least 100 ms/MHz.

text: When a scanning receiver is used in the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz, the average detector measurement shall use a BW at -6 dB of 120 kHz, a maximum step size of 60 kHz and a minimum dwell time of 5 ms, as given in Table 2.
quote: Table 2 Scanning receiver parameters Frequency range MHz Average detector BW at -6 dB Maximum step size Minimum dwell time 30 to 1,000 120 kHz 60 kHz 5 ms
condition: Only if a scanning receiver is used.
test_case: Verify that the receiver settings are BW 120 kHz at -6 dB, step size of at most 60 kHz and dwell time of at least 5 ms.

text: The narrowband emission test of the ESA shall be performed at the intervals specified in the CISPR 12 standard throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz.
quote: The Technical Service shall perform the test at the intervals specified in the CISPR 12 standard throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz.
test_case: Confirm that the frequency sweep covered 30 to 1,000 MHz at the CISPR 12 intervals, or used the 14-band alternative based on accredited laboratory data.

text: In the event that the narrowband limit is exceeded during the test, investigations shall be made to ensure that this is due to the ESA and not to background radiation including broadband radiation from the ESA.
quote: In the event that the limit is exceeded during the test, investigations shall be made to ensure that this is due to the ESA and not to background radiation
condition: Only if the limit is exceeded during the test.
test_case: For any exceedance, check that the report documents an investigation that distinguishes ESA narrowband emission from background or broadband radiation.

text: The ESAs may comply with the requirements of any combination of the test methods (absorber chamber test according to ISO 11452-2, TEM cell testing according to ISO 11452-3, bulk current injection testing according to ISO 11452-4, stripline testing according to ISO 11452-5, reverberation chamber test according to ISO 11452-11) only provided that these result in the full frequency range specified in paragraph 3.1. of this Annex being covered.
quote: ESAs may comply with the requirements of any combination of the following test methods at the manufacturer's discretion provided that these results in the full frequency range specified in paragraph 3.1.
test_case: Review the test plan and reports to confirm that the chosen combination of ISO 11452 methods covers the full 20 to 6,000 MHz range.

text: For the immunity testing of ESAs to electromagnetic radiation, the frequency range and general test conditions shall be based on ISO 11452-1.
quote: (Frequency range and general test conditions shall be based on ISO 11452-1).
test_case: Check the test report confirms that the frequency range and general test conditions follow ISO 11452-1.

text: The test conditions of the ESA during the immunity tests shall be according to ISO 11452-1.
quote: The test conditions shall be according to ISO 11452-1.
test_case: Verify in the test report that the test conditions (temperature, supply voltage, etc.) comply with ISO 11452-1.

text: The ESA under test shall be switched on and shall be stimulated to be in normal operation condition.
quote: The ESA under test shall be switched on and shall be stimulated to be in normal operation condition.
test_case: Confirm during the test that the lamps and sensors are powered and operating in normal mode (e.g. indicator flashing, fog lamp lit, sensors measuring).

text: The ESA under test shall be arranged as defined in this Annex unless individual test methods dictate otherwise.
quote: It shall be arranged as defined in this Annex unless individual test methods dictate otherwise.
test_case: Inspect the test set-up against the arrangement defined in Annex 9 and the applicable ISO 11452 part.

text: Any extraneous equipment required to operate the ESA under test shall not be in place during the calibration phase.
quote: Any extraneous equipment required to operate the ESA under test shall not be in place during the calibration phase.
test_case: Check the calibration records to confirm that no ESA operating equipment was present during field calibration.

text: No extraneous equipment shall be closer than 1 m from the reference point during calibration.
quote: No extraneous equipment shall be closer than 1 m from the reference point during calibration.
test_case: Measure the distance from the calibration reference point to any equipment; it must be at least 1 m.

text: To ensure reproducible measurement results, the test signal generating equipment and its layout shall be to the same specification as that used during each appropriate calibration phase.
quote: the test signal generating equipment and its layout shall be to the same specification as that used during each appropriate calibration phase.
test_case: Compare the test and calibration set-up records and confirm that the equipment and layout are identical.

text: If the ESA under test consists of more than one unit and the wiring harnesses as intended for use in the vehicle are not available as interconnecting cables, the length between the electronic control unit and the AN shall be as defined in the standard.
quote: If these are not available, the length between the electronic control unit and the AN shall be as defined in the standard.
condition: ESA consists of more than one unit (e.g. parking sensors with ECU) and the vehicle harness is not used
test_case: Measure the harness length between the ECU and the AN in the set-up and compare it with the length specified in the ISO standard.

text: The immunity measurements of the ESA shall be made in the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency range with frequency steps according to ISO 11452-1.
quote: Measurements shall be made in the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency range with frequency steps according to ISO 11452-1.
test_case: Check the test report confirms coverage of 20 to 6,000 MHz with ISO 11452-1 frequency steps.

text: If not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer, the test signal modulation shall be AM (amplitude modulation), with 1 kHz modulation and 80 per cent modulation depth in the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range.
quote: AM (amplitude modulation), with 1 kHz modulation and 80 per cent modulation depth in the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range
test_case: Verify that the generator settings in the 20 to 400 MHz range are AM, 1 kHz, 80 % depth.

text: If not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer, the test signal modulation shall be PM2 (pulse modulation type 2), Ton 3 µs, period 3,333 µs in the 2,700 to 3,100 MHz frequency range.
quote: PM2 (pulse modulation type 2), Ton 3 µs, period 3,333 µs in the 2,700 to 3,100 MHz frequency range
test_case: Verify that the generator settings in the 2,700 to 3,100 MHz range are PM with Ton 3 µs and a period of 3,333 µs.

text: If not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer, the test signal modulation shall be PM3 (pulse modulation type 3), Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs in the 380 to 2,700 MHz and the 3,100 to 6,000 MHz frequency ranges.
quote: PM3 (pulse modulation type 3), Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs in the 380 to 2,700 MHz and the 3,100 to 6,000 MHz frequency ranges
test_case: Verify that the generator settings in the 380 to 2,700 MHz and 3,100 to 6,000 MHz ranges are PM with Ton 500 µs and a period of 1,000 µs.

text: The frequency step size and dwell time shall be chosen according to ISO 11452-1.
quote: Frequency step size and dwell time shall be chosen according to ISO 11452-1.
test_case: Check that the step size and dwell time in the test report comply with ISO 11452-1.
merged: The frequency step size and dwell time shall be chosen according to ISO 11451-1.

text: The test of the ESA shall be performed at the intervals specified in ISO 11452-1, throughout the frequency range 20 to 6,000 MHz, or alternatively, if the manufacturer provides measurement data for the whole frequency band from a test laboratory accredited to the applicable parts of ISO 17025 and recognized by the Type Approval Authority, at a reduced number of spot frequencies chosen by the Technical Service to confirm that the ESA meets the requirements of this Annex.
quote: The Technical Service shall perform the test at the intervals specified in ISO 11452-1, throughout the frequency range 20 to 6,000 MHz.
test_case: Review the test report for the full-range intervals, or for accredited full-band data plus spot-frequency confirmation tests.

text: If an ESA fails the tests defined in this Annex, it shall be verified as having failed under the relevant test conditions and not as a result of the generation of uncontrolled fields.
quote: If an ESA fails the tests defined in this Annex, it shall be verified as having failed under the relevant test conditions
test_case: In case of a failure, check field monitoring records to confirm that the failure occurred under the specified field conditions.
merged: If a vehicle fails the test defined in Annex 6, it shall be verified as having failed under the relevant test conditions and not as a result of the generation of uncontrolled fields.

text: When the absorber chamber test is used, the "substitution method" shall be used to establish the test field conditions according to ISO 11452-2.
quote: The "substitution method" shall be used to establish the test field conditions according to ISO 11452-2.
condition: Absorber chamber test (ISO 11452-2) chosen
test_case: Verify in the absorber chamber test report that the field was established by the substitution method per ISO 11452-2.

text: When the absorber chamber test is used, the test shall be performed with vertical polarization.
quote: The test shall be performed with vertical polarization.
condition: Absorber chamber test (ISO 11452-2) chosen
test_case: Confirm that the antenna polarization recorded in the test report is vertical.

text: When TEM cell testing is used, the test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-3, and depending on the ESA to be tested the method of maximum field coupling to the ESA or to the wiring harness inside the TEM-cell shall be chosen.
quote: The test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-3. Depending on the ESA to be tested the Technical Service shall chose the method of maximum field coupling
condition: TEM cell test (ISO 11452-3) chosen
test_case: Check that the TEM cell test report references ISO 11452-3 and documents the chosen maximum coupling orientation.

text: When bulk current injection testing is used, the test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-4 on a test bench with the BCI substitution method and the injection probe positioned at 150 mm distance to the ESA, or with the BCI closed loop method and the injection probe positioned at 900 mm distance to the ESA, or alternatively with the ESA installed in the vehicle according to ISO 11451-4 with the BCI substitution method and the injection probe positioned at 150 mm distance to the ESA.
quote: The test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-4 on a test bench with the following characteristics: BCI test method with substitution method and injection probe positioned at 150 mm
condition: Bulk current injection test (ISO 11452-4) chosen
test_case: Verify the BCI method and measure the probe distance (150 mm substitution or 900 mm closed loop) in the set-up.

text: When stripline testing is used, the test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-5.
quote: Test methodology The test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-5.
condition: Stripline test (ISO 11452-5) chosen
test_case: Confirm that the stripline test report references and follows ISO 11452-5.

text: When the reverberation chamber test is used, the test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-11.
quote: Test methodology The test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-11.
condition: Reverberation chamber test (ISO 11452-11) chosen
test_case: Confirm that the reverberation chamber test report references and follows ISO 11452-11.

text: Unless otherwise specified, the reverberation chamber testing method shall be carried out using a test setup with ground plane.
quote: Unless otherwise specified, the reverberation chamber testing method shall be carried out using a test setup with ground plane.
condition: Reverberation chamber test (ISO 11452-11) chosen
test_case: Inspect the reverberation chamber set-up for the presence of a ground plane.

text: The test method shall ensure the immunity of ESAs to conducted transients on the vehicle power supply.
quote: This test method shall ensure the immunity of ESAs to conducted transients on the vehicle power supply
test_case: Perform the Annex 10 transient immunity tests on each ESA (LED lamps, parking sensors) and confirm that the required functional status is met.

text: The test method shall limit conducted transients from ESAs to the vehicle power supply.
quote: limit conducted transients from ESAs to the vehicle power supply
test_case: Measure the conducted transient emissions of each ESA on its supply lines and confirm they are within the limits.

text: For immunity against transient disturbances conducted along 12/24 V supply lines, the test pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b according to ISO 7637-2 shall be applied to the supply lines of the ESAs as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
quote: Apply the test pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 to the supply lines
test_case: Apply ISO 7637-2 pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b to the supply lines and connected lines of the ESA and verify the required FPSC is achieved.

text: For immunity against transient disturbances conducted along 12/24 V supply lines, the starting profile according to ISO 16750-2 shall be applied to the supply lines of the ESAs as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines; ESAs exclusively reserved for mounting on electric vehicles (vehicles without 12V/24V starter motor) are not subject to the starting profile.
quote: Apply the starting profile according to the International Standard ISO 16750-2 to the supply lines as well as to other connections
condition: The ESA may be installed on vehicles with a 12V/24V starter motor (not exclusively electric vehicles).
test_case: Apply the ISO 16750-2 starting profile to the supply lines of the ESA and verify the required functional status class is met.

text: The emission of transient conducted disturbances generated by ESAs on 12/24 V supply lines shall be measured according to ISO 7637-2 on supply lines as well as on other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
quote: Measurement according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 on supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs
test_case: Measure the transient emissions of the ESA per ISO 7637-2 on its supply lines and confirm compliance with the Regulation limits.

text: The provisions of this Regulation shall not apply to those parts of the external surface of the front bumper assembly which, with the vehicle in the laden condition and all doors, windows and access lids etc. closed, are at a height of more than 2 metres, below the floor line, or located so that, in their static condition and in operation, they cannot be contacted by a sphere 100 mm in diameter.
quote: The provisions of this Regulation shall not apply to those parts of the external surface which, with the vehicle in the laden condition
test_case: With the vehicle laden and all closures shut, check each bumper surface area for height above 2 m, location below the floor line and contactability by a 100 mm sphere to define the assessed zone.

text: The external surface of the vehicle (front bumper assembly, including fascia, grille, emblem, plate holder and towing eye cover) shall not exhibit, directed outwards, any pointed or sharp parts or any projections of such shape, dimensions, direction or hardness as to be likely to increase the risk or seriousness of bodily injury to a person hit by the external surface or brushing against it in the event of a collision.
quote: The external surface of vehicles shall not exhibit, directed outwards, any pointed or sharp parts or any projections of such shape, dimensions, direction or hardness
test_case: Inspect the installed bumper external surface; pass if no outward-directed pointed, sharp or injurious projections are found.

text: The external surface of the vehicle (front bumper assembly) shall not exhibit, directed outwards, any part likely to catch on pedestrians, cyclists or motor cyclists.
quote: The external surface of vehicles shall not exhibit, directed outwards, any part likely to catch on pedestrians, cyclists or motor cyclists.
test_case: Inspect the installed bumper for outward-directed hooks, edges or parts that could catch; pass if none are present.

text: No protruding part of the external surface of the front bumper assembly shall have a radius of curvature less than 2.5 mm.
quote: No protruding part of the external surface shall have a radius of curvature less than 2.5 mm.
test_case: Measure radii of curvature of all protruding parts with radius gauges; pass if every radius is at least 2.5 mm.

text: For parts of the external surface of the front bumper assembly which protrude less than 5 mm, the 2.5 mm radius requirement shall not apply, but the outward facing angles of such parts shall be blunted, save where such parts protrude less than 1.5 mm.
quote: This requirement shall not apply to parts of the external surface which protrude less than 5 mm, but the outward facing angles of such parts shall be blunted
test_case: Measure protrusion of small features; for those protruding 1.5 mm to <5 mm verify outward facing angles are blunted.

text: Where protruding parts of the external surface of the front bumper assembly are made of a material of hardness not exceeding 60 Shore A and have a radius of curvature less than 2.5 mm, the hardness measurement shall be taken with the component as installed on the vehicle.
quote: The hardness measurement shall be taken with the component as installed on the vehicle.
condition: Protruding parts made of soft material (≤60 Shore A) with radius less than 2.5 mm are present.
test_case: Measure Shore A hardness on the installed component; pass if hardness ≤60 Shore A for parts with radius below 2.5 mm.

text: Where it is impossible to carry out a hardness measurement by the Shore A procedure on protruding parts of the front bumper assembly, comparable measurements shall be used for evaluation.
quote: Where it is impossible to carry out a hardness measurement by the Shore A procedure, comparable measurements shall be used for evaluation.
condition: Soft-material exemption is claimed and Shore A measurement is impossible.
test_case: Verify that an equivalent hardness measurement method was used and documented where Shore A could not be applied.

text: The provisions of paragraphs 5.1. to 5.5. shall apply to the front bumper assembly in addition to the particular specifications of paragraph 6., except where these particular specifications expressly provide otherwise.
quote: The provisions of the above paragraphs 5.1. to 5.5. shall apply in addition to the particular specifications of the following paragraph 6.
test_case: Check that the assessment of bumper, grille and emblem covers both paragraph 5 and paragraph 6 requirements unless expressly exempted.

text: Added ornaments (e.g. the radome emblem) which project more than 10 mm from their support shall retract, become detached or bend over under a force of 10 daN exerted at their most salient point in any direction in a plane approximately parallel to the surface on which they are mounted.
quote: Added ornaments which project more than 10 mm from their support shall retract, become detached or bend over under a force of 10 daN
condition: The emblem or another added ornament projects more than 10 mm from its support and is not mounted on a radiator grille.
test_case: Apply 10 daN at the most salient point parallel to the mounting surface; pass if the ornament retracts, detaches or bends over.

text: After the ornaments are retracted, detached or bent over, the remaining projections shall not project more than 10 mm.
quote: After the ornaments are retracted, detached or bent over, the remaining projections shall not project more than 10 mm.
condition: An added ornament projecting more than 10 mm is present.
test_case: After the 10 daN test, measure the remaining projection; pass if it is 10 mm or less.

text: The projections remaining after the ornaments are retracted, detached or bent over shall in any case satisfy the provisions of paragraph 5.2.
quote: These projections shall in any case satisfy the provisions of paragraph 5.2.
condition: An added ornament projecting more than 10 mm is present.
test_case: Inspect the residual projections after the test; pass if no pointed, sharp or injurious parts remain.

text: For ornaments on radiator grilles, only the general requirements of paragraph 5. shall apply.
quote: These provisions shall not apply to ornaments on radiator grilles, to which only the general requirements of paragraph 5. shall apply.
condition: The emblem is mounted on a radiator grille.
test_case: Verify the grille-mounted emblem against paragraph 5 radius and projection requirements.

text: To apply the 10 daN force to the ornament, a flat-ended ram of not more than 50 mm diameter shall be used, or, where this is not possible, an equivalent method shall be used.
quote: To apply the 10 daN force a flat-ended ram of not more than 50 mm diameter shall be used.
condition: An added ornament projecting more than 10 mm is present.
test_case: Check that the ornament test used a flat-ended ram of ≤50 mm diameter or a documented equivalent method.

text: If the ornament (emblem) is mounted on a base, this base shall be regarded as belonging to the ornament and not to the supporting surface.
quote: If the ornament is mounted on a base, this base is regarded as belonging to the ornament and not to the supporting surface.
condition: The emblem is mounted on a base.
test_case: Measure ornament projection including the base from the supporting surface.

text: Protective strips or shielding on the external surface of the front bumper assembly shall be firmly secured to the vehicle.
quote: Protective strips or shielding on the external surface shall not be subject to the requirements of paragraph 6.1.1. above; however, they shall be firmly secured to the vehicle.
condition: Protective strips or shielding are present on the bumper.
test_case: Check the attachment of protective strips by manual pull; pass if they are firmly secured.

text: Projecting visors and rims on headlights (lamps integrated in the bumper) shall not project more than 30 mm as measured in relation to the external transparent surface of the headlight and their radius of curvature shall be at least 2.5 mm throughout, determined according to paragraph 3. of Annex 3.
quote: provided that their projection, as measured in relation to the external transparent surface of the headlight does not exceed 30 mm
condition: Lamp bezels are treated as headlight visors/rims (bumper contains headlamps).
test_case: Measure bezel projection from the lens per Annex 3 para 3 and radii; pass if ≤30 mm and ≥2.5 mm.

text: The requirements of paragraph 5.4. shall not apply to gaps between fixed or movable elements, including those forming part of air intake or outlet grilles and radiator grilles, provided that the distance between consecutive elements does not exceed 40 mm and provided that the grilles and gaps have a functional purpose.
quote: provided that the distance between consecutive elements does not exceed 40 mm and provided that the grilles and gaps have a functional purpose.
test_case: Measure distances between consecutive lower grille elements; verify ≤40 mm and functional purpose where the 2.5 mm radius exemption is used.

text: For gaps of between 40 mm and 25 mm between consecutive elements of grilles and gaps, the radii of curvature shall be 1 mm or more.
quote: For gaps of between 40 mm and 25 mm the radii of curvature shall be 1 mm or more.
test_case: For grille gaps between 25 and 40 mm, measure element radii; pass if ≥1 mm.

text: If the distance between two consecutive elements of grilles and gaps is equal to or less than 25 mm, the radii of curvature of external faces of the elements shall not be less than 0.5 mm.
quote: if the distance between two consecutive elements is equal to or less than 25 mm, the radii of curvature of external faces of the elements shall not be less than 0.5 mm.
test_case: For grille gaps ≤25 mm, measure external face radii; pass if ≥0.5 mm.

text: The distance between two consecutive elements of grilles and gaps shall be determined according to the method described in paragraph 4. of Annex 3 to this Regulation.
quote: The distance between two consecutive elements of grilles and gaps shall be determined according to the method described in paragraph 4. of Annex 3
test_case: Verify gap distances were measured using the Annex 3 paragraph 4 method.

text: The junction of the front with the side faces of each element forming a grille or gap shall be blunted.
quote: The junction of the front with the side faces of each element forming a grille or gap shall be blunted.
test_case: Inspect each grille element edge between front and side faces; pass if blunted.

text: The ends of the bumpers shall be turned in towards the external surface in order to minimize the risk of fouling.
quote: The ends of the bumpers shall be turned in towards the external surface in order to minimize the risk of fouling.
test_case: Inspect bumper ends; pass if they turn in towards the body surface.

text: The bumper end requirement is considered satisfied if either the bumper is recessed or integrated within the bodywork or the end of the bumper is turned in so that it is not contactable by a 100 mm sphere and the gap between the bumper end and the surrounding bodywork does not exceed 20 mm.
quote: the end of the bumper is turned in so that it is not contactable by a 100 mm sphere and the gap between the bumper end and the surrounding bodywork does not exceed 20 mm.
test_case: Check bumper integration in bodywork, or verify with a 100 mm sphere that the end is not contactable and measure the end gap ≤20 mm.

text: If the line of the bumper which corresponds to the outline contour of the car vertical projection is on a rigid surface, that surface shall have a minimum radius of curvature of 5 mm at all its points lying from the contour line to 20 mm inward, this applying to that part of the zone situated between and in front of the tangential points with the contour line of two vertical planes each forming with the longitudinal plane of symmetry of the vehicle an angle of 15° (see Fig. 1).
quote: that surface shall have a minimum radius of curvature of 5 mm at all its points lying from the contour line to 20 mm inward
condition: Bumper contour line lies on a rigid surface (not the bumper cover); geometry not provided
test_case: Measure radii of the rigid surface within 20 mm inward of the contour line in the ±15° zone per Fig. 1; pass if all radii ≥ 5 mm.

text: If the line of the bumper which corresponds to the outline contour of the car vertical projection is on a rigid surface, that surface shall have a minimum radius of curvature of 2.5 mm in all other cases.
quote: and a minimum radius of curvature of 2.5 mm in all other cases
condition: Bumper contour line lies on a rigid surface (not the bumper cover); geometry not provided
test_case: Measure radii of the rigid bumper surface outside the 5 mm zone; pass if all radii ≥ 2.5 mm.

text: Parts on or of the bumper or bumper insets which have a projection of less than 5 mm, with special reference to joint covers and jets for headlamp washers, are exempt from paragraph 6.5.2., but the outward facing angles of such parts shall be blunted, save where such parts protrude less than 1.5 mm.
quote: but the outward facing angles of such parts shall be blunted, save where such parts protrude less than 1.5 mm
test_case: Identify bumper parts/insets projecting less than 5 mm (e.g. sensors, joint covers) and check that outward facing angles are blunted where projection ≥ 1.5 mm.

text: The requirement of paragraph 6.5.2. does not apply to the bumper cover; the provisions of paragraph 5. of this Regulation remain applicable to the bumper cover.
quote: The requirement of paragraph 6.5.2. above does not apply to the bumper cover. The provisions of paragraph 5. of this Regulation remain applicable.
test_case: Assess the bumper cover (fascia) against the general requirements of paragraph 5 (radii and projections); pass if all paragraph 5 requirements are met.

text: Air intake and outlet flaps shall meet the requirements of paragraphs 5.2., 5.3. and 5.4. in all positions of use.
quote: Air intake and outlet flaps shall meet the requirements of paragraphs 5.2., 5.3. and 5.4. above in all positions of use.
condition: Lower grille / air intake includes movable flaps (active grille shutters)
test_case: Check the air intake flaps in every position of use against paragraphs 5.2, 5.3 and 5.4; pass if all are met in all positions.

text: Folds in body panels may have a radius of curvature of less than 2.5 mm only provided that it is not less than one-tenth of the height "H" of the projection, measured in accordance with the method described in paragraph 1. of Annex 3 to this Regulation.
quote: Folds in body panels may have a radius of curvature of less than 2.5 mm provided that it is not less than one-tenth of the height "H"
condition: Fascia has folds with radius less than 2.5 mm
test_case: Measure fold radius and projection height H per Annex 3 paragraph 1; pass if radius ≥ H/10.

text: Supporting brackets provided by the vehicle manufacturer for registration plates shall comply with the requirements of paragraph 5.4. of this Regulation if they are contactable by a 100 mm diameter sphere when a registration plate is fitted in accordance with the vehicle manufacturer's recommendation.
quote: Supporting brackets provided by the vehicle manufacturer for registration plates shall comply with the requirements of paragraph 5.4. of this Regulation if they are contactable
test_case: Fit a registration plate per manufacturer recommendation, probe the plate holder with a 100 mm sphere; where contactable, verify paragraph 5.4 radius requirements are met.

text: Where the UN R26 approval mark is affixed to the vehicle, it shall be arranged according to Model A (or Model B when grouped with other Regulation approvals), with the dimension a = 8 mm min.
quote: The above approval mark affixed to a vehicle shows that the vehicle type concerned has been approved in the Netherlands (E 4) pursuant to UN Regulation No. 26
condition: Only relevant if the approval mark is affixed on the bumper assembly as part of whole-vehicle type approval; the mark is a vehicle-level marking, not a bumper marking.
test_case: Inspect the approval mark on the vehicle and measure that its arrangement follows Model A/B and dimension a is at least 8 mm.

text: The height H of a projection of folds in body panels (e.g. of the bumper fascia) shall be determined graphically by reference to the circumference of a 165 mm diameter circle, internally tangential to the external outline of the external surface at the section to be checked.
quote: The height H of a projection is determined graphically by reference to the circumference of a 165 mm diameter circle
test_case: On a fascia section drawing, fit an internally tangential 165 mm circle to the external outline and confirm the projection height is derived from it.

text: The height H of a projection of folds in body panels shall be the maximum value of the distance, measured along a straight line passing through the centre of the 165 mm diameter circle, between the circumference of the circle and the external contour of the projection (see Fig.1).
quote: H is the maximum value of the distance, measured along a straight line passing through the centre of the 165 mm diameter circle
test_case: Measure the maximum radial distance from the 165 mm circle to the projection contour on the section and verify it is reported as H.

text: Where it is not possible for a 100 mm diameter circle to contact externally part of the external outline of the external surface at the section under consideration, the surface outline in this area shall be assumed to be that formed by the circumference of the 100 mm diameter circle between its tangent points with the external outline (see Fig.2).
