quote: the surface outline in this area will be assumed to be that formed by the circumference of the 100 mm diameter circle between its tangent points
test_case: Check fascia sections with a 100 mm circle; where it cannot contact the outline, verify the outline is replaced by the circle arc between tangent points.

text: Drawings of the necessary sections through the external surface (e.g. of the bumper fascia) shall be provided by the manufacturer to allow the height of the projections to be measured.
quote: Drawings of the necessary sections through the external surface shall be provided by the manufacturer to allow the height of the projections
test_case: Verify that section drawings of the bumper external surface are available and allow measurement of projection heights.

text: If the dimension of the projection of a component mounted on a surface other than convex (e.g. emblem, plate holder, towing eye cover, sensors) cannot be determined by simple measurement, it shall be determined by the maximum variation of the distance of the centre of a 100 mm diameter sphere from the nominal line of the panel when the sphere is moved over and is in constant contact with that component.
quote: it shall be determined by the maximum variation of the distance of the centre of a 100 mm diameter sphere from the nominal line of the panel
test_case: Roll a 100 mm sphere over the mounted component in constant contact and record the maximum variation of the sphere centre from the nominal panel line as the projection.

text: The projection of headlamp visors and rims from the external surface of the headlamp shall be measured horizontally from the point of contact of a 100 mm diameter sphere as shown in Figure 4.
quote: The projection from the external surface of the headlamp shall be measured horizontally from the point of contact of a 100 mm diameter sphere
condition: Only if the bumper carries headlamps or lamp visors/rims treated as headlamp visors (not stated; only fog lamps with bezels are listed).
test_case: Measure horizontally from the contact point of a 100 mm sphere to the visor/rim edge and verify against the projection limit.

text: The dimension of a gap or space between elements of a grille (e.g. the lower grille and air intake) shall be determined by the distance between two planes passing through the points of contact of the sphere and perpendicular to the line joining those points of contact.
quote: The dimension of a gap or space between elements of a grille shall be determined by the distance between two planes passing through the points of contact
test_case: Place the sphere in the lower grille openings and measure the distance between the two perpendicular planes through its contact points to obtain the gap dimension.

text: Every vehicle conforming to a vehicle type approved under this Regulation shall have affixed, conspicuously and in a readily accessible place specified on the approval form, an international approval mark consisting of a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the approving country and the number of this Regulation followed by the letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the circle.
quote: There shall be affixed, conspicuously and in a readily accessible place specified on the approval form, to every vehicle conforming to a vehicle type approved
test_case: Inspect the vehicle for an approval mark of the prescribed layout in the specified location.

text: The approval mark shall be clearly legible and be indelible.
quote: The approval mark shall be clearly legible and be indelible.
test_case: Visually check legibility and perform a rub test for indelibility.

text: The approval mark shall be placed close to or on the vehicle data plate affixed by the manufacturer.
quote: The approval mark shall be placed close to or on the vehicle data plate affixed by the manufacturer.
test_case: Verify the approval mark is on or adjacent to the vehicle data plate.

text: The vehicle fitted with the front protective device shall be subjected to impact tests made in accordance with the conditions and procedure specified in annex 3 to this Regulation and, after each impact test, shall meet the requirements of paragraphs 6.1.1. to 6.1.5.
quote: After each impact test made in accordance with the conditions and procedure specified in annex 3 to this Regulation, the vehicle shall meet the following requirements
test_case: Perform the low-speed impact tests per Annex 3 on the vehicle with the bumper fitted and check all paragraph 6.1.1-6.1.5 criteria after each impact.

text: After each impact test made in accordance with annex 3, the lighting and signalling devices shall continue to operate correctly and to remain visible.
quote: The lighting and signalling devices shall continue to operate correctly and to remain visible.
test_case: After each Annex 3 impact, operate the integrated front fog lamps and direction indicators and verify they function correctly and remain visible.

text: After each impact test made in accordance with annex 3, should the adjustment of the factory-fitted lighting devices be disturbed, it may be corrected to conform to the required specifications only provided this can be done by the normal means of adjustment.
quote: Should the adjustment of the factory-fitted lighting devices be disturbed, it may be corrected to conform to the required specifications, provided this can be done by the normal means of adjustment.
condition: Lighting device adjustment (e.g. fog lamp aim) disturbed by the impact
test_case: If fog lamp aim is disturbed after impact, verify it can be restored to specification using only the normal adjustment means.

text: After each impact test made in accordance with annex 3, the vehicle's bonnet (hood), boot lid (trunk lid) and doors shall be operable in the normal manner.
quote: The vehicle's bonnet (hood), boot lid (trunk lid) and doors shall be operable in the normal manner
test_case: After each impact, open and close the bonnet, boot lid and doors and verify normal operation.

text: The side doors of the vehicle shall not be able to open under the effect of the impact made in accordance with annex 3.
quote: in addition, the side doors of the vehicle shall not be able to open under the effect of the impact.
test_case: Observe during and after each impact that no side door opens.

text: After each impact test made in accordance with annex 3, the vehicle's fuel and cooling systems shall have neither leaks nor constricted fluid passages which prevent normal functioning.
quote: The vehicle’s fuel and cooling systems shall have neither leaks nor constricted fluid passages which prevent normal functioning
test_case: After each impact, inspect fuel and cooling systems behind the bumper for leaks and constrictions and verify normal functioning.

text: After each impact test made in accordance with annex 3, the sealing devices and caps of the vehicle's fuel and cooling systems shall be operable in the normal manner.
quote: their sealing devices and caps shall be operable in the normal manner.
test_case: After each impact, operate fuel and coolant caps/sealing devices and verify normal operation.

text: After each impact test made in accordance with annex 3, the vehicle's exhaust system shall not suffer any damage or displacement which would prevent its normal function.
quote: The vehicle's exhaust system shall not suffer any damage or displacement which would prevent its normal function.
test_case: After each impact, inspect the exhaust system for damage or displacement impairing its function.

text: After each impact test made in accordance with annex 3, the vehicle's propulsion, suspension (including tyres), steering and braking systems shall remain in adjustment and shall operate in a normal manner.
quote: The vehicle's propulsion, suspension (including tyres), steering and braking systems shall remain in adjustment and shall operate in a normal manner.
test_case: After each impact, check alignment/adjustment and normal operation of propulsion, suspension, tyres, steering and brakes.

text: Sensors, cameras, radar devices, etc. being part of driver assist systems (e.g. the front radar and ultrasonic parking sensors) may become damaged, disoriented or broken due to an impact carried out according to Annex 3 only as long as the basic braking and steering performance are still intact.
quote: They may become damaged, disoriented or broken due to an impact carried out according to Annex 3 as long as the basic braking and steering performance are still intact.
test_case: After each impact, if radar/parking sensors are damaged or misaligned, verify basic braking and steering performance remain intact.

text: The low-speed-impact test shall make it possible to verify whether the protective devices of the vehicle meet the requirements of this Regulation.
quote: The test shall make it possible to verify whether the protective devices of the vehicle meet the requirements of this Regulation.
test_case: Check that the test report shows the front protective device was assessed against the Regulation's requirements using the Annex 3 procedure.

text: For the low-speed-impact test, the vehicle shall be placed on a horizontal and level rigid smooth surface.
quote: The vehicle shall be placed on a horizontal and level rigid smooth surface.
test_case: Inspect the test setup and confirm the vehicle stands on a horizontal, level, rigid, smooth surface.

text: For the low-speed-impact test, the vehicle shall be at rest.
quote: The vehicle shall be at rest.
test_case: Confirm from the test record that the vehicle was stationary before impact.

text: For the low-speed-impact test, the front wheels shall be in the straight-ahead position.
quote: The front wheels shall be in the straight-ahead position.
test_case: Check the front wheels are set straight-ahead before the impact.

text: For the low-speed-impact test, the tyres shall be inflated to the pressure recommended by the vehicle manufacturer.
quote: The tyres shall be inflated to the pressure recommended by the vehicle manufacturer.
test_case: Measure tyre pressures before the test and compare them with the manufacturer's recommended values.

text: For the low-speed-impact test, the brakes shall be disengaged and the transmission control shall be in neutral position.
quote: The brakes shall be disengaged and the transmission control shall be in neutral position.
test_case: Verify that the brakes are released and the transmission is in neutral before the impact.

text: Vehicles equipped with hydro pneumatic, hydraulic or pneumatic suspension or a device for automatic levelling according to load shall be tested in the normal running conditions specified by the manufacturer.
quote: Vehicles equipped with hydro pneumatic, hydraulic or pneumatic suspension or a device for automatic levelling according to load shall be tested in the normal running conditions
condition: Target vehicle has hydro pneumatic, hydraulic or pneumatic suspension or automatic load levelling
test_case: Confirm the suspension was set to the manufacturer-specified normal running condition during the test.

text: The effective mass of the impactor shall be equal to the mass corresponding to the "unladen weight" of the vehicle to be tested.
quote: The effective mass shall be equal to the mass corresponding to the “unladen weight" of the vehicle to be tested.
test_case: Compare the impactor effective mass with the vehicle unladen mass in the test report; they must be equal.

text: In the two vehicle-loading conditions the protective device between the corners, as defined in paragraph 3.1.5. of this Regulation, shall be intersected by the horizontal plane passing through the reference line.
quote: In the two vehicle-loading conditions the protective device between the corners, as defined in paragraph 3.1.5. of this Regulation, shall be intersected by the horizontal plane
test_case: Measure the protective device height at unladen and laden weight and confirm the horizontal plane at the reference height intersects it between the corners.

text: The first contact of the impactor with the vehicle shall be by the impact contour on the protective device.
quote: The first contact of the impactor with the vehicle shall be by the impact contour on the protective device.
test_case: Use high-speed video or contact marks to confirm the impactor contour first touches the front protective device and no other part.

text: The reference height of the impactor reference line is 445 mm.
quote: The reference height is 445 mm.
test_case: Measure the height of the impactor reference line above the ground; it must be 445 mm.

text: The longitudinal impact test shall consist of two impacts on the front surface of the vehicle, one impact made with the vehicle under "unladen weight", as defined in paragraph 3.1.3. of this Regulation, and the other made with the vehicle under "laden test weight", as defined in paragraph 3.1.4.
quote: On each surface one impact is made with the vehicle under "unladen weight", as defined in paragraph 3.1.3. of this Regulation, and the other
test_case: Check that the test report shows two frontal longitudinal impacts, one at unladen weight and one at laden test weight.

text: For the longitudinal impacts on the front surface, the median plane of the impactor for the second impact shall be at a distance at least 300 mm from the first, provided that the extremities of the impactor do not pass outside a zone defined by two planes parallel to the longitudinal median plane and passing through the corners of the vehicle.
quote: for the second impact the median plane of the impactor shall be at a distance at least 300 mm from the first
test_case: Measure the lateral offset between the two impact locations (at least 300 mm) and confirm both lie within the corner planes.

text: For the longitudinal impact test, the impactor should be placed so that plane A is vertical and the reference line is horizontal at the reference height of 445 mm.
quote: The impactor shown in the figure should be placed so that plane A is vertical and the reference line is horizontal at the reference height of 445 mm.
test_case: Verify the impactor orientation (plane A vertical, reference line horizontal) and height of 445 mm before the longitudinal impact.
merged: For the corner impact test, the impactor should be placed so that plane A is vertical and the reference line is horizontal and at the reference height of 445 mm.

text: For the longitudinal impact test, the vehicle should be aligned so that a point between the vehicle corners touches, but does not move, the impactor, the longitudinal median plane of the vehicle being perpendicular to plane A of the impactor.
quote: The vehicle should be aligned so that a point between the vehicle corners touches, but does not move, the impactor
test_case: Check the alignment record: contact point between the corners, and vehicle median plane perpendicular to plane A.

text: In the longitudinal impact test, the vehicle should be impacted at a speed of 4 km/h +0.25/-0.
quote: The vehicle should be impacted at a speed of 4 km/h +0.25/-0
test_case: Record the impact speed with the speed instrument; it must be between 4.00 and 4.25 km/h.

text: The corner impact test shall consist of an impact at one front corner of the vehicle at unladen weight (see paragraph 3.1.3. of the Regulation) and an impact at the other front corner with the vehicle at the weight given in paragraph 3.1.4.
quote: This test consists of an impact at one front corner and an impact at one rear corner of the vehicle, which is at unladen weight
test_case: Check the test report shows one front-corner impact at unladen weight and the other front-corner impact at laden test weight.

text: For the corner impact test, plane A of the impactor shall make an angle of 60 ± 5º with the longitudinal median plane of the vehicle.
quote: plane A of the impactor shall make an angle of 60 ± 5º with the longitudinal median plane of the vehicle
test_case: Measure the angle between plane A and the vehicle median plane; it must be within 55° to 65°.

text: For the corner impact test, the point of the first contact shall be in the vertical median plane of the impactor (within a tolerance of ± 25 mm).
quote: the point of the first contact shall be in the vertical median plane of the impactor (within a tolerance of ± 25 mm)
test_case: Measure the offset of the first contact point from the impactor's vertical median plane; it must be no more than 25 mm.

text: In the corner impact test, the vehicle should be impacted at a speed of 2.5 km/h +0.1/-0.
quote: The vehicle should be impacted at a speed of 2.5 km/h +0.1/-0
test_case: Record the corner impact speed; it must be between 2.5 and 2.6 km/h.

text: If the protective devices include self-restoring materials, the permitted recovery time between tests shall be as stated by the manufacturer.
quote: If the protective devices include self-restoring materials, the permitted recovery time between tests shall be as stated by the manufacturer.
condition: Protective device (e.g. EPP energy absorber) is declared as containing self-restoring materials
test_case: Check that the time between tests is not shorter than the recovery time stated by the manufacturer.

text: The instrument used to record the impact speed referred to in paragraphs 2.7.5. and 2.8.4. shall be accurate to within one per cent.
quote: The instrument used to record the speed referred to in paragraphs 2.7.5. and 2.8.4. above shall be accurate to within one per cent.
test_case: Check the calibration certificate of the speed measurement instrument; accuracy must be within ±1 %.

text: The lighting and light-signalling devices (front fog lamps and front direction indicators) shall be so fitted that under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and notwithstanding any vibrations to which they may be subjected, they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation and enable the vehicle to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
quote: The lighting and light-signalling devices shall be so fitted that under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10.
test_case: Inspect lamp mountings in the bumper after vibration/normal use and confirm position, orientation and photometry remain within the Regulation's requirements.

text: It shall not be possible for the front fog lamps and front direction indicator lamps to be inadvertently maladjusted.
quote: In particular, it shall not be possible for the lamps to be inadvertently maladjusted.
test_case: Check that lamp fixing and any aiming device in the bumper cannot be moved without deliberate action or tools.

text: The illuminating lamps described in paragraph 2.5.10. (front fog lamps) shall be so installed that correct adjustment of their orientation can easily be carried out.
quote: The illuminating lamps described in paragraphs 2.5.1., 2.5.2. and 2.5.10. shall be so installed that correct adjustment of their orientation can easily be carried out.
test_case: Verify on the vehicle that the front fog lamp aim can be easily adjusted with the bumper fitted.

text: For all light-signalling devices (front direction indicators), the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the bearing plane of the vehicle on the road, with a tolerance of ±3°.
quote: the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the bearing plane of the vehicle on the road
test_case: Measure the installed direction indicator reference axis relative to the ground plane; deviation shall not exceed ±3°.

text: For light-signalling devices other than side retro-reflectors and side-marker lamps (front direction indicators), the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle, with a tolerance of ±3°.
quote: it shall be perpendicular to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle in the case of side retro-reflectors and of side-marker lamps and parallel to that plane in the case of all other signalling devices
test_case: Measure the installed direction indicator reference axis relative to the vehicle median longitudinal plane; deviation shall not exceed ±3°.

text: Any specific instructions as regards fitting of the light-signalling devices laid down by the manufacturer shall be complied with.
quote: In addition, any specific instructions as regards fitting laid down by the manufacturer shall be complied with.
test_case: Compare lamp installation in the bumper with the manufacturer's fitting instructions; all instructions shall be met.

text: For all light-signalling devices, in each direction a tolerance of ±3° shall be allowed for the orientation of the reference axis.
quote: In each direction a tolerance of ±3° shall be allowed.
test_case: Confirm measured angular deviations of the reference axis in each direction are within ±3°.

text: In the absence of specific instructions, the height and orientation of the front fog lamps and front direction indicators shall be verified with the vehicle unladen and placed on a flat, horizontal surface, in the condition defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2.
quote: the height and orientation of the lamps shall be verified with the vehicle unladen and placed on a flat, horizontal surface
test_case: Measure lamp heights and orientation on the unladen vehicle on a flat horizontal surface and record compliance.

text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair (front fog lamps, front direction indicators) shall be fitted to the vehicle symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane (based on the exterior geometrical form of the lamp and not on the edge of its illuminating surface).
quote: Be fitted to the vehicle symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane (this estimate to be based on the exterior geometrical form of the lamp
test_case: Measure lateral positions of left and right lamps from the median longitudinal plane; they shall be symmetrical.

text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall be symmetrical to one another in relation to the median longitudinal plane; this requirement is not valid with regard to the interior structure of the lamp.
quote: Be symmetrical to one another in relation to the median longitudinal plane, this requirement is not valid with regard to the interior structure of the lamp
test_case: Compare exterior form of left and right lamps; they shall be mirror-symmetrical.

text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall satisfy the same colorimetric requirements.
quote: Satisfy the same colorimetric requirements.
test_case: Check approval/colour of left and right lamps of each pair; both shall meet the same colour requirements.

text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall have substantially identical photometric characteristics; this shall not apply to a matched pair of a function.
quote: Have substantially identical photometric characteristics. This shall not apply to a matched pair of a function and/or an AFS.
test_case: Compare photometric approval data of left and right lamps of each pair; they shall be substantially identical.

text: In case of lamps incorporating a manufacturer logo, only two lateral logos (one on each side) or one central logo can be fitted on the front of the vehicle.
quote: only two lateral logos (one on each side) or one central logo can be fitted on the front of the vehicle
condition: Front fog lamps or direction indicators incorporate a manufacturer logo
test_case: Inspect front lamps for logos; count shall be two lateral or one central at most.

text: In case of lamps incorporating a logo, all logos that are not vehicle manufacturer or body manufacturer logos are prohibited.
quote: All logos that are not vehicle manufacturer or body manufacturer logos are prohibited.
condition: Front fog lamps or direction indicators incorporate a logo
test_case: Inspect any logos in lamps; only vehicle or body manufacturer logos shall be present.

text: On vehicles whose external shape is asymmetrical the requirements for lamps constituting a pair shall be satisfied so far as is possible.
quote: On vehicles whose external shape is asymmetrical the above requirements shall be satisfied so far as is possible.
condition: Vehicle/bumper external shape is asymmetrical
test_case: Assess pair symmetry on asymmetric front end; deviations shall be limited to those forced by the shape.

text: Where lamps are grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with one another, all requirements regarding colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility, electrical connections and other requirements, if any, shall be fulfilled.
quote: Lamps may be grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with one another provided that all requirements regarding colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility, electrical connections
condition: Fog lamp or direction indicator is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with other lamps
test_case: For each grouped/combined lamp verify colour, position, orientation, visibility and electrical connection requirements of every function.

text: The photometric and colorimetric requirements of a lamp shall be fulfilled when all other functions with which this lamp is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated are switched OFF.
quote: The photometric and colorimetric requirements of a lamp shall be fulfilled when all other functions with which this lamp is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated are switched OFF.
condition: Fog lamp or direction indicator is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with other functions
test_case: Measure photometry and colour of each function with the other functions switched OFF; values shall comply.

text: When a front position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with one or more other function(s) which can be switched ON together with it, the requirements regarding colour of each of these other functions shall be fulfilled when the reciprocally incorporated function(s) and the front position lamps are switched ON.
quote: when a front or rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with one or more other function(s) which can be switched ON together with them
condition: A front position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with the fog lamp or direction indicator
test_case: Measure colour of the other function with both it and the front position lamp ON; colour shall comply.

text: Stop lamps and direction-indicator lamps shall not be reciprocally incorporated.
quote: Stop lamps and direction-indicator lamps are not permitted to be reciprocally incorporated.
test_case: Verify the direction indicator is not reciprocally incorporated with a stop lamp.

text: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.14.11.1., subparagraph (a), the apparent surface of which is composed of two or more distinct parts, shall be installed so that either the total area of the projection of the distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis occupies not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projection, or the minimum distance between the facing edges of two adjacent/tangential distinct parts does not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis.
quote: shall occupy not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projection of the said apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis
condition: Fog lamp or direction indicator apparent surface is composed of two or more distinct parts
test_case: Measure apparent surface projection: ≥60 % fill of circumscribing quadrilateral or gap between parts ≤75 mm.

text: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.4.11.1., subparagraph (b) or (c), composed of two lamps marked "D", shall be installed so that either the projection of the apparent surfaces of the two lamps occupies not less than 60 per cent of the smallest circumscribing quadrilateral, or the minimum distance between the facing edges of the apparent surfaces does not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis.
quote: composed of two lamps marked "D" or two independent retro reflectors, shall be installed in such a way that
condition: Fog lamp or direction indicator is made of two lamps marked "D"
test_case: Measure projection of the two D-marked lamps: ≥60 % fill or facing-edge distance ≤75 mm.

text: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.4.11.1., subparagraph (d) (interdependent lamp system) shall fulfil the requirements of paragraph 5.7.2.1.
quote: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.4.11.1., subparagraph (d) shall fulfil the requirements of paragraph 5.7.2.1.
condition: Fog lamp or direction indicator is an interdependent lamp system
test_case: Verify interdependent lamp system against the 60 %/75 mm criteria of paragraph 5.7.2.1.

text: Two lamps or an even number of lamps in the shape of a band or strip shall be placed symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle, extending on both sides to within at least 0.4 m of the extreme outer edge of the vehicle, and shall be not less than 0.8 m long; the illumination shall be provided by not less than two light sources placed as close as possible to the ends.
quote: shall be placed symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle, extending on both sides to within at least 0.4 m
condition: Lamp is in the shape of a band or strip
test_case: Measure strip lamp: symmetric, ≤0.4 m from outer edge, ≥0.8 m long, ≥2 light sources near ends.

text: White light emitted by a lamp fitted on the front of the vehicle (front fog lamps) shall not be visible from the rear of the vehicle.
quote: White light emitted by a lamp fitted on the front of the vehicle (as defined in paragraph 2.1.5.) shall not be visible from the rear of the vehicle.
test_case: Check visibility of the front fog lamp apparent surface from the rear per paragraph 5.10.4.2.

text: The maximum height above the ground of the front fog lamps and front direction indicators shall be measured from the highest point and the minimum height from the lowest point of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis.
quote: The maximum height above the ground shall be measured from the highest point and the minimum height from the lowest point of the apparent surface
test_case: Measure lamp heights from the highest and lowest points of the apparent surface and compare with the limits.

text: For the purposes of reducing the geometric visibility angles, the position of a lamp with regard to height above the ground shall be measured from the H plane.
quote: For the purposes of reducing the geometric visibility angles, the position of a lamp with regard to height above the ground, shall be measured from the H plane.
condition: Reduced geometric visibility angles are applied due to low mounting height
test_case: Measure lamp height from the H plane when applying reduced vertical visibility angles.

text: The position of the front fog lamps and front direction-indicator lamps, as regards width, shall be determined from that edge of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is the furthest from the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle when referred to the overall width, and from the inner edges of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis when referred to the distance between lamps.
quote: The position, as regards width, will be determined from that edge of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is the furthest
test_case: Measure the lateral position of the lamps from the outer edge (overall width) and inner edges (distance between lamps) of the apparent surface and check against the installation limits.

text: In the absence of specific instructions, the photometric characteristics (e.g. intensity, colour, apparent surface, etc.) of the front fog lamps and front direction-indicator lamps shall not be intentionally varied during the period when the lamp is switched ON.
quote: the photometric characteristics (e.g. intensity, colour, apparent surface, etc.) of a lamp shall not be intentionally varied during the period when the lamp is switched ON
test_case: Operate each lamp and verify that intensity, colour and apparent surface remain constant while switched ON (apart from permitted variations).

text: The direction-indicator lamps shall be flashing lamps.
quote: Direction-indicator lamps, the vehicle-hazard warning signal, amber side-marker lamps complying with paragraph 6.18.7. below, and the emergency stop signal shall be flashing lamps.
test_case: Activate the direction indicator and verify that the front direction-indicator lamps flash.

text: Where the photometric characteristics of the front fog lamps or front direction-indicator lamps vary in relation to the ambient light, as a consequence of other lamps being switched ON or OFF, or when the lamp is being used to provide another lighting function, any variation in the photometric characteristics shall be in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
quote: provided that any variation in the photometric characteristics is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned
condition: Lamp photometric characteristics vary with ambient light, other lamps or another lighting function
test_case: Check that any designed variation of lamp output stays within the device approval photometric limits.

text: If the photometric characteristics of the front direction indicator lamp of category 1, 1a or 1b are varied during a flash by sequential activation of light sources, this shall be as specified in paragraph 5.6. of UN Regulation No. 6 or paragraph 5.6.11. of UN Regulation No. [LSD].
quote: may be varied during a flash by sequential activation of light sources as specified in paragraph 5.6. of UN Regulation No. 6. or paragraph 5.6.11.
condition: Front direction indicator uses sequential activation of light sources
test_case: Verify the sequential activation pattern conforms to R6 para. 5.6 / LSD para. 5.6.11 via the device approval report.

text: For the visibility of white light towards the rear of a vehicle, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a white lamp (front fog lamp) if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 2 in a transverse plane situated 25 m behind the vehicle (see Annex 4).
quote: there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a white lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 2 in a transverse plane situated 25 m behind
test_case: Observe from Zone 2 at 25 m behind the vehicle; no direct view of the white fog lamp apparent surface shall be possible.

text: In case of doubt, the requirement of no white light visible to the rear shall be deemed fulfilled if the luminous intensity of the white light emitted to the rear by the front fog lamp, as verified during type approval of the lamps, is not more than 0.25 cd per lamp taking into account the influence of the vehicle body if applicable.
quote: is not more than 0.25 cd per lamp taking into account the influence of the vehicle body if applicable
test_case: Check from the lamp type approval data that rearward white intensity is ≤ 0.25 cd per lamp including body influence.

text: The electrical connections shall be such that the front fog lamps cannot be switched ON unless the lamps referred to in paragraph 5.11. (front and rear position lamps, end-outline marker lamps if they exist, side-marker lamps if they exist, and rear registration plate lamp) are also switched ON.
quote: the main-beam and dipped-beam headlamps and the front fog lamps cannot be switched ON unless the lamps referred to in paragraph 5.11. are also switched ON
test_case: With position lamps OFF, attempt to switch ON the front fog lamps; they shall not illuminate.

text: Where the front fog lamps substitute the function of the front position lamps, their electrical connections shall be such that in case of failure of any of these lighting devices the front position lamps are automatically switched ON again.
quote: Their electrical connections are such that in case of failure of any of these lighting devices the front position lamps are automatically switched ON again
condition: Front fog lamps substitute the front position lamp function
test_case: Simulate failure of a substituting fog lamp and verify the front position lamps switch ON automatically.

text: Where the front fog lamps substitute the function of the front position lamps, the substituting lamp/function shall meet, for the respective position lamp, the geometric visibility prescribed for the front position lamps in 6.9.5.
quote: The substituting lamp/function meets, for the respective position lamp, the requirements concerning: (a) The geometric visibility prescribed for the front position lamps in 6.9.5
condition: Front fog lamps substitute the front position lamp function
test_case: Verify the fog lamp installed meets front position lamp geometric visibility angles of paragraph 6.9.5.

text: Where the front fog lamps substitute the function of the front position lamps, the substituting lamp/function shall meet, for the respective position lamp, the minimum photometric values according to the angles of light distribution.
quote: (b) The minimum photometric values according to the angles of light distribution
condition: Front fog lamps substitute the front position lamp function
test_case: Check fog lamp photometry meets front position lamp minimum values at the light distribution angles.

text: Where the front fog lamps substitute the function of the front position lamps, appropriate evidence demonstrating compliance with the requirements indicated in paragraph 5.12.1.2. shall be provided in the test reports of the substituting lamp.
quote: Appropriate evidence demonstrating compliance with the requirements indicated in paragraph 5.12.1.2. above is provided in the test reports of the substituting lamp.
condition: Front fog lamps substitute the front position lamp function
test_case: Review the substituting lamp test reports for evidence of geometric visibility and photometric compliance.

text: The concealment of the front direction-indicator lamps shall be prohibited.
quote: The concealment of lamps shall be prohibited, with the exception of the main-beam headlamps, the dipped-beam headlamps and the front fog lamps
test_case: Inspect the installation to confirm the front direction indicators are not concealable.

text: The front fog lamps may be concealed only when they are not in use.
quote: the front fog lamps, which may be concealed when they are not in use
condition: Front fog lamps are concealable
test_case: Verify any concealment of fog lamps occurs only when they are switched OFF.

text: Where the front fog lamps are concealable, in the event of any failure affecting the operation of the concealment device(s) the lamps shall remain in the position of use, if already in use, or shall be capable of being moved into the position of use without the aid of tools.
quote: the lamps shall remain in the position of use, if already in use, or shall be capable of being moved into the position of use without the aid of tools
condition: Front fog lamps are concealable
test_case: Simulate concealment device failure and verify lamps remain in or can be moved by hand to the position of use.

text: Where the front fog lamps are concealable, it shall be possible to move the lamps into the position of use and to switch them ON by means of a single control, without excluding the possibility of moving them into the position of use without switching them ON.
quote: It shall be possible to move the lamps into the position of use and to switch them ON by means of a single control
condition: Front fog lamps are concealable
test_case: Operate the single control and verify the lamps deploy and switch ON.

text: Where the front fog lamps are concealable, it shall not be possible deliberately, from the driver's seat, to stop the movement of switched ON lamps before they reach the position of use.
quote: It shall not be possible deliberately, from the driver's seat, to stop the movement of switched ON lamps before they reach the position of use.
condition: Front fog lamps are concealable
test_case: Attempt to stop deployment from the driver's seat; it shall not be possible.

text: The colour of the light emitted by the front fog lamps shall be white or selective yellow.
quote: Front fog lamp: White or selective yellow
test_case: Measure chromaticity of the fog lamp light and verify it is within white or selective yellow limits.

text: The colour of the light emitted by the direction-indicator lamps shall be amber.
quote: Direction-indicator lamp: Amber
test_case: Measure chromaticity of the indicator light and verify it is within amber limits.

text: The number of front fog lamps and front direction-indicator lamps mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.
quote: The number of lamps mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.
test_case: Count installed fog lamps and front indicators and compare with paragraphs 6.3 and 6.5.

text: The front fog lamps or front direction-indicator lamps may be installed on movable components only provided that the conditions specified in paragraphs 5.18., 5.19. and 5.20. are fulfilled.
quote: Any lamp may be installed on movable components provided that the conditions specified in paragraphs 5.18., 5.19. and 5.20. are fulfilled.
condition: Lamps installed on a movable component
test_case: Confirm whether lamps are on movable components and, if so, check paragraphs 5.18 to 5.20.

text: When the movable components are in a position other than a "normal position of use", the front fog lamps and front direction-indicator lamps installed on them shall not cause undue discomfort to road users.
quote: When the movable components are in a position other than a "normal position of use", the devices installed on them shall not cause undue discomfort to road users.
condition: Lamps installed on a movable component
test_case: Assess lamp light in non-normal positions of the movable component for undue discomfort.

text: When a lamp is installed on a movable component and the movable component is in the "normal position(s) of use", the lamp shall always return to the position(s) specified by the manufacturer in accordance with this Regulation.
quote: the lamp shall always return to the position(s) specified by the manufacturer in accordance with this Regulation
condition: Lamps installed on a movable component
test_case: Move the component and return it to normal position; verify lamp returns to the specified position.

text: For front fog lamps installed on a movable component, when the movable components are moved and returned to the normal position 10 times, no value of the angular inclination of these lamps, relative to its support, measured after each operation, shall differ by more than 0.15 per cent from the average of the 10 measured values; otherwise each limit of paragraph 6.2.6.1.1. shall be modified by this excess.
quote: no value of the angular inclination of these lamps, relative to its support, measured after each operation of the movable component, differs by more than 0.15 per cent
condition: Front fog lamps installed on a movable component
test_case: Cycle the movable component 10 times, measure fog lamp inclination each time and verify deviation ≤ 0.15 % from the average.

text: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the front direction-indicator lamps shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position different from the "normal position of use".
quote: front and rear direction-indicator lamps and retro-reflectors shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component
test_case: Place each movable component in its fixed positions and verify ≤ 50 % of the indicator apparent surface is hidden.

text: If it is not practicable to keep the front direction-indicator lamps not more than 50 per cent hidden, additional lamps satisfying all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for the front direction-indicator lamps shall be switched ON when the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of these lamps is more than 50 per cent hidden by the movable component.
quote: Additional lamps satisfying all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for the above indicated lamps shall be switched ON
condition: Front direction indicators more than 50 % hidden by a movable component in a fixed position
test_case: With the movable component in such a position, verify additional compliant indicator lamps switch ON.

text: With the exception of retro-reflectors, a lamp (front fog lamp, front direction indicator), even bearing an approval mark, is deemed not to be present when it cannot be made to operate by the sole installation of a light source and/or a fuse; the lamps shall therefore be fully operable on the vehicle.
quote: a lamp even bearing an approval mark is deemed not to be present when it cannot be made to operate by the sole installation of a light source and/or a fuse
test_case: Verify on the vehicle that the front fog lamps and direction indicators operate with only the light source and fuse installed and no further components needed.

text: Lamps approved with light source(s) according to UN Regulation No. 37, except when such light sources are used as non-replaceable light source(s), shall be fitted in a vehicle in such a way that the light source can be correctly replaced without the need for expert assistance and without the need for special tools, other than those provided with the vehicle by the manufacturer.
quote: shall be fitted in a vehicle in such a way that the light source can be correctly replaced without the need for expert assistance and without the need for special tools
condition: Lamps use replaceable light sources approved according to UN Regulation No. 37.
test_case: Replace the light source in the installed lamp using only vehicle-supplied tools and confirm correct replacement without expert assistance.

text: For lamps approved with replaceable light source(s) according to UN Regulation No. 37, the vehicle manufacturer shall provide with the vehicle a detailed description of the procedure for replacement.
quote: The vehicle manufacturer shall provide with the vehicle a detailed description of the procedure for replacement.
condition: Lamps use replaceable light sources approved according to UN Regulation No. 37.
test_case: Check the vehicle documentation contains a detailed light source replacement procedure for the lamps.

text: In the case where a light source module includes a holder for an approved replaceable light source according to Regulation No. 37, this light source shall be replaceable as required in paragraph 5.23.
quote: In the case where a light source module includes a holder for an approved replaceable light source according to Regulation No. 37, this light source shall be replaceable
condition: A light source module in the lamps includes a holder for an R37 replaceable light source.
test_case: Verify the R37 light source in the module can be replaced per paragraph 5.23 without expert assistance or special tools.

text: For vehicles of M and N categories, it shall be demonstrated to the Technical Service that the electric power supply conditions for the lamps comply, when the electrical system of the vehicle is in a constant voltage operating condition representative for the relevant category of powered vehicle, with the provisions of paragraphs 5.27.1. and 5.27.2.
quote: the electric power supply conditions for the devices indicated in 2.5.1., 2.5.2., 2.5.4., 2.5.6. and 2.5.7. above comply, when the electrical system of the vehicle is in a constant voltage operating condition
test_case: Measure the supply voltage at the lamp terminals with the vehicle electrical system in constant voltage operating condition and compare with 5.27.1/5.27.2 limits.

text: The voltage supplied at the terminals of devices which, according to their type approval documentation, have been tested by the application of a special power supply/electronic light source control gear, or in a secondary operating mode or at a voltage requested by the applicant, shall not exceed the voltage specified for the relevant devices or functions as they have been approved.
quote: shall not exceed the voltage specified for the relevant devices or functions as they have been approved
condition: The lamps were approved with a special power supply, secondary operating mode or applicant-requested voltage and are not exempted by 5.27.3.
test_case: Measure terminal voltage on the vehicle and confirm it does not exceed the voltage stated in the lamp approval documentation.

text: In all cases of electric power supply conditions not covered by paragraph 5.27.1., the voltage at the terminals of the device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems) by more than 3 per cent.
quote: the voltage at the terminals of the device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems) by more than 3 per cent
condition: The lamps do not include electronic light source control gear, integral variable intensity control or only R128 light sources (5.27.3 exemption).
test_case: Measure lamp terminal voltage in constant voltage condition; pass if not above nominal value (e.g. 13.5 V) +3 %.

text: The provisions of paragraphs 5.27.1. and 5.27.2. shall not apply to devices which include an electronic light source control gear, or a variable intensity control being part of the device, or only light source(s) approved according to UN Regulation No. 128.
quote: shall not apply to devices which include: - an electronic light source control gear, or - a variable intensity control being part of the device
condition: Presence of electronic light source control gear, integral variable intensity control, or only R128 light sources in the lamps.
test_case: Review the lamp design/approval documents to determine whether the 5.27.3 exemption applies.

text: There shall be no obstacle on the inside of the angles of geometric visibility to the propagation of light from any part of the apparent surface of the front fog lamps and front direction indicators observed from infinity, except obstacles already presented when the lamp was type-approved.
quote: There shall be no obstacle on the inside of the angles of geometric visibility to the propagation of light from any part of the apparent surface of the lamp observed from infinity.
test_case: Check on the installed bumper (fascia, bezels, grille) that no part obstructs light from the apparent surface within the required geometric visibility angles.

text: If measurements of geometric visibility are taken closer to the lamp, the direction of observation shall be shifted parallel to achieve the same accuracy.
quote: If measurements are taken closer to the lamp, the direction of observation shall be shifted parallel to achieve the same accuracy.
test_case: Confirm the geometric visibility measurement procedure uses parallel-shifted observation directions when measured near the lamp.

text: If, when the lamp is installed, any part of the apparent surface of the lamp is hidden by any further parts of the vehicle, proof shall be furnished that the part of the lamp not hidden by obstacles still conforms to the photometric values prescribed for the approval of the device.
quote: proof shall be furnished that the part of the lamp not hidden by obstacles still conforms to the photometric values prescribed for the approval of the device
condition: Part of the apparent surface of the fog lamps or direction indicators is hidden by bumper parts (bezel, fascia).
test_case: Photometrically measure the lamp with the obstructing bumper parts in place and verify the device photometric values are met.

text: The photometric field of measurements of the installed optical unit may be reduced to 5° below the horizontal only when the vertical angle of geometric visibility below the horizontal may be reduced to 5° (lamp at less than 750 mm above the ground measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.).
quote: the photometric field of measurements of the installed optical unit may be reduced to 5º below the horizontal
condition: Lamp mounting height below 750 mm above ground (height unknown).
test_case: Measure lamp height per 5.8.1; if below 750 mm, verify photometry down to 5° below horizontal is met.

text: In the case of an interdependent lamp system, the geometric visibility requirements shall be fulfilled when all its interdependent lamps are operated together.
quote: In the case of an interdependent lamp system the geometric visibility requirements shall be fulfilled when all its interdependent lamps are operated together.
condition: The front direction indicator or fog lamp is an interdependent lamp system.
test_case: Operate all interdependent lamps together and verify geometric visibility angles are met.

text: A LED module of the front fog lamps or front direction indicators may be non-replaceable only if so stated in the communication sheet of the component type approval.
quote: A LED module does not need to be replaceable, if so stated in the communication sheet of the component type approval.
condition: Lamps use non-replaceable LED modules.
test_case: Check the lamp component approval communication sheet states the LED module is non-replaceable.

text: All lamps (front fog lamps and front direction indicators) shall, where applicable, be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulations as specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6 of this Regulation when installed on a vehicle.
quote: All lamps (devices) shall, where applicable, be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulations as specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6
test_case: Verify the fog lamps and direction indicators carry valid approval marks under the device regulations referenced in paragraph 6 (e.g. R148/R149).

text: In case of light-signalling lamps incorporating a manufacturer logo, the lamp shall be type approved according to the requirements of the UN Regulation No. 148.
quote: in case of light-signalling lamps incorporating a manufacturer logo, the lamp shall be type approved according to the requirements of the UN Regulation No. 148
condition: The front direction indicator lamp incorporates a manufacturer logo.
test_case: Check the logo-bearing direction indicator has an R148 approval covering the logo.

text: Lamps approved for one or more replaceable light source categories according to Regulations Nos. 37, 99 or 128 shall be fitted with light sources approved according to these light source categories only; this does not concern light source modules, LED modules and non-replaceable light sources, except when they are required to be approved by the applicable Regulation.
quote: shall be fitted with light sources approved according to these light source categories only
condition: The lamps use replaceable light sources of R37/R99/R128 categories.
test_case: Inspect installed light sources and confirm they carry approval for the categories stated in the lamp approval.

text: The use of lamps approved for and equipped with LED substitute light source(s) is allowed exclusively in the case where the statement indicated in paragraph 3.2.8. is present and positive, and the presence of the marking on the lamps related to the use of LED substitute light source(s) shall be checked.
quote: The use of lamps approved for and equipped with LED substitute light source(s), is allowed exclusively in the case where the statement indicated in paragraph 3.2.8. is present and positive.
condition: The lamps are equipped with LED substitute light sources.
test_case: Check the positive 3.2.8 statement and the LED substitute marking on the lamps.

text: The number of front fog lamps installed on the vehicle shall be two.
quote: Number Two Class “F3” and type-approved according to the 03 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 19
test_case: Count the front fog lamps installed on the vehicle; pass if exactly two are fitted.

text: The front fog lamps shall be of Class "F3" and type-approved according to the 03 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 19, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 149.
quote: Class “F3” and type-approved according to the 03 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 19, or to the 00 or subsequent series
test_case: Check the approval marking and communication form of each fog lamp; pass if Class F3 approved under R19 03+ or R149 00+.

text: In width, that point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the front fog lamp which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
quote: which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle
test_case: Measure the lateral distance from the outermost point of the fog lamp apparent surface to the vehicle outer edge; pass if ≤ 400 mm.

text: In height, the front fog lamp shall be not less than 250 mm above the ground.
quote: In height: Minimum: Not less than 250 mm above the ground.
test_case: Measure the height of the lowest point of the fog lamp apparent surface above ground on the unladen vehicle; pass if ≥ 250 mm.

text: For M1 category vehicles, the front fog lamp shall be not more than 800 mm above the ground.
quote: Maximum: For M1 and N1 category vehicles: not more than 800 mm above the ground.
test_case: Measure the height of the highest point of the fog lamp apparent surface above ground; pass if ≤ 800 mm.

text: No point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the front fog lamp shall be higher than the highest point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the dipped-beam headlamp.
quote: No point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis shall be higher than the highest point on the apparent surface
test_case: Compare the highest points of the fog lamp and dipped-beam headlamp apparent surfaces; pass if the fog lamp is not higher.

text: In length, the front fog lamps shall be at the front of the vehicle; this requirement shall be deemed to be satisfied if the light emitted does not cause discomfort to the driver either directly, or indirectly through the devices for indirect vision and/or other reflecting surfaces of the vehicle.
quote: In length: at the front of the vehicle. This requirement shall be deemed to be satisfied if the light emitted does not cause discomfort to the driver
test_case: Inspect installation position and assess from the driver's seat with lamps on; pass if lamps are at the front and cause no direct or indirect discomfort.

text: The geometric visibility of the front fog lamp shall be defined by angles α = 5° upwards and downwards and β = 45° outwards and 10° inwards, as specified in paragraph 2.10.7.
quote: Defined by angles α and ß as specified in paragraph 2.10.7.: α = 5° upwards and downwards, ß = 45° outwards and 10° inwards.
test_case: Verify on vehicle/CAD that the apparent surface is unobstructed within α ±5° and β 45° out / 10° in; pass if visible throughout.

text: The presence of partitions or other items of equipment near the front fog lamp shall not give rise to secondary effects causing discomfort to other road users.
quote: The presence of partitions or other items of equipment near the front fog lamp shall not give rise to secondary effects causing discomfort
test_case: Inspect bezels and surrounding fascia parts with the lamp lit; pass if no stray reflections or glare to other road users.

text: The orientation of the front fog lamps shall be toward the front.
quote: Orientation Toward the front.
test_case: Inspect the lamp reference axis direction; pass if directed toward the front.

text: When the total objective luminous flux of the light source for each front fog lamp does not exceed 2,000 lumens, the vertical inclination of the cut-off to be set in the unladen vehicle state with one person in the driver's seat shall be -1.0 per cent or lower.
quote: The vertical inclination of the cut-off to be set in the unladen vehicle state with one person in the driver´s seat shall be – 1.0 per cent or lower.
condition: Total objective luminous flux of the fog lamp light source does not exceed 2,000 lm (not stated).
test_case: Measure cut-off inclination on unladen vehicle with driver; pass if ≤ -1.0 %.

text: When the total objective luminous flux of the light source for each front fog lamp exceeds 2,000 lumens and the mounting height h of the lower edge of the apparent surface is ≤ 0.8 m, the vertical inclination of the cut-off shall under all the static conditions of Annex 5 automatically remain between -1.0 per cent and -3.0 per cent, with initial aiming between -1.5 per cent and -2.0 per cent.
quote: h ≤ 0.8 Limits: between -1.0 per cent and -3.0 per cent Initial aiming: between -1.5 per cent and -2.0 per cent
condition: Total objective luminous flux of the fog lamp light source exceeds 2,000 lm (not stated).
test_case: Measure cut-off inclination under all Annex 5 static load conditions; pass if within -1.0 % to -3.0 % and initial aim within -1.5 % to -2.0 %.

text: When the total objective luminous flux of the light source for each front fog lamp exceeds 2,000 lumens, the initial downward inclination of the cut-off to be set in the unladen vehicle state with one person in the driver's seat shall be specified within an accuracy of one decimal place by the manufacturer and indicated in a clearly legible and indelible manner on each vehicle close to either the front fog lamp or the manufacturer's plate or in combination with the indication referred to in paragraph 6.2.6.1.1. by the symbol shown in Annex 7.
quote: shall be specified within an accuracy of one decimal place by the manufacturer and indicated in a clearly legible and indelible manner on each vehicle close to either the front fog lamp
condition: Total objective luminous flux of the fog lamp light source exceeds 2,000 lm (not stated).
test_case: Inspect the vehicle for the Annex 7 symbol with the inclination value to one decimal near the fog lamp or manufacturer's plate; pass if present, legible and indelible.

text: When the total objective luminous flux of the light source for each front fog lamp exceeds 2,000 lumens, the value of the indicated initial downward inclination shall be defined in accordance with paragraph 6.3.6.1.2.1.
quote: The value of this indicated downward inclination shall be defined in accordance with paragraph 6.3.6.1.2.1.
condition: Total objective luminous flux of the fog lamp light source exceeds 2,000 lm (not stated).
test_case: Compare the marked inclination value with the initial aiming range of 6.3.6.1.2.1; pass if within range.

text: When the total objective luminous flux of the light source for each front fog lamp exceeds 2,000 lumens and the mounting height h of the lower edge of the apparent surface is > 0.8 m, the vertical inclination of the cut-off shall under all the static conditions of Annex 5 automatically remain between -1.5 per cent and -3.5 per cent, with initial aiming between -2.0 per cent and -2.5 per cent.
quote: h > 0.8 Limits: between -1.5 per cent and -3.5 per cent Initial aiming: between -2.0 per cent and -2.5 per cent.
condition: Total objective luminous flux exceeds 2,000 lm and mounting height of lower edge exceeds 0.8 m (not stated).
test_case: Measure cut-off inclination under all Annex 5 static load conditions; pass if within -1.5 % to -3.5 % and initial aim within -2.0 % to -2.5 %.

text: Where a levelling device is fitted for a front fog lamp, independent or grouped with other front lighting and light signalling functions, it shall be such that the vertical inclination, under all the static loading conditions of Annex 5, shall remain between the limits prescribed in paragraph 6.3.6.1.2.1.
quote: Where a levelling device is fitted for a front fog lamp, independent or grouped with other front lighting and light signalling functions, it shall be such
condition: A levelling device is fitted for the front fog lamps (not stated).
test_case: Measure cut-off inclination under all Annex 5 static loads with the levelling device active; pass if within 6.3.6.1.2.1 limits.

text: In the case where the front fog lamp is part of the dipped-beam headlamp or is part of an AFS system, the requirements of paragraph 6.2.6. shall be applied during the use of the front fog beam as part of the dipped beam.
quote: In the case where the front fog lamp is part of the dipped-beam headlamp or is part of an AFS system, the requirements of paragraph 6.2.6. shall be applied
condition: Front fog lamp is part of the dipped-beam headlamp or an AFS system (not stated).
test_case: Verify dipped-beam levelling compliance (6.2.6) while the fog beam is used as part of the dipped beam.

text: The levelling device may be used to automatically adapt the inclination of the front fog beam in relation to the prevailing ambient conditions only provided that the limits for the downward inclination specified in paragraph 6.3.6.1.2.1. are not exceeded.
quote: provided that the limits for the downward inclination specified in paragraph 6.3.6.1.2.1. are not exceeded
condition: Levelling device fitted and used for automatic adaptation to ambient conditions (not stated).
test_case: Operate the adaptive levelling across ambient conditions; pass if inclination stays within 6.3.6.1.2.1 limits.

text: In the case of a failure of the levelling device, the front fog beam shall not assume a position in which the cut-off is less inclined than it was at the time when the failure of the device occurred.
quote: the front fog beam shall not assume a position in which the cut off is less inclined than it was at the time when the failure
condition: A levelling device is fitted for the front fog lamps (not stated).
test_case: Simulate levelling device failure; pass if the cut-off does not become less inclined than at failure.

text: It shall be possible to switch the front fog lamps ON and OFF independently of the main-beam headlamps, the dipped-beam headlamps or any combination of main- and dipped-beam headlamps, unless the front fog lamps are used as part of another lighting function in an AFS or cannot be simultaneously lit with any other lamps with which they are reciprocally incorporated.
quote: It shall be possible to switch the front fog lamps ON and OFF independently of the main-beam headlamps, the dipped-beam headlamps
test_case: Operate the switches in all headlamp combinations; pass if fog lamps can be switched ON and OFF independently.

text: Where the front fog lamps are used as part of another lighting function in an AFS, the switching ON of the front fog lamps function shall have the priority over the function for which the front fog lamps are used as a part.
quote: the switching ON of the front fog lamps function shall have the priority over the function for which the front fog lamps are used as a part
condition: Front fog lamps are used as part of an AFS lighting function (not stated).
test_case: Activate the AFS function and then the fog lamp switch; pass if the fog lamp function takes priority.

text: A closed-circuit tell-tale shall be mandatory for the front fog lamps.
quote: Tell-tale Closed-circuit tell-tale mandatory.
test_case: Switch fog lamps ON; pass if a closed-circuit tell-tale illuminates in the driver's view.

text: Where the luminous intensity of the front fog beam is indicated as variable in the communication form, any variations of the luminous intensities or alignment shall be performed automatically and in such a way that no discomfort, neither for the driver nor to other road users, is caused.
quote: Any variations of the luminous intensities or alignment shall be performed automatically and in such a way that no discomfort, neither for the driver nor to other road users
condition: Front fog lamp has variable luminous intensity/alignment (not stated).
test_case: Observe intensity/alignment variation under changing ambient conditions; pass if automatic and causes no discomfort.

text: Arrangement "A" of direction-indicator lamps shall apply to all motor vehicles.
quote: Arrangement "A" shall apply to all motor vehicles.
test_case: Check the categories and positions of all direction indicators on the vehicle; pass if they constitute arrangement A.

text: Direction-indicator lamps shall be mandatory on the vehicle.
quote: Presence (see figure below) Mandatory.
test_case: Inspect the vehicle; pass if direction-indicator lamps are fitted.

text: The direction-indicator lamps shall be type-approved according to the 01 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 6, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
quote: The devices shall be type-approved according to the 01 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 6, or to the 00
test_case: Check approval markings of the front direction indicators; pass if approved under R6 01+ or R148 00+.

text: The number of direction-indicator lamps shall be according to the arrangement.
quote: Number According to the arrangement.
test_case: Count direction indicators per category; pass if consistent with arrangement A.

text: The two front direction-indicator lamps shall be of category 1 or 1a or 1b if the distance between the edge of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of this lamp and that of the dipped-beam headlamp and/or the front fog lamp, if there is one, is at least 40 mm.
quote: 1 or 1a or 1b, If the distance between the edge of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of this lamp
condition: Distance between front direction indicator and front fog lamp / dipped-beam headlamp apparent surfaces is at least 40 mm
test_case: Measure the distance between apparent surface edges in the reference-axis direction; verify the approved indicator category is 1, 1a or 1b when distance ≥ 40 mm.
merged: The two front direction-indicator lamps shall be of category 1a or 1b if the distance between the edge of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of this lamp and that of the dipped-beam headlamp and/or the front fog lamp, if there is one, is greater than 20 mm and less than 40 mm.

The two front direction-indicator lamps shall be of category 1b if the distance between the edge of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of this lamp and that of the dipped-beam headlamp and/or the front fog lamp, if there is one, is less than or equal to 20 mm.

text: Where an AFS is fitted, the distance to be considered for the choice of the front direction-indicator category shall be the distance between the front direction-indicator lamp and the closest lighting unit in its closest position contributing to or performing a passing-beam mode.
quote: Where an AFS is fitted, the distance to be considered for the choice of the category is the distance between the front direction-indicator lamp
condition: Vehicle is fitted with an AFS
test_case: Measure distance to the closest AFS passing-beam lighting unit in its closest position and verify the indicator category accordingly.

text: In width, the edge of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the front direction-indicator lamp farthest from the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
quote: the edge of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis farthest from the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle shall not be more than 400 mm
test_case: Measure on the vehicle the lateral distance from the outer apparent-surface edge to the extreme outer edge; pass if ≤ 400 mm.

text: The distance between the inner edges of the two apparent surfaces of the front direction-indicator lamps in the direction of the reference axes shall not be less than 600 mm, which may be reduced to 400 mm where the overall width of the vehicle is less than 1,300 mm.
quote: The distance between the inner edges of the two apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axes shall not be less than 600 mm.
test_case: Measure the distance between the inner apparent-surface edges; pass if ≥ 600 mm (≥ 400 mm if vehicle width < 1,300 mm).

text: The height above the ground of the front direction-indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a, 1b, measured in accordance with paragraph 5.8., shall not be less than 350 mm and not more than 1,500 mm.
quote: The height of the direction-indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a and 2b, measured in accordance with paragraph 5.8., shall not be less than 350 mm
test_case: Measure mounting height per paragraph 5.8. on the unladen vehicle; pass if 350 mm ≤ height ≤ 1,500 mm.

text: If the structure of the vehicle does not permit the upper height limit to be respected, the upper limit for the front direction-indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a, 1b may be increased to 2,100 mm only.
quote: they may be increased to 2,300 mm for side direction-indicator lamps of categories 5 and 6, and to 2,100 mm for the direction-indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a, 1b
condition: Vehicle structure does not permit the 1,500 mm upper limit
test_case: Verify justification of structural constraint and that height does not exceed 2,100 mm.

text: The front direction-indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a, 1b shall meet the horizontal angles of geometric visibility given in the figure of paragraph 6.5.
quote: Horizontal angles: (see figure below) Vertical angles: 15° above and below the horizontal for direction indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a, 1b
test_case: Check geometric visibility of the apparent surface on the vehicle over the horizontal angles of the figure in paragraph 6.5.

text: The front direction-indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a, 1b shall have vertical angles of geometric visibility of 15° above and below the horizontal, except that where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1) the downward angle may be reduced to 5°.
quote: Vertical angles: 15° above and below the horizontal for direction indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a, 2b and 5.
test_case: Check unobstructed visibility at 15° up and 15° down (5° down if mounted below 750 mm).

text: For the front direction indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a, 1b mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane only.
quote: mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane
condition: Front direction indicators mounted below 750 mm
test_case: Verify mounting height < 750 mm and inward visibility of at least 20° under the H plane and 45° otherwise.

text: To be considered visible, the front direction indicator lamp shall provide an unobstructed view of the apparent surface of at least 12.5 square centimetres, the illuminating surface area of any retro-reflector that does not transmit light being excluded.
quote: To be considered visible, the lamp shall provide an unobstructed view of the apparent surface of at least 12.5 square centimetres
test_case: Determine the unobstructed projected apparent surface at the boundary angles; pass if ≥ 12.5 cm² excluding non-transmitting retro-reflector areas.

text: At the discretion of the manufacturer, for M1 vehicles, the front direction indicator lamps shall meet the alternative horizontal angles of the figure in paragraph 6.5.5.2, with the inward angle of 45° reducible to 20° under the H plane for lamps mounted below 750 mm.
quote: Or, at the discretion of the manufacturer, for M1 and N1 category vehicles: Front and rear direction indicator lamps, as well as side-marker lamps
condition: Manufacturer chooses the alternative arrangement of paragraph 6.5.5.2
test_case: Check geometric visibility against the alternative figure of paragraph 6.5.5.2.

text: Under the alternative arrangement, the front direction indicator lamps shall have vertical angles of 15° above and below the horizontal, the downward angle being reducible to 5° where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm.
quote: Vertical angles: 15° above and below the horizontal. However, where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1)
condition: Manufacturer chooses the alternative arrangement of paragraph 6.5.5.2
test_case: Check vertical visibility 15° up/down (5° down if below 750 mm).

text: The orientation of the front direction-indicator lamps shall be according to the specifications for installation by the manufacturer, if any.
quote: Orientation According to the specifications for installation by the manufacturer, if any.
test_case: Compare installed orientation with the manufacturer's installation specification.

text: The direction-indicator lamps shall switch ON independently of the other lamps.
quote: Direction-indicator lamps shall switch ON independently of the other lamps.
test_case: Operate the indicator control with all other lamps off/on and verify independent switching.

text: All direction-indicator lamps on one side of a vehicle shall be switched ON and OFF automatically as defined by applicable UN Regulations and/or by means of one control and shall flash in phase.
quote: All direction-indicator lamps on one side of a vehicle shall be switched ON and OFF automatically as defined by applicable UN Regulations
test_case: Activate the indicator on each side and verify all indicators on that side switch by one control and flash in phase.

text: A direction indicator capable of being activated in different modes (static or sequential) shall not switch between both modes once activated.
quote: A direction indicator capable of being activated in different modes (static or sequential), shall not switch between both modes once activated.
condition: Front direction indicator capable of static and sequential modes
test_case: Activate the indicator and verify the mode does not change during the activation.

text: On M1 vehicles less than 6 m in length, with an arrangement complying with paragraph 6.5.5.2., the amber side-marker lamps, when mounted, shall also flash at the same frequency (in phase) with the direction-indicator lamps.
quote: the amber side-marker lamps, when mounted, shall also flash at the same frequency (in phase) with the direction-indicator lamps
condition: Arrangement per 6.5.5.2 chosen and amber side-marker lamps are mounted
test_case: Activate indicators and verify side-marker lamps flash in phase at the same frequency.
