merged: On M1 vehicles less than 6 m in length, with an arrangement complying with paragraph 6.5.5.2., the amber side-marker lamps, when mounted, shall also flash at the same frequency (in phase) with the direction-indicator lamps when the hazard warning signal operates.

text: An operating tell-tale shall be mandatory for the front direction-indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a, 1b; it may be visual or auditory or both.
quote: Operating tell-tale mandatory for direction-indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a and 2b.
test_case: Verify presence of an operating tell-tale for the direction indicators on the vehicle.

text: If the direction-indicator tell-tale is visual, it shall be a flashing light which, at least in the event of the malfunction of any of these direction-indicator lamps, is either extinguished, or remains alight without flashing, or shows a marked change of frequency.
quote: If it is visual it shall be a flashing light which, at least in the event of the malfunction of any of these direction-indicator lamps
condition: Tell-tale is visual
test_case: Disconnect one front indicator and verify the visual tell-tale extinguishes, stays lit steady or markedly changes frequency.

text: If the direction-indicator tell-tale is entirely auditory, it shall be clearly audible and shall show a marked change of frequency, at least in the event of the malfunction of any of these direction-indicator lamps.
quote: If it is entirely auditory it shall be clearly audible and shall show a marked change of frequency
condition: Tell-tale is entirely auditory
test_case: Disconnect one indicator and verify the audible signal markedly changes frequency.

text: The direction-indicator tell-tale shall be activated by the signal produced according to paragraph 6.2.2. of UN Regulation No. 6, or paragraph 5.6.3. of the 00 series or paragraph 4.6.1.4. of the 01 series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148, or another suitable way.
quote: It shall be activated by the signal produced according to: - paragraph 6.2.2. of UN Regulation No. 6, or
test_case: Verify the front indicator lamp provides the failure signal per R6 6.2.2 / R148 and the tell-tale responds to it.

text: The light of the direction-indicator lamps shall be a flashing light flashing 90 ± 30 times per minute.
quote: The light shall be a flashing light flashing 90 ± 30 times per minute.
test_case: Measure flash frequency; pass if between 60 and 120 flashes per minute.

text: Operation of the light-signal control shall be followed within not more than one second by the emission of light and within not more than one and one-half seconds by its first extinction.
quote: Operation of the light-signal control shall be followed within not more than one second by the emission of light
test_case: Measure time from control operation to first light ≤ 1 s and to first extinction ≤ 1.5 s.

text: In the event of failure, other than short-circuit, of one direction-indicator lamp, the others shall continue to flash, but the frequency in this condition may be different from that prescribed.
quote: In the event of failure, other than short-circuit, of one direction-indicator lamp, the others shall continue to flash
test_case: Open-circuit one front indicator and verify remaining indicators continue flashing.

text: The hazard warning signal shall be given by simultaneous operation of the direction-indicator lamps in accordance with the requirements of paragraph 6.5.
quote: The signal shall be given by simultaneous operation of the direction-indicator lamps in accordance with the requirements of paragraph 6.5. above.
test_case: Activate hazard warning and verify all direction indicators including front ones operate simultaneously.

text: All direction indicators of the category 1 (1, 1a, 1b) activated simultaneously for the hazard warning signal shall operate in the same mode; i.e. static or sequential.
quote: All direction indicators of the category 1 (1, 1a, 1b) activated simultaneously shall operate in the same mode; i.e. static or sequential.
test_case: Activate hazard warning and verify both front indicators operate in the same mode.

text: The position in width of the direction-indicator lamps used for the hazard warning signal shall be as specified in paragraph 6.5.4.1.
quote: Width: As specified in paragraph 6.5.4.1.
test_case: Verify width position per 6.5.4.1 measurements.
merged: The position in height of the direction-indicator lamps used for the hazard warning signal shall be as specified in paragraph 6.5.4.2.
The orientation of the direction-indicator lamps used for the hazard warning signal shall be as specified in paragraph 6.5.6.

text: The geometric visibility of the direction-indicator lamps used for the hazard warning signal shall be as specified in paragraph 6.5.5.
quote: Geometric visibility As specified in paragraph 6.5.5.
test_case: Verify geometric visibility per 6.5.5.

text: The hazard warning signal shall be operated by means of a separate manual control enabling all the direction-indicator lamps to flash in phase.
quote: The signal shall be operated by means of a separate manual control enabling all the direction-indicator lamps to flash in phase.
test_case: Operate the separate hazard control and verify all indicators flash in phase.

text: When the hazard warning signal is switched ON automatically to indicate to other road-users the risk of imminent danger, the signal shall remain switched ON until it is manually or automatically switched OFF.
quote: in this case, the signal shall remain switched ON until it is manually or automatically switched OFF
condition: Vehicle has automatic hazard warning activation for imminent danger
test_case: Trigger automatic activation and verify the signal remains on until switched off.

text: A flashing closed-circuit tell-tale shall be mandatory for the hazard warning signal.
quote: Tell-tale Flashing closed-circuit tell-tale mandatory.
test_case: Activate hazard warning and verify a flashing closed-circuit tell-tale operates.

text: The hazard warning signal shall meet the requirements of paragraph 6.5.9 (flashing 90 ± 30 times per minute, timing of first emission and extinction, continued flashing on failure).
quote: Other requirements As specified in paragraph 6.5.9.
test_case: Measure hazard flash frequency and timing per 6.5.9.

text: The hazard warning signal shall be able to function even if the device which starts or stops the propulsion system is in a position which makes it impossible to start the propulsion system.
quote: The hazard warning signal shall be able to function even if the device which starts or stops the propulsion system is in a position
test_case: With ignition/propulsion off, activate hazard warning and verify front indicators flash.

text: If the bumper incorporates front position lamps, there shall be two front position lamps, type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
quote: Two, type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series
condition: Front position lamps are integrated in the bumper assembly (presence not stated).
test_case: Check that two front position lamps are fitted and that each bears a UN R7 (02+) or UN R148 (00+) approval mark.

text: For front position lamps, that point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
quote: that point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm
condition: Front position lamps are integrated in the bumper assembly (presence not stated).
test_case: Measure the lateral distance from the outermost point of the apparent surface to the vehicle's extreme outer edge; pass if it is at most 400 mm.

text: The front position lamps shall be positioned above the ground not less than 250 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm).
quote: In height: above the ground, not less than 250 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm for O1 and O2 categories of vehicles
condition: Front position lamps are integrated in the bumper assembly (presence not stated).
test_case: Measure the apparent surface height above ground per paragraph 5.8.1.; pass if it is between 250 mm and 1,500 mm, or up to 2,100 mm where justified by the bodywork.

text: Where the front position lamp and another lamp are reciprocally incorporated, the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the other lamp shall be used to verify compliance with the positioning requirements (paragraphs 6.9.4.1. to 6.9.4.3.).
quote: Where the front position lamp and another lamp are reciprocally incorporated, the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the other lamp shall be used
condition: A front position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with another lamp (e.g. the direction indicator) in the bumper.
test_case: Verify the position measurements using the apparent surface of the other incorporated lamp; pass if paragraphs 6.9.4.1. to 6.9.4.3. are met.

text: The front position lamps shall have a horizontal angle of geometric visibility of 45° inwards and 80° outwards; where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the inward angle may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
quote: Horizontal angle: 45° inwards and 80° outwards. However, where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm
condition: Front position lamps are integrated in the bumper assembly (presence not stated).
test_case: Check the geometric visibility of the apparent surface over 45° inwards and 80° outwards (20° inwards under the H plane if mounted below 750 mm); pass if unobstructed.

text: The front position lamps shall have a vertical angle of geometric visibility of 15° above and below the horizontal; where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle may be reduced to 5°.
quote: Vertical angle: 15° above and below the horizontal. However, where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm
condition: Front position lamps are integrated in the bumper assembly (presence not stated).
test_case: Check the visibility over 15° up and 15° down (5° down if mounted below 750 mm); pass if unobstructed.

text: For M1 vehicles, the alternative geometric visibility of front position lamps (horizontal 45° outwards to 45° inwards, 20° inwards under the H plane if mounted below 750 mm; vertical 15° above and below, 5° downward if mounted below 750 mm) may be applied only if a front side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle.
quote: as an alternative to paragraph 6.9.5.1. above, at the discretion of the manufacturer or his duly accredited representative, and only if a front side-marker lamp is installed
condition: Front position lamps are integrated and the alternative visibility angles are used with a front side-marker lamp installed.
test_case: Confirm that a front side-marker lamp is installed and check visibility over the alternative angles.

text: When the alternative geometric visibility is applied, to be considered visible the front position lamp shall provide an unobstructed view of the apparent surface of at least 12.5 cm2, excluding the illuminating surface area of any retro-reflector that does not transmit light.
quote: To be considered visible, the lamp shall provide an unobstructed view of the apparent surface of at least 12.5 cm2.
condition: Front position lamps are integrated and the alternative visibility of 6.9.5.2 is used.
test_case: Measure the unobstructed apparent surface area at the boundary angles, excluding non-light-transmitting retro-reflector area; pass if at least 12.5 cm2.

text: The front position lamps shall be oriented forwards.
quote: Orientation Forwards.
condition: Front position lamps are integrated in the bumper assembly (presence not stated).
test_case: Inspect the lamp installation; pass if the reference axis points forwards.

text: If a front position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with a direction-indicator, the front position lamp on the relevant side of the vehicle, or the reciprocally incorporated part of it, may be switched OFF only during the entire time (both ON and OFF cycle) of operation of the direction-indicator lamp.
quote: if a front position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with a direction-indicator the electrical connection of the front position lamp on the relevant side
condition: A front position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with the front direction indicator in the bumper corner lamps.
test_case: Operate the direction indicator; pass if the position lamp on that side is switched OFF only while the indicator operates, or stays ON.

text: The electrical connections of the front position lamps shall be in accordance with paragraph 5.11.
quote: Electrical connections In accordance with paragraph 5.11.
condition: Front position lamps are integrated in the bumper assembly (presence not stated).
test_case: Check the switching logic against paragraph 5.11.; pass if compliant.

text: A closed-circuit tell-tale for the front position lamps shall be provided; this tell-tale shall be non-flashing, and it is not required if the instrument panel lighting can only switch ON simultaneously with the front position lamps.
quote: Closed-circuit tell-tale mandatory. This tell-tale shall be non-flashing and shall not be required if the instrument panel lighting can only switch ON
condition: Front position lamps are integrated in the bumper assembly (presence not stated).
test_case: Switch the front position lamps ON; pass if a steady (non-flashing) tell-tale lights, unless the panel lighting switches only with the lamps.

text: A tell-tale indicating failure of the front position lamps shall be provided if required by the component regulation.
quote: However, a tell-tale indicating failure is mandatory if required by the component regulation.
condition: Front position lamps are integrated and the component regulation requires a failure tell-tale.
test_case: Simulate a lamp failure; pass if the failure tell-tale activates where the component regulation requires it.

text: If one or more infrared radiation generators are installed inside the front position lamp, they shall be switched ON only when the headlamp on the same side of the vehicle is switched ON and the vehicle is in forward motion.
quote: it (they) is (are) allowed to be switched ON only when the headlamp on the same side of the vehicle is switched ON and the vehicle is in forward motion
condition: Front position lamps with infrared radiation generators are integrated in the bumper.
test_case: Check the IR generator activation logic; pass if it is active only with the same-side headlamp ON and the vehicle in forward motion.

text: In the event that the front position lamp or the headlamp on the same side fails, the infrared radiation generator(s) installed inside the front position lamp shall be automatically switched OFF.
quote: In the event that the front position lamp or the headlamp on the same side fails, the infrared radiation generator(s) shall be automatically switched OFF.
condition: Front position lamps with infrared radiation generators are integrated in the bumper.
test_case: Simulate failure of the position lamp or headlamp; pass if the IR generator switches OFF automatically.

text: The electrical connections shall be such that the rear fog-lamp(s) cannot be switched ON unless the main beams, dipped-beams or front fog-lamps are switched ON.
quote: The rear fog-lamp(s) cannot be switched ON unless the main beams, dipped-beams or front fog-lamps are switched ON;
condition: The vehicle wiring/switching logic for the front fog lamps interacts with the rear fog lamp circuit.
test_case: With main beam, dipped beam and front fog lamps OFF, attempt to switch ON the rear fog lamp and verify it does not illuminate.

text: Front retro-reflectors (non-triangular) shall be fitted on motor vehicles having all forward facing lamps with reflectors concealable.
quote: Mandatory on motor vehicles having all forward facing lamps with reflectors concealable.
condition: The target vehicle has all forward facing lamps with concealable reflectors.
test_case: Review the vehicle front lighting configuration; if all forward facing lamps are concealable, verify front retro-reflectors are present.

text: If front retro-reflectors (non-triangular) are fitted in the bumper, there shall be two, type-approved according to the requirements concerning Class IA or IB retro-reflectors in the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 3, or in the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 150.
quote: Two, type-approved according to the requirements concerning Class IA or IB retro-reflectors in the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 3
condition: Front retro-reflectors are integrated in the bumper (presence not stated in specification).
test_case: Check that two front retro-reflectors are fitted and that each carries a valid R3 or R150 Class IA/IB approval mark.

text: Additional front retro-reflecting devices and materials (including two retro-reflectors not complying with paragraph 6.16.4.) are permitted only provided they do not impair the effectiveness of the mandatory lighting and light-signalling devices.
quote: Additional retro-reflecting devices and materials (including two retro-reflectors not complying with paragraph 6.16.4. below), are permitted provided they do not impair the effectiveness
condition: Additional front retro-reflecting devices or materials are fitted on the bumper.
test_case: Inspect the installation to confirm the additional retro-reflecting devices do not obscure or impair the mandatory front lamps.

text: If the bumper incorporates front retro-reflectors, the point on the illuminating surface which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
quote: that point on the illuminating surface which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge
condition: Bumper incorporates front retro-reflectors (presence unknown)
test_case: Measure the lateral distance from the outermost illuminating-surface point to the vehicle's extreme outer edge; pass if ≤ 400 mm.

text: If the bumper incorporates front retro-reflectors, for M1 category vehicles the distance between the inner edges of the two apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axes has no special requirement.
quote: The distance between the inner edges of the two apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axes shall: For M1 and N1 category vehicles: have no special requirement
condition: Bumper incorporates front retro-reflectors (presence unknown)
test_case: Confirm the vehicle is M1; no inner-edge spacing limit is checked.

text: If the bumper incorporates front retro-reflectors, the front retro-reflectors shall be above the ground not less than 250 mm nor more than 900 mm (1,500 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 900 mm).
quote: In height: above the ground, not less than 250 mm nor more than 900 mm (1,500 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible
condition: Bumper incorporates front retro-reflectors (presence unknown)
test_case: Measure mounting height of the illuminating surface at unladen vehicle; pass if within 250–900 mm (or ≤1,500 mm where justified by bodywork).

text: If the bumper incorporates front retro-reflectors, the front retro-reflectors shall be positioned in length at the front of the vehicle.
quote: In length: at the front of the vehicle.
condition: Bumper incorporates front retro-reflectors (presence unknown)
test_case: Inspect installation; pass if the retro-reflectors are located at the front of the vehicle.

text: If the bumper incorporates front retro-reflectors, the geometric visibility horizontal angle of the front retro-reflectors shall be 30° inwards and outwards.
quote: Geometric visibility Horizontal angle: 30° inwards and outwards.
condition: Bumper incorporates front retro-reflectors (presence unknown)
test_case: Check unobstructed visibility of the illuminating surface over 30° inwards and outwards; pass if no obstruction.

text: If the bumper incorporates front retro-reflectors, the geometric visibility vertical angle of the front retro-reflectors shall be 10° above and below the horizontal, except that where a retro-reflector is mounted below 750 mm the downward angle may be reduced to 5°.
quote: Vertical angle: 10° above and below the horizontal. However, where a retro-reflector is mounted below 750 mm
condition: Bumper incorporates front retro-reflectors (presence unknown)
test_case: Check unobstructed visibility 10° up and 10° (or 5° if mounted below 750 mm) down; pass if no obstruction.

text: If the bumper incorporates front retro-reflectors, the orientation of the front retro-reflectors shall be towards the front.
quote: Orientation Towards the front.
condition: Bumper incorporates front retro-reflectors (presence unknown)
test_case: Inspect installation; pass if retro-reflectors face forward.

text: If the bumper corners incorporate optional side retro-reflectors, these devices shall be type-approved according to the requirements concerning Class IA or IB retro-reflectors in the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 3, or in the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 150.
quote: These devices shall be type-approved according to the requirements concerning Class IA or IB retro-reflectors in the 02 or subsequent series of amendments
condition: Bumper incorporates side retro-reflectors (presence unknown)
test_case: Check approval mark/certificate of the side retro-reflector for R3 Class IA/IB or R150.

text: If the bumper incorporates optional side retro-reflectors, the side retro-reflectors shall be above the ground not less than 250 mm nor more than 900 mm (not more than 1,200 mm if grouped with any lamp(s), 1,500 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible or if the presence of the device is not mandatory according to paragraph 6.17.1.).
quote: Above the ground, not less than 250 mm nor more than 900 mm (not more than 1,200 mm if grouped with any lamp(s), 1,500 mm
condition: Bumper incorporates side retro-reflectors (presence unknown)
test_case: Measure mounting height; pass if within the applicable range.

text: If the bumper incorporates optional side retro-reflectors, for motor vehicles the length of which does not exceed 6 m, one side retro-reflector shall be fitted within the first third and/or one within the last third of the vehicle length.
quote: for motor vehicles the length of which does not exceed 6 m, it is sufficient to have one side retro-reflector fitted within the first third
condition: Bumper incorporates side retro-reflectors (presence unknown)
test_case: Measure longitudinal position; pass if within the first third of vehicle length.

text: If the bumper incorporates optional side retro-reflectors, the geometric visibility of the side retro-reflectors shall be horizontal 45° to the front and to the rear and vertical 10° above and below the horizontal (downward angle may be reduced to 5° where mounted below 750 mm).
quote: Geometric visibility Horizontal angle: 45° to the front and to the rear. Vertical angle: 10° above and below the horizontal.
condition: Bumper incorporates side retro-reflectors (presence unknown)
test_case: Check unobstructed visibility over the specified angles; pass if no obstruction.

text: If the bumper incorporates optional side retro-reflectors, the orientation of the side retro-reflectors shall be towards the side.
quote: Orientation Towards the side.
condition: Bumper incorporates side retro-reflectors (presence unknown)
test_case: Inspect installation; pass if facing sideways.

text: If the bumper incorporates side-marker lamps on the M1 vehicle, the side-marker lamps shall be of the SM1 type or the SM2 type.
quote: The SM1 type of side-marker lamp shall be used on all categories of vehicles; however the SM2 type of side-marker lamps may be used on the M1
condition: Bumper incorporates side-marker lamps (presence unknown)
test_case: Check approval marking of the side-marker lamp for SM1 or SM2.

text: On M1 category vehicles less than 6 m in length, side-marker lamps shall be used if they supplement the reduced geometric visibility requirements of front position lamps conforming to paragraph 6.9.5.2. and rear position lamps conforming to paragraph 6.10.5.2.
quote: on M1 and N1 category vehicles less than 6 m in length, side-marker lamps shall be used, if they supplement the reduced geometric visibility
condition: Front position lamps use reduced geometric visibility per 6.9.5.2 (presence unknown)
test_case: Review lamp installation; pass if side-marker lamps are fitted where reduced position-lamp visibility is used.

text: If the bumper incorporates side-marker lamps, the devices shall be type-approved according to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 91, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
quote: The devices shall be type-approved according to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 91, or to the 00
condition: Bumper incorporates side-marker lamps (presence unknown)
test_case: Check approval mark/certificate for R91 or R148.

text: If the bumper incorporates side-marker lamps, the side-marker lamps shall be above the ground not less than 250 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm).
quote: Above the ground, not less than 250 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible
condition: Bumper incorporates side-marker lamps (presence unknown)
test_case: Measure mounting height; pass if within 250–1,500 mm.

text: If the bumper incorporates side-marker lamps, for vehicles the length of which does not exceed 6 m, one side-marker lamp shall be fitted within the first third and/or within the last third of the vehicle length.
quote: for vehicles the length of which does not exceed 6 m and for chassis-cabs it is sufficient to have one side-marker lamp fitted within the first third
condition: Bumper incorporates side-marker lamps (presence unknown)
test_case: Measure longitudinal position; pass if within the first third of the vehicle length.

text: If the vehicle is equipped with side-marker lamps used to supplement the reduced geometric visibility of front direction indicator lamps conforming to paragraph 6.5.5.2. and/or position lamps conforming to paragraph 6.9.5.2., the horizontal angles shall be 45° towards the front and rear ends of the vehicle and 30° towards the centre of the vehicle.
quote: side-marker lamps used to supplement the reduced geometric visibility of front and rear direction indicator lamps conforming to paragraph 6.5.5.2.
condition: Front direction indicators use reduced geometric visibility per 6.5.5.2 supplemented by side-marker lamps
test_case: Check side-marker visibility 45° towards vehicle end and 30° towards centre; pass if no obstruction.

text: If the bumper incorporates optional side-marker lamps, the geometric visibility horizontal angle shall be 45° to the front and to the rear, which may be reduced to 30° for vehicles on which installation of side-marker lamps is optional.
quote: Horizontal angle: 45° to the front and to the rear; however for vehicles on which the installation of the side-marker lamps is optional
condition: Bumper incorporates side-marker lamps (presence unknown)
test_case: Check unobstructed visibility over 45° (or 30°) front and rear; pass if no obstruction.

text: If the bumper incorporates side-marker lamps, the geometric visibility vertical angle shall be 10° above and below the horizontal, except that where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm the downward angle may be reduced to 5°.
quote: Vertical angle: 10° above and below the horizontal. However, where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm
condition: Bumper incorporates side-marker lamps (presence unknown)
test_case: Check unobstructed visibility 10° up and 10° (5° below 750 mm) down.

text: If the bumper incorporates side-marker lamps, the orientation of the side-marker lamps shall be towards the side.
quote: Orientation Towards the side.
condition: Bumper incorporates side-marker lamps (presence unknown)
test_case: Inspect installation; pass if side-marker lamps face sideways.

text: On M1 category vehicles less than 6 m in length, amber side-marker lamps may be wired to flash only provided that this flashing is in phase and at the same frequency with the direction-indicator lamps at the same side of the vehicle.
quote: amber side-marker lamps may be wired to flash, provided that this flashing is in phase and at the same frequency with the direction-indicator lamps
condition: Bumper incorporates amber side-marker lamps wired to flash
test_case: Activate direction indicator and record both signals; pass if side-marker flashes in phase and at same frequency.

text: If a tell-tale for the side-marker lamps exists, its function shall be carried out by the tell-tale required for the front and rear position lamps; a tell-tale indicating failure is mandatory if required by the component regulation.
quote: If it exists its function shall be carried out by the tell-tale required for the front and rear position lamps.
condition: Bumper incorporates side-marker lamps (presence unknown)
test_case: Verify the side-marker tell-tale is the position-lamp tell-tale.

text: When an optional side-marker lamp is grouped or combined with a position lamp that is reciprocally incorporated or grouped with the direction indicator, the side-marker lamp on the relevant side may be switched OFF only during the entire period (both ON and OFF cycle) of activation of the direction indicator lamp.
quote: the electrical connection of the side-marker lamp on the relevant side of the vehicle may be such that it is switched OFF during the entire period
condition: Side-marker lamp grouped/combined with position lamp reciprocally incorporated or grouped with the front direction indicator
test_case: Activate the indicator; pass if any switching OFF of the side-marker lamp covers the entire ON and OFF cycle period.

text: If the bumper incorporates daytime running lamps, there shall be two, type-approved according to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 87, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
quote: Two, type-approved according to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 87, or to the 00 or subsequent series
condition: Bumper incorporates daytime running lamps (presence unknown)
test_case: Count DRLs and check approval marks for R87 or R148.

text: If the bumper incorporates daytime running lamps, the distance between the inner edges of the apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axes shall not be less than 600 mm (may be reduced to 400 mm where the overall width of the vehicle is less than 1,300 mm).
quote: the distance between the inner edges of the apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axes shall not be less than 600 mm
condition: Bumper incorporates daytime running lamps (presence unknown)
test_case: Measure inner-edge spacing; pass if ≥ 600 mm (≥ 400 mm for vehicle width < 1,300 mm).

text: If the bumper incorporates daytime running lamps, the daytime running lamps shall be above the ground not less than 250 mm nor more than 1,500 mm.
quote: In height: above the ground not less than 250 mm nor more than 1,500 mm.
condition: Bumper incorporates daytime running lamps (presence unknown)
test_case: Measure mounting height; pass if within 250–1,500 mm.

text: If the bumper incorporates daytime running lamps, the daytime running lamps shall be at the front of the vehicle, deemed satisfied if the light emitted does not cause discomfort to the driver either directly or indirectly through the devices for indirect vision and/or other reflecting surfaces of the vehicle.
quote: This requirement shall be deemed to be satisfied if the light emitted does not cause discomfort to the driver either directly or indirectly
condition: Bumper incorporates daytime running lamps (presence unknown)
test_case: Inspect position and check from driver seat for direct/indirect glare; pass if no discomfort.

text: If the bumper incorporates daytime running lamps, the geometric visibility shall be horizontal outwards 20° and inwards 20° and vertical upwards 10° and downwards 10°.
quote: Geometric visibility Horizontal: outwards 20° and inwards 20°. Vertical: upwards 10° and downwards 10°.
condition: Bumper incorporates daytime running lamps (presence unknown)
test_case: Check unobstructed visibility over the specified angles; pass if no obstruction.

text: If the bumper incorporates daytime running lamps, the orientation of the daytime running lamps shall be towards the front.
quote: Orientation Towards the front.
condition: Bumper incorporates daytime running lamps (presence unknown)
test_case: Inspect installation; pass if facing forward.

text: The daytime running lamp shall switch OFF automatically when the front fog lamps are switched ON.
quote: The daytime running lamp shall switch OFF automatically ... as well as when either of the following conditions exists: (a) The front fog lamps are switched ON
condition: Vehicle fitted with daytime running lamps
test_case: With DRLs ON, switch ON front fog lamps; pass if DRLs switch OFF automatically.
merged: The daytime running lamps shall not be switched ON automatically when the front fog lamps are switched ON.

text: If a front direction-indicator lamp is not reciprocally incorporated with a daytime running lamp and the distance between the edges of the apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis of the front direction-indicator lamp and the daytime running lamp is equal or less than 40 mm, the electrical connections of the daytime running lamp shall be such that the daytime running lamp on the relevant side of the vehicle is switched OFF during the entire period (both ON and OFF cycle) of operation of the front direction-indicator lamp, or its luminous intensity is reduced during that entire period to not more than 140 cd within the angles of geometric visibility.
quote: the electrical connections of the daytime running lamp shall be such that, either (a) The daytime running lamp on the relevant side of the vehicle is switched OFF
condition: Vehicle DRL located within 40 mm of the front direction-indicator lamp
test_case: Measure edge distance; if ≤ 40 mm, activate indicator and verify DRL is OFF or ≤ 140 cd during the entire ON and OFF cycle.

text: The switching OFF or dimming of the daytime running lamp near the front direction-indicator lamp is not required if the luminous intensity of the front direction-indicator lamp in HV is at least 50% higher than the luminous intensity of the daytime running lamp in HV.
quote: If the luminous intensity of the front direction-indicator lamp in HV is at least 50% higher than the luminous intensity of the daytime running lamp in HV
condition: Vehicle DRL located within 40 mm of the front direction-indicator lamp
test_case: Compare HV intensities of indicator and DRL; exemption valid if indicator ≥ 1.5 × DRL.

text: If a front direction-indicator lamp is reciprocally incorporated with a daytime running lamp with totally common apparent surfaces, the electrical connections shall be such that the daytime running lamp function on the relevant side of the vehicle is switched OFF during the entire period (both ON and OFF cycle) of operation of the front direction-indicator lamp.
quote: the electrical connections shall be such that the daytime running lamp function on the relevant side of the vehicle is switched OFF during the entire period
condition: Front direction indicator reciprocally incorporated with a DRL with totally common apparent surfaces
test_case: Activate the indicator; pass if DRL function on that side is OFF throughout ON and OFF cycles.

text: In the case of partially common apparent surfaces of the daytime running lamp and the front direction-indicator lamp, the electrical connections of the daytime running lamp shall be such that the whole daytime running lamp function on the relevant side of the vehicle is switched OFF during the entire period (both ON and OFF cycle) of activation of the front direction-indicator lamp, or alternatively meet the provision for category 1a or 1b front direction-indicator lamps.
quote: The whole daytime running lamp function on the relevant side of the vehicle is switched OFF during the entire period (both ON and OFF cycle)
condition: A daytime running lamp shares a partially common apparent surface with the front direction-indicator lamp in the bumper corners.
test_case: Activate the direction indicator and check that the DRL on the same side is OFF during both ON and OFF cycles of the indicator.

text: In the case of partially common apparent surfaces, for a category 1a or 1b front direction-indicator lamp, the daytime running lamp function on the relevant side of the vehicle shall be switched OFF for the part of the apparent surface in common with the front direction-indicator lamp and the luminous intensity of the part not in common shall be reduced during the entire period (both ON and OFF cycle) of operation of the front direction-indicator lamp to not more than 140 cd within the angles of geometric visibility.
quote: the luminous intensity of the part of the apparent surface not in common is reduced during the entire period (both ON and OFF cycle) of operation
condition: A daytime running lamp shares a partially common apparent surface with a category 1a or 1b front direction-indicator lamp and option (b) is used.
test_case: With the indicator operating, measure the DRL non-common part intensity within the geometric visibility angles and confirm it is ≤ 140 cd and the common part is OFF.

text: If cornering lamps are fitted, the cornering lamp on one side of the vehicle may only be switched ON automatically when the direction-indicators on the same side are switched ON and/or the steering angle is changed towards the same side, and shall be switched OFF automatically when the direction-indicator is switched OFF and/or the steering angle has returned to the straight-ahead position.
quote: The cornering lamp shall be switched OFF automatically when the direction-indicator is switched OFF and/or the steering angle has returned
condition: Cornering lamps are integrated in the bumper corner lamps.
test_case: Operate the direction indicator and steering and verify the cornering lamp switches ON only on the same side and switches OFF automatically when the indicator is cancelled.

text: Conspicuity markings shall not be fitted on vehicles of category M1; the front bumper assembly for the M1 vehicle shall not carry conspicuity markings.
quote: Prohibited: on vehicles of categories M1 and O1.
test_case: Visually inspect the bumper assembly and confirm that no conspicuity marking material is applied.

text: Where the emergency stop signal is given by the direction-indicator lamps, the emergency stop signal shall be given by the simultaneous operation of all the direction-indicator lamps fitted (including the front direction indicators) as described in paragraph 6.23.7.
quote: The emergency stop signal shall be given by the simultaneous operation of all the stop or direction-indicator lamps fitted as described in paragraph 6.23.7.
condition: Vehicle emergency stop signal implemented via the direction-indicator lamps
test_case: Trigger the emergency stop signal and verify that all direction-indicator lamps, including the front ones, operate simultaneously.

text: Where the emergency stop signal is given by the direction-indicator lamps, the number of lamps shall be as specified in paragraph 6.7.2.
quote: Number As specified in paragraph 6.5.2. or 6.7.2.
condition: Vehicle emergency stop signal implemented via the direction-indicator lamps
test_case: Check the number of front direction indicators against paragraph 6.5.2.
merged: Where the emergency stop signal is given by the direction-indicator lamps, the arrangement shall be as specified in paragraph 6.5.3.
Where the emergency stop signal is given by the direction-indicator lamps, the position shall be as specified in paragraph 6.5.4.
Where the emergency stop signal is given by the direction-indicator lamps, the orientation shall be as specified in paragraph 6.5.6.

text: Where the emergency stop signal is given by the direction-indicator lamps, the geometric visibility shall be as specified in paragraph 6.5.5.
quote: Geometric visibility As specified in paragraph 6.5.5. or 6.7.5.
condition: Vehicle emergency stop signal implemented via the direction-indicator lamps
test_case: Verify the geometric visibility angles of the front direction indicators against paragraph 6.5.5.

text: All the lamps of the emergency stop signal shall flash in phase at a frequency of 4.0 ± 1.0 Hz.
quote: All the lamps of the emergency stop signal shall flash in phase at a frequency of 4.0 ± 1.0 Hz.
condition: Vehicle emergency stop signal implemented via the direction-indicator lamps
test_case: Measure flash frequency and phase of all emergency stop signal lamps; pass if in phase and 3.0-5.0 Hz.

text: If any of the lamps of the emergency stop signal to the rear of the vehicle use filament light sources, the frequency of the emergency stop signal shall be 4.0 +0.0/-1.0 Hz.
quote: However, if any of the lamps of the emergency stop signal to the rear of the vehicle use filament light sources the frequency shall be 4.0 +0.0/-1.0 Hz.
condition: Emergency stop signal via direction indicators and rear lamps use filament light sources
test_case: Measure flash frequency; pass if between 3.0 and 4.0 Hz.

text: The emergency stop signal shall operate independently of other lamps.
quote: The emergency stop signal shall operate independently of other lamps.
condition: Vehicle emergency stop signal implemented via the direction-indicator lamps
test_case: Activate the emergency stop signal with other lamps on/off and verify independent operation.

text: The emergency stop signal shall be switched ON and OFF automatically.
quote: The emergency stop signal shall be switched ON and OFF automatically.
condition: Vehicle emergency stop signal implemented via the direction-indicator lamps
test_case: Verify by vehicle test that the signal activates and deactivates without driver input.

text: The emergency stop signal shall be switched ON only when the vehicle speed is above 50 km/h and the braking system is providing the emergency braking logic signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H.
quote: The emergency stop signal shall be switched ON only when the vehicle speed is above 50 km/h and the braking system is providing the emergency braking logic signal
condition: Vehicle emergency stop signal implemented via the direction-indicator lamps
test_case: Perform emergency braking above and below 50 km/h; pass if signal activates only above 50 km/h with emergency braking logic signal.

text: The emergency stop signal shall be automatically switched OFF if the emergency braking logic signal as defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H is no longer provided or if the hazard warning signal is activated.
quote: The emergency stop signal shall be automatically switched OFF if the emergency braking logic signal as defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H is no longer provided
condition: Vehicle emergency stop signal implemented via the direction-indicator lamps
test_case: Remove the emergency braking logic signal or activate hazard warning; pass if the emergency stop signal switches off.

text: If fitted, the rear-end collision alert signal shall be given by the simultaneous operation of all the direction indicator lamps fitted (including the front direction indicators) as described in paragraph 6.25.7.
quote: The rear-end collision alert signal shall be given by the simultaneous operation of all the direction indicator lamps fitted as described in paragraph 6.25.7.
condition: Vehicle fitted with rear-end collision alert signal
test_case: Trigger the rear-end collision alert signal and verify all direction indicator lamps operate simultaneously.

text: For the rear-end collision alert signal, the number of lamps shall be as specified in paragraph 6.5.2.
quote: Number As specified in paragraph 6.5.2.
condition: Vehicle fitted with rear-end collision alert signal
test_case: Check the number of direction indicators against paragraph 6.5.2.

text: For the rear-end collision alert signal, the arrangement shall be as specified in paragraph 6.5.3.
quote: Arrangement As specified in paragraph 6.5.3.
condition: Vehicle fitted with rear-end collision alert signal
test_case: Check the arrangement of the direction indicators against paragraph 6.5.3.
merged: For the rear-end collision alert signal, the position shall be as specified in paragraph 6.5.4.
For the rear-end collision alert signal, the orientation shall be as specified in paragraph 6.5.6.

text: For the rear-end collision alert signal, the geometric visibility shall be as specified in paragraph 6.5.5.
quote: Geometric visibility As specified in paragraph 6.5.5.
condition: Vehicle fitted with rear-end collision alert signal
test_case: Verify the geometric visibility of the direction indicators against paragraph 6.5.5.

text: Compliance with the electrical connection requirements of the rear-end collision alert signal shall be demonstrated by the applicant, by simulation or other means of verification accepted by the Technical Service responsible for type approval.
quote: Compliance with these requirements shall be demonstrated by the applicant, by simulation or other means of verification accepted by the Technical Service
condition: Vehicle fitted with rear-end collision alert signal
test_case: Review simulation or verification evidence for the electrical connection requirements.

text: All the lamps of the rear-end collision alert signal shall flash in phase at a frequency of 4.0 +/- 1.0 Hz.
quote: All the lamps of the rear-end collision alert signal shall flash in phase at a frequency of 4.0 +/- 1.0 Hz.
condition: Vehicle fitted with rear-end collision alert signal
test_case: Measure flash frequency and phase; pass if in phase and 3.0-5.0 Hz.

text: If any of the lamps of the rear-end collision alert signal to the rear of the vehicle use filament light sources, the frequency shall be 4.0 +0.0/-1.0 Hz.
quote: However, if any of the lamps of the rear end collision alert signal to the rear of the vehicle use filament light sources the frequency shall be 4.0 +0.0/-1.0 Hz.
condition: Rear-end collision alert signal fitted and rear lamps use filament light sources
test_case: Measure flash frequency; pass if between 3.0 and 4.0 Hz.

text: The rear-end collision alert signal shall operate independently of other lamps.
quote: The rear-end collision alert signal shall operate independently of other lamps.
condition: Vehicle fitted with rear-end collision alert signal
test_case: Verify independent operation with other lamps switched on and off.

text: The rear-end collision alert signal shall be switched ON and OFF automatically.
quote: The rear-end collision alert signal shall be switched ON and OFF automatically.
condition: Vehicle fitted with rear-end collision alert signal
test_case: Verify automatic activation and deactivation without driver input.

text: The rear-end collision alert signal shall not be switched ON if the direction indicator lamps, the hazard warning signal or the emergency stop signal is activated.
quote: The rear-end collision alert signal shall not be switched ON if the direction indicator lamps, the hazard warning signal or the emergency stop signal is activated.
condition: Vehicle fitted with rear-end collision alert signal
test_case: With direction indicators, hazard warning or emergency stop signal active, create alert conditions; pass if RECAS does not activate.

text: The rear-end collision alert signal shall only be switched ON when Vr > 30 km/h and TTC ≤ 1.4, or when Vr ≤ 30 km/h and TTC ≤ 1.4 / 30 × Vr.
quote: The rear-end collision alert signal may only be switched ON under the following conditions: Vr switch ON Vr > 30 km/h TTC ≤ 1.4
condition: Vehicle fitted with rear-end collision alert signal
test_case: Simulate following-vehicle scenarios; pass if activation occurs only within the specified Vr/TTC conditions.

text: The switch ON period of the rear-end collision alert signal shall be not more than 3 seconds.
quote: The switch ON period of the rear-end collision alert signal shall be not more than 3 seconds.
condition: Vehicle fitted with rear-end collision alert signal
test_case: Measure activation duration; pass if ≤ 3 s.

text: If the front direction indicators are used for the answer-back signal, the number of lamps used for the answer-back signal shall be in accordance with the individual specifications applicable to the specific lamp used for the answer-back signal, but may be less than or equal to that number.
quote: In accordance with the individual specifications applicable to the specific lamp used for the answer-back signal. However, the number may be less than
condition: Front direction indicators are used to provide an answer-back signal
test_case: Check the vehicle installation: the number of indicator lamps used for answer-back does not exceed the number specified in paragraph 6.5.

text: If the front direction indicators are used for the answer-back signal, the arrangement of the lamps used for the answer-back signal shall be in accordance with the individual specifications applicable to the specific lamp used for the answer-back signal.
quote: Arrangement In accordance with the individual specifications applicable to the specific lamp used for the answer-back signal.
condition: Front direction indicators are used to provide an answer-back signal
test_case: Verify that the arrangement of the indicator lamps complies with paragraph 6.5 arrangement requirements.
merged: If the front direction indicators are used for the answer-back signal, the position in width of the lamps used for the answer-back signal shall be in accordance with the individual specifications applicable to the specific lamp used for the answer-back signal.

If the front direction indicators are used for the answer-back signal, the position in height of the lamps used for the answer-back signal shall be in accordance with the individual specifications applicable to the specific lamp used for the answer-back signal.

If the front direction indicators are used for the answer-back signal, the position in length of the lamps used for the answer-back signal shall be in accordance with the individual specifications applicable to the specific lamp used for the answer-back signal.

If the front direction indicators are used for the answer-back signal, the orientation of the lamps used for the answer-back signal shall be in accordance with the individual specifications applicable to the specific lamp used for the answer-back signal.

text: If the front direction indicators are used for the answer-back signal, the geometric visibility of the lamps used for the answer-back signal shall be in accordance with the individual specifications applicable to the specific lamp used for the answer-back signal, but may be reduced in comparison to those specifications.
quote: Geometric visibility In accordance with the individual specifications applicable to the specific lamp used for the answer-back signal. However, the geometric visibility may be reduced
condition: Front direction indicators are used to provide an answer-back signal
test_case: Verify the geometric visibility angles of the indicator lamps do not exceed those of paragraph 6.5.

text: If the front direction indicators are used for the answer-back signal, the answer-back signal shall only operate under the park condition of a vehicle.
quote: The answer-back signal shall only operate under the park condition of a vehicle.
condition: Front direction indicators are used to provide an answer-back signal
test_case: Functional test: attempt to trigger the answer-back signal outside park condition; the signal shall not operate.

text: If the front direction indicators are used for the answer-back signal and the answer-back signal flashes, the frequency shall not exceed 2.0 Hz.
quote: If the answer-back signal flashes, the frequency shall not exceed 2.0 Hz.
condition: Front direction indicators are used to provide a flashing answer-back signal
test_case: Measure the flash frequency of the answer-back signal; it shall be ≤ 2.0 Hz.

text: The front fog lamps shall not be used to provide the answer-back signal.
quote: However, front fog lamps, rear fog lamps and stop lamps are not permitted to be used.
test_case: Functional test of locking/unlocking: verify that the front fog lamps are not activated as part of the answer-back signal.

text: If the front direction indicators are used for the answer-back signal, the answer-back signal shall be provided by approved lighting and light-signalling devices where the maximum luminous intensity per lamp does not exceed 700 cd on or above the HH line.
quote: The answer-back signal shall be provided by approved lighting and light-signalling devices and exterior courtesy lamps where in all these cases, the maximum luminous intensity per lamp does not exceed 700 cd
condition: Front direction indicators are used to provide an answer-back signal
test_case: Photometric measurement in answer-back mode: intensity per lamp on or above the HH line ≤ 700 cd, and the lamp holds a valid approval.

text: If the front direction indicators are used for the answer-back signal, the answer-back signal may only be activated automatically in conjunction with the locking and unlocking of the door(s) and/or the detection of the vehicle user in proximity to the vehicle.
quote: The answer-back signal may only be activated automatically in conjunction with the locking and unlocking of the door(s) and/or the detection of the vehicle user
condition: Front direction indicators are used to provide an answer-back signal
test_case: Functional test: answer-back activation occurs only on locking/unlocking or user proximity detection.

text: If the front direction indicators are used for the answer-back signal, the duration of the optical indication of the answer-back signal shall not exceed 3 seconds, defined from the beginning to the end of the signal, irrespective of whether it contains flashes, variations of intensity or variations in apparent surface.
quote: The duration of the optical indication of the answer-back signal shall not exceed 3 seconds.
condition: Front direction indicators are used to provide an answer-back signal
test_case: Measure the answer-back signal duration from start to end; it shall be ≤ 3 s.

text: Where the front fog lamp or front direction indicator is reciprocally incorporated with another function and the non-textured outer lens is excluded, so that the apparent surface according to paragraph 2.10.2. is used, function F1 shall not be transparent to function F2.
quote: "7b" is the apparent surface according to paragraph 2.10.2. and F1 shall not be transparent to F2
condition: Lamp functions in the bumper are reciprocally incorporated with another function.
test_case: Inspect the reciprocally incorporated lamp and confirm that function F1 is not transparent to function F2 per the Annex 3 Part 7 example.

text: For verifying that no red light from the front lamps (front fog lamps, front direction indicators) is visible to the front according to paragraph 5.10.4., the zone 1 explored by the eye of the observer shall be bounded in height by two horizontal planes 1 m and 2.2 m above the ground.
quote: In height, by two horizontal planes 1 m and 2.2 m respectively above the ground
test_case: Observe the front lamps from zone 1 between 1 m and 2.2 m height and confirm no red light is directly or indirectly visible.

text: For verifying the visibility of a red lamp to the front according to paragraph 5.10.4., the zone 1 explored by the eye of the observer shall be bounded in width by a vertical plane forming to the front an angle of 15° outwards from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane, passing through the point or points of contact of vertical planes parallel to the median longitudinal plane delimiting the vehicle's overall width; if there are several points of contact, the foremost shall correspond to the forward plane.
quote: In width, by two vertical planes which, forming to the front and to the rear respectively an angle of 15° outwards from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane
test_case: Construct the 15° outward vertical planes through the foremost width contact points and confirm no red light from the bumper lamps is visible within zone 1.

text: For the loading condition tests, the mass of the passengers shall be calculated on the basis of 75 kg per person.
quote: For the following tests, the mass of the passengers shall be calculated on the basis of 75 kg per person.
condition: Only if the Annex 5 loading conditions are used to check the vertical orientation of the front fog lamps fitted in the bumper (the bumper has no dipped-beam headlamps).
test_case: Check that the vehicle loading for the orientation tests uses 75 kg per occupant.

text: For vehicles in category M1, the angle of the light beam shall be determined under the load condition: one person in the driver's seat.
quote: One person in the driver's seat;
condition: Only if the Annex 5 loading conditions are used to check the vertical orientation of the front fog lamps fitted in the bumper.
test_case: Measure the beam inclination with one 75 kg person in the driver's seat and check it is within the permitted range.

text: For vehicles in category M1, the angle of the light beam shall be determined under the load condition: the driver, plus one passenger in the front seat farthest from the driver.
quote: The driver, plus one passenger in the front seat farthest from the driver;
condition: Only if the Annex 5 loading conditions are used to check the vertical orientation of the front fog lamps fitted in the bumper.
test_case: Measure the beam inclination with the driver and one front passenger and check it is within the permitted range.

text: For vehicles in category M1, the angle of the light beam shall be determined under the load condition: the driver, one passenger in the front seat farthest from the driver, all the seats farthest to the rear occupied.
quote: The driver, one passenger in the front seat farthest from the driver, all the seats farthest to the rear occupied;
condition: Only if the Annex 5 loading conditions are used to check the vertical orientation of the front fog lamps fitted in the bumper.
test_case: Measure the beam inclination with driver, front passenger and rearmost seats occupied and check it is within the permitted range.

text: For vehicles in category M1, the angle of the light beam shall be determined under the load condition: all the seats occupied.
quote: All the seats occupied;
condition: Only if the Annex 5 loading conditions are used to check the vertical orientation of the front fog lamps fitted in the bumper.
test_case: Measure the beam inclination with all seats occupied and check it is within the permitted range.

text: For vehicles in category M1, the angle of the light beam shall be determined with all the seats occupied, plus an evenly distributed load in the luggage boot to obtain the permissible load on the rear axle (or on the front axle if the boot is at the front); if the vehicle has a front and a rear boot, the additional load shall be appropriately distributed to obtain the permissible axle loads; if the maximum permissible laden mass is obtained before the permissible load on one of the axles, the loading of the boot(s) shall be limited to the figure which enables that mass to be reached.
quote: All the seats occupied, plus an evenly distributed load in the luggage boot, in order to obtain the permissible load on the rear axle
condition: Only if the Annex 5 loading conditions are used to check the vertical orientation of the front fog lamps fitted in the bumper.
test_case: Load all seats and boot to the permissible axle load (limited by maximum laden mass), measure the beam inclination and check it is within the permitted range.

text: For vehicles in category M1, the angle of the light beam shall be determined with the driver, plus an evenly distributed load in the boot to obtain the permissible load on the corresponding axle; if the maximum permissible laden mass is obtained before the permissible load on the axle, the loading of the boot(s) shall be limited to the figure which enables that mass to be reached.
quote: Driver, plus an evenly distributed load in the boot, in order to obtain the permissible load on the corresponding axle.
condition: Only if the Annex 5 loading conditions are used to check the vertical orientation of the front fog lamps fitted in the bumper.
test_case: Load the driver and boot to the permissible axle load (limited by maximum laden mass), measure the beam inclination and check it is within the permitted range.

text: In determining the M1 loading conditions, account shall be taken of any loading restrictions laid down by the manufacturer.
quote: In determining the above loading conditions, account shall be taken of any loading restrictions laid down by the manufacturer.
condition: Only if the Annex 5 loading conditions are used to check the vertical orientation of the front fog lamps fitted in the bumper.
test_case: Review the test loading plan against the manufacturer's loading restrictions and confirm they are respected.

text: The values measured for the distances of the front fog lamps and front direction indicators shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.
quote: The values measured for the distances shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.
test_case: Compare measured lamp distances with the individual installation specifications of paragraphs 6.3 and 6.5; all within limits.

text: The position of the front fog lamps and front direction indicators, as defined in paragraph 2.1.6., in width, in height and in length shall be checked in accordance with the general requirements set out in paragraphs 2.10.2., 2.10.3., 2.10.4., 2.3.3. and 5.4. of this Regulation.
quote: The position of lamps, as defined in paragraph 2.1.6. of this Regulation, in width, in height and in length shall be checked
test_case: Measure lamp positions in width, height and length on the vehicle per paragraphs 2.10.2–2.10.4, 2.3.3 and 5.4; check is performed.

text: The values measured for the angles of geometric visibility of the front fog lamps and front direction indicators shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled, except that the limits of the angles may have an allowance corresponding to the ±3° variation permitted in paragraph 5.3. for the mounting of the light-signalling devices.
quote: The values measured for the angles shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled except that the limits
test_case: Compare measured visibility angles with the individual lamp specifications allowing ±3°; all fulfilled.

text: The angles of geometric visibility of the front fog lamps and front direction indicators shall be checked in accordance with paragraph 2.10.7. of this Regulation.
quote: The angles of geometric visibility shall be checked in accordance with paragraph 2.10.7. of this Regulation.
test_case: Measure geometric visibility angles per paragraph 2.10.7 on the vehicle.

text: The visibility of red light towards the front and of white light towards the rear shall be checked in accordance with paragraph 5.10. of this Regulation.
quote: The visibility of red light towards the front and of white light towards the rear shall be checked in accordance with paragraph 5.10.
test_case: Check per paragraph 5.10 that no red light is visible from the front from the bumper lamps.

text: The initial downward inclination of the cut-off of the front fog lamps shall be set to the plated figure as required and shown in Annex 7.
quote: The initial downward inclination of the cut-off of the dipped beam and the front fog lamps shall be set to the plated figure
test_case: Measure fog lamp cut-off inclination on unladen vehicle; equals plated figure per Annex 7.

text: Alternatively, where the initial aim of the front fog lamps is set to a figure different from the plated figure, it shall be shown to be representative of the type approved when tested in accordance with the procedures contained in Annex 6 and in particular paragraph 4.1.
quote: Alternatively, the manufacturer shall set the initial aim to a figure that is different from the plated figure where it can be shown
condition: Initial fog lamp aim set to a figure different from the plated figure
test_case: Verify by Annex 6 paragraph 4.1 procedure that the alternative aim is representative of the approved type.

text: In the case of a front fog lamp with light source(s) having a total objective luminous flux which exceeds 2,000 lumens, at a mounting height h < 0.8 m the variation of the downward inclination as a function of the loading conditions shall remain within 0.7 per cent minimum vertical inclination and 3.3 per cent maximum vertical inclination.
quote: h < 0.8: 0.7 per cent minimum vertical inclination and 3.3 per cent maximum vertical inclination
condition: Fog lamp light source total objective luminous flux exceeds 2,000 lm
test_case: Measure fog lamp inclination under specified loading states; stays within 0.7 %–3.3 % downward for h < 0.8 m.
merged: In the case of a front fog lamp with light source(s) having a total objective luminous flux which exceeds 2,000 lumens, at a mounting height h > 0.8 m the variation of the downward inclination as a function of the loading conditions shall remain within 1.2 per cent minimum vertical inclination and 3.8 per cent maximum vertical inclination.

text: For vehicles in category M1, the states of loading to be used for the front fog lamp inclination variation check shall be those of paragraph 2.1.1.1. and paragraph 2.1.1.6. of Annex 5, taking into account paragraph 2.1.2.
quote: Vehicles in category M1: Paragraph 2.1.1.1. Paragraph 2.1.1.6. taking into account Paragraph 2.1.2.
condition: Fog lamp light source total objective luminous flux exceeds 2,000 lm
test_case: Confirm the inclination check uses Annex 5 loading states 2.1.1.1 and 2.1.1.6 (with 2.1.2) for the M1 vehicle.

text: The front fog lamps, front direction indicators and their tell-tales shall function in accordance with the provisions set out in paragraphs 5.11. to 5.14. of this Regulation and with the individual specifications applicable to each lamp.
quote: The lamps and tell-tales shall function in accordance with the provisions set out in paragraphs 5.11. to 5.14. of this Regulation
test_case: Operate lamps and observe tell-tales; behaviour complies with paragraphs 5.11–5.14 and 6.3/6.5.

text: The electrical connections shall be checked by switching on every lamp supplied by the electrical system of the vehicle, including the front fog lamps and front direction indicators.
quote: The electrical connections shall be checked by switching on every lamp supplied by the electrical system of the vehicle.
test_case: Switch on each fog lamp and direction indicator via vehicle controls; each lamp lights.

text: The presence, number, colour, arrangement and, where applicable, the category of the front fog lamps and front direction indicators shall be such that the requirements set out in paragraphs 5.15. and 5.16. as well as in the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.
quote: These shall be such that the requirements set out in paragraphs 5.15. and 5.16. as well as in the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.
test_case: Compare inspected lamp colour, number, arrangement and category with paragraphs 5.15, 5.16, 6.3 and 6.5; all compliant.

text: The presence, number, colour, arrangement and, where applicable, the category of the front fog lamps and front direction indicators shall be checked by visual inspection of the lamps and their markings.
quote: The presence, number, colour, arrangement and, where applicable, the category of lamps shall be checked by visual inspection
test_case: Visually inspect lamps and approval markings for presence, number, colour, arrangement and category.

text: For vehicles with a lower bumper height at the test position of less than 425 mm, the requirements of paragraph 5.1.1. (flexible lower legform to bumper) shall be applied.
quote: Legform test to bumper: For vehicles with a lower bumper height at the test position of less than 425 mm the requirements of paragraph
condition: Lower bumper height at the test position is less than 425 mm (bumper geometry not provided).
test_case: Measure the lower bumper height at each test position; if below 425 mm, verify that the flexible lower legform test of paragraph 5.1.1. is used.

text: When tested in accordance with Annex 5, paragraph 1. (Flexible lower legform impactor), the absolute value of the maximum dynamic medial collateral ligament elongation at the knee shall not exceed 22 mm.
quote: the absolute value of the maximum dynamic medial collateral ligament elongation at the knee shall not exceed 22 mm
condition: Flexible lower legform test applies (lower bumper height below 425 mm, or 425-500 mm and chosen by manufacturer).
test_case: Perform flexible lower legform impacts per Annex 5 para. 1 at all bumper test points; pass if |MCL elongation| <= 22 mm.

text: When tested in accordance with Annex 5, paragraph 1. (Flexible lower legform impactor), the maximum dynamic anterior cruciate ligament and posterior cruciate ligament elongation shall not exceed 13 mm.
quote: the maximum dynamic anterior cruciate ligament and posterior cruciate ligament elongation shall not exceed 13 mm
condition: Flexible lower legform test applies (lower bumper height below 425 mm, or 425-500 mm and chosen by manufacturer).
test_case: Perform flexible lower legform impacts per Annex 5 para. 1; pass if ACL and PCL elongations each <= 13 mm.

text: When tested in accordance with Annex 5, paragraph 1. (Flexible lower legform impactor), the absolute value of dynamic bending moments at the tibia shall not exceed 340 Nm.
quote: The absolute value of dynamic bending moments at the tibia shall not exceed 340 Nm.
condition: Flexible lower legform test applies (lower bumper height below 425 mm, or 425-500 mm and chosen by manufacturer).
test_case: Perform flexible lower legform impacts per Annex 5 para. 1; pass if |tibia bending moment| <= 340 Nm at all tibia segments.

text: Where the manufacturer nominates bumper test widths (relaxation zone) up to a maximum of 264 mm in total, the absolute value of the tibia bending moment in those widths shall not exceed 380 Nm.
quote: the manufacturer may nominate bumper test widths up to a maximum of 264 mm in total where the absolute value of the tibia bending moment shall not exceed 380 Nm
condition: Manufacturer nominates a relaxation zone and the Contracting Party does not restrict it.
test_case: Check nominated relaxation widths total <= 264 mm and that measured |tibia bending moment| <= 380 Nm within them.

text: For vehicles with a lower bumper height at the test position which is greater than, or equal to, 425 mm and less than 500 mm, the requirements of either paragraph 5.1.1. or 5.1.2., at the choice of the manufacturer, shall be applied.
quote: For vehicles with a lower bumper height at the test position which is greater than, or equal to, 425 mm and less than 500 mm
condition: Lower bumper height at the test position is between 425 mm and 500 mm.
test_case: Measure the lower bumper height; if 425-500 mm, verify the test report applies either paragraph 5.1.1. or 5.1.2. as chosen by the manufacturer.

text: For vehicles with a lower bumper height at the test position of greater than, or equal to, 500 mm, the requirements of paragraph 5.1.2. (upper legform to bumper) shall be applied.
quote: For vehicles with a lower bumper height at the test position of greater than, or equal to, 500 mm the requirements of paragraph 5.1.2. shall be applied.
condition: Lower bumper height at the test position is 500 mm or more.
test_case: Measure the lower bumper height; if at least 500 mm, verify the upper legform to bumper test of paragraph 5.1.2. is applied.

text: The flexible lower legform impactor shall be certified pursuant to Annex 6, paragraph 1.
quote: The flexible lower legform impactor shall be certified pursuant to Annex 6, paragraph 1.
condition: Flexible lower legform test applies.
test_case: Review the impactor certification record against Annex 6 para. 1 before testing.

text: When tested in accordance with Annex 5, paragraph 2. (upper legform to bumper), the instantaneous sum of the impact forces with respect to time shall not exceed 7.5 kN.
quote: the instantaneous sum of the impact forces with respect to time shall not exceed 7.5 kN
condition: Upper legform to bumper test applies (lower bumper height at least 500 mm, or 425-500 mm and chosen by manufacturer).
test_case: Perform upper legform to bumper impacts per Annex 5 para. 2; pass if summed impact force <= 7.5 kN at all times.

text: When tested in accordance with Annex 5, paragraph 2. (upper legform to bumper), the bending moment on the test impactor shall not exceed 510 Nm.
quote: the bending moment on the test impactor shall not exceed 510 Nm
condition: Upper legform to bumper test applies (lower bumper height at least 500 mm, or 425-500 mm and chosen by manufacturer).
test_case: Perform upper legform to bumper impacts per Annex 5 para. 2; pass if impactor bending moment <= 510 Nm.

text: The upper legform impactor shall be certified pursuant to Annex 6, paragraph 2.
quote: The upper legform impactor shall be certified pursuant to Annex 6, paragraph 2.
condition: Upper legform to bumper test applies.
test_case: Review the upper legform impactor certification against Annex 6 para. 2.

text: In the case of a vehicle fitted with an ARHSS which could change the vehicle height at the front axle more than 20 mm from the nominal for any vehicle speed between 25 and 40 km/h, the legform to bumper provisions of paragraph 5.1. shall, in addition to the normal running condition, be met for all adjustable vehicle steady heights corresponding to vehicle speeds from 25 up to 40 km/h.
quote: the provisions of paragraphs 5.1. and 5.2. shall, in addition to the normal running condition as specified by the manufacturer for a vehicle speed of 40 km/h, be met
condition: Target vehicle is fitted with an ARHSS changing front axle height more than 20 mm between 25 and 40 km/h.
test_case: Test or simulate legform to bumper impacts at all ARHSS steady heights for 25-40 km/h; pass if paragraph 5.1. limits are met.

text: For vehicles fitted with an ARHSS, the legform impactor to be used is the legform impactor as used for the legform to bumper test in normal running conditions for a speed of 40 km/h.
quote: The legform impactor to be used is the legform impactor as used for the legform to bumper test in normal running conditions for a speed of 40 km/h.
condition: Target vehicle is fitted with an ARHSS.
test_case: Verify the same legform impactor type as in the normal ride height test is used for ARHSS height tests.

text: For vehicles fitted with an ARHSS, with the agreement of the technical service, compliance shall be demonstrated by a limited number of legform tests or by numerical simulation so that the biomechanical limits set out in paragraph 5.1.1. and paragraph 5.1.2. respectively are met.
quote: compliance shall be demonstrated by a limited number of legform tests or by numerical simulation according to the specification set out in paragraph 5.3
condition: Target vehicle is fitted with an ARHSS.
test_case: Review legform test or simulation results at ARHSS heights; pass if 5.1.1./5.1.2. biomechanical limits are met.

text: At the time of testing, the test facility and the vehicle or sub-system shall have a relative humidity of 40 per cent ± 30 per cent and stabilized temperature of 20 ºC ± 4 ºC.
quote: the test facility and the vehicle or sub-system shall have a relative humidity of 40 per cent ± 30 per cent
test_case: Record test facility and vehicle/bumper conditioning data; pass if relative humidity is 10-70 % and stabilized temperature is 16-24 °C at the time of testing.

text: The impact test site shall consist of a flat, smooth and hard surface with a slope not exceeding 1 per cent.
quote: The test site shall consist of a flat, smooth and hard surface with a slope not exceeding 1 per cent.
test_case: Survey the test site surface; pass if it is flat, smooth and hard with slope ≤ 1 %.

text: Either a complete vehicle, or a cut-body, adjusted to the conditions of paragraphs 3.1.1. and 3.1.2. shall be used for the pedestrian impact test.
quote: Either a complete vehicle, or a cut-body, adjusted to the following conditions shall be used for the test.
test_case: Check the test report/setup; pass if a complete vehicle or a cut-body including the front bumper assembly, prepared per 3.1.1/3.1.2, was used.

text: The vehicle shall be in its normal ride attitude, and shall be either securely mounted on raised supports or at rest on a flat horizontal surface with the parking brake applied.
quote: The vehicle shall be in its normal ride attitude, and shall be either securely mounted on raised supports or at rest
test_case: Verify vehicle ride height against normal ride attitude and mounting/parking brake condition before impact; pass if conforming.

text: The cut-body shall include, in the test, all parts of the vehicle front structure, all under-bonnet components and all components behind the windscreen that may be involved in a frontal impact with a vulnerable road user, to demonstrate the performance and interactions of all the contributory vehicle components.
quote: The cut-body shall include, in the test, all parts of the vehicle front structure, all under-bonnet components
condition: Testing performed on a cut-body rather than a complete vehicle
test_case: Inspect the cut-body; pass if the complete front bumper assembly (fascia, absorber, beam, grille, lamps, sensors) and all other front-structure parts involved in pedestrian impact are present.

text: The cut-body shall be securely mounted in the normal vehicle ride attitude.
quote: The cut-body shall be securely mounted in the normal vehicle ride attitude.
condition: Testing performed on a cut-body rather than a complete vehicle
test_case: Check the cut-body fixture and measured attitude; pass if rigidly mounted at the normal ride attitude.

text: All devices designed to protect vulnerable road users when impacted by the vehicle shall be correctly activated before and/or be active during the relevant test.
