quote: All devices designed to protect vulnerable road users when impacted by the vehicle shall be correctly activated before and/or be active
condition: Presence of active pedestrian protection devices interacting with the bumper
test_case: Verify activation status of any pedestrian protection devices before/during the test; pass if correctly activated/active.

text: It shall be the responsibility of the manufacturer to show that any devices designed to protect vulnerable road users will act as intended in a pedestrian impact.
quote: It shall be the responsibility of the manufacturer to show that any devices will act as intended in a pedestrian impact.
condition: Presence of active pedestrian protection devices interacting with the bumper
test_case: Review manufacturer evidence (simulation/test) of device deployment in pedestrian impact; pass if intended function is demonstrated.

text: For vehicle components which could change shape or position, other than active devices to protect pedestrians, and which have more than one fixed shape or position, the vehicle shall comply with the components in each fixed shape or position.
quote: For vehicle components which could change shape or position, other than active devices to protect pedestrians, and which have more than one fixed shape
condition: Bumper components (e.g. towing eye cover, active grille shutters) that have more than one fixed shape or position
test_case: Identify movable bumper components and test/assess lower leg impact in each fixed position; pass if limits are met in all positions.

text: For each lower legform test, the impactor (femur, knee joint and tibia) shall be covered by flesh and skin composed of synthetic rubber sheets (R1, R2) and neoprene sheets (N1F, N2F, N1T, N2T, N3) as shown in Figure 1, with sheet sizes within the requirements described in Figure 1.
quote: For each test the impactor (femur, knee joint and tibia) shall be covered by flesh and skin composed of synthetic rubber sheets
test_case: Inspect the impactor flesh and skin set-up against Figure 1; pass if sheet types and sizes conform.

text: The flexible lower legform impactor flesh and skin sheets are required to have compression characteristics as shown in Figure 2, checked using material from the same batch as the sheets used for the impactor flesh and skin.
quote: The sheets are required to have compression characteristics as shown in Figure 2.
test_case: Review compression test records of same-batch material; pass if within Figure 2 corridors.

text: All lower legform impactor components shall be stored for a sufficient period of time in a controlled storage area with a stabilized temperature of 20 °C ± 4 °C prior to impactor removal for testing, and after removal shall not be subjected to conditions other than those pertaining in the test area as defined in Annex 3, paragraph 1.1.
quote: All impactor components shall be stored for a sufficient period of time in a controlled storage area with a stabilized temperature of 20 °C ± 4 °C
test_case: Check storage temperature log; pass if 20 °C ± 4 °C maintained before test.

text: For the lower legform testing, a horizontal and vertical impact tolerance of ±10 mm shall apply.
quote: For the lower legform testing, a horizontal and vertical impact tolerance of ±10 mm shall apply.
test_case: Compare actual vs. target impact point; pass if within ±10 mm horizontally and vertically.

text: During contact between the lower legform impactor and the vehicle, the impactor shall not contact the ground or any object which is not part of the vehicle.
quote: During contact between the impactor and the vehicle, the impactor shall not contact the ground or any object which is not part of the vehicle.
test_case: Review high-speed video; pass if no ground or foreign object contact during the impact.

text: The impact velocity of the lower legform impactor when striking the bumper shall be 11.1 m/s ± 0.2 m/s.
quote: The impact velocity of the impactor when striking the bumper shall be 11.1 m/s ± 0.2 m/s.
test_case: Measure impact velocity; pass if 10.9–11.3 m/s.
merged: The impact velocity of the upper legform impactor when striking the bumper shall be 11.1 m/s ± 0.2 m/s.

text: The effect of gravity shall be taken into account when the lower legform impact velocity is obtained from measurements taken before the time of first contact.
quote: The effect of gravity shall be taken into account when the impact velocity is obtained from measurements taken before the time of first contact.
test_case: Review velocity evaluation for gravity correction.

text: The tibia bending moments of the flexible lower legform impactor shall not exceed ±15 Nm within an evaluation interval of 30 ms immediately prior to impact.
quote: The tibia bending moments shall not exceed +/- 15 Nm within an evaluation interval of 30 ms immediately prior to impact.
test_case: Evaluate tibia moment channels over 30 ms before impact; pass if |M| ≤ 15 Nm.

text: The offset compensation shall be done with the flexible lower legform impactor in resting position prior to the test/acceleration phase.
quote: The offset compensation shall be done with the flexible lower legform impactor in resting position prior to the test/acceleration phase.
test_case: Check data acquisition log shows offset zeroing with impactor at rest before launch.

text: Each lower legform to bumper test shall be completed within two hours of when the impactor to be used is removed from the controlled storage area.
quote: Each test shall be completed within two hours of when the impactor to be used is removed from the controlled storage area.
test_case: Compare storage removal and impact timestamps; pass if ≤ 2 h.
merged: Each upper legform to bumper test shall be completed within two hours of when the impactor to be used is removed from the controlled storage area.

text: The selected measuring points for the lower legform to bumper tests shall be in the bumper test area as defined in paragraph 2.14. of this Regulation.
quote: The selected measuring points shall be in the bumper test area as defined in paragraph 2.14. of this Regulation.
test_case: Mark the bumper test area on the vehicle and verify all impact points lie within it.
merged: The selected measuring points for the upper legform to bumper tests shall be in the bumper test area as defined in paragraph 2.14. of this Regulation.

text: A minimum of three lower legform to bumper tests shall be carried out, one each to the middle and the outer thirds of the bumper test area at positions judged to be the most likely to cause injury.
quote: A minimum of three lower legform to bumper tests shall be carried out, one each to the middle and the outer thirds of the bumper test area
test_case: Review test plan; pass if at least one test in each third of the bumper test area at worst-case positions.

text: The lower legform to bumper tests shall be to different types of structure, where they vary throughout the area to be assessed.
quote: Tests shall be to different types of structure, where they vary throughout the area to be assessed.
test_case: Check that selected points cover the different bumper structures (e.g. beam, crash box, fog lamp, sensor locations).

text: The selected lower legform test points shall be a minimum of 84 mm apart as measured horizontally and perpendicular to the longitudinal median plane of the vehicle.
quote: The selected test points shall be a minimum of 84 mm apart as measured horizontally and perpendicular to the longitudinal median plane of the vehicle.
test_case: Measure lateral spacing between test points; pass if ≥ 84 mm.

text: The positions tested by the laboratories in the lower legform to bumper tests shall be indicated in the test report.
quote: The positions tested by the laboratories shall be indicated in the test report.
test_case: Check the test report lists all tested positions.

text: For the lower legform to bumper test, the direction of the impact velocity vector shall be in the horizontal plane and parallel to the longitudinal vertical plane of the vehicle, with a tolerance of ±2° in the horizontal plane and in the longitudinal plane at the time of first contact.
quote: The direction of the impact velocity vector shall be in the horizontal plane and parallel to the longitudinal vertical plane of the vehicle.
test_case: Measure velocity vector direction at first contact; pass if within ±2°.

text: For the lower legform to bumper test, the axis of the impactor shall be perpendicular to the horizontal plane with a roll and pitch angle tolerance of ±2° in the lateral and longitudinal plane.
quote: The axis of the impactor shall be perpendicular to the horizontal plane with a roll and pitch angle tolerance of ±2°
test_case: Measure impactor roll and pitch at first contact; pass if within ±2°.

text: The bottom of the lower legform impactor (without parts needed for the purposes of launching and/or protection) shall be at 75 mm above ground reference plane at the time of first contact with the bumper, with a ±10 mm tolerance.
quote: The bottom of the impactor (without parts needed for the purposes of launching and/or protection) shall be at 75 mm above ground reference plane
test_case: Measure impactor bottom height at first contact (high-speed video); pass if 75 ± 10 mm.

text: When setting the height of the propulsion system for the lower legform test, an allowance shall be made for the influence of gravity during the period of free flight of the impactor.
quote: When setting the height of the propulsion system, an allowance shall be made for the influence of gravity during the period of free flight
test_case: Review launcher set-up calculation for gravity drop compensation.

text: The lower legform impactor for the bumper tests shall be in "free flight" at the moment of impact.
quote: The lower legform impactor for the bumper tests shall be in "free flight" at the moment of impact.
test_case: Verify from video that the impactor is detached from the launcher at impact.

text: The lower legform impactor shall be released to free flight at such a distance from the vehicle that the test results are not influenced by contact of the impactor with the propulsion system during rebound of the impactor.
quote: The impactor shall be released to free flight at such a distance from the vehicle that the test results are not influenced by contact
test_case: Verify from video that no rebound contact with the propulsion system occurs during the measurement.

text: At the time of first contact the lower legform impactor shall have the intended orientation about its vertical axis, for the correct operation of its knee joint, with a yaw angle tolerance of ±5°.
quote: At the time of first contact the impactor shall have the intended orientation about its vertical axis, for the correct operation of its knee joint
test_case: Measure impactor yaw at first contact; pass if within ±5°.

text: For each upper legform to bumper test the foam flesh shall be two new sheets of 25 mm thick foam type CF-45 or equivalent cut from the sheet used for the dynamic certification test, with a 1.5 mm thick fibre reinforced rubber skin, and the mass of foam and skin together shall be 0.6 kg ± 0.1 kg.
quote: For each test the foam flesh shall be two new sheets of 25 mm thick foam type CF-45 or equivalent
condition: Upper legform to bumper test applies to the vehicle (instead of lower legform test, depending on bumper height)
test_case: Inspect and weigh foam and skin; pass if specification met and mass 0.6 ± 0.1 kg.

text: The upper legform test impactor or at least the foam flesh shall be stored during a period of at least four hours in a controlled storage area with a stabilized humidity of 35 per cent ± 15 per cent and a stabilized temperature of 20 °C ± 4 °C prior to removal for test.
quote: shall be stored during a period of at least four hours in a controlled storage area with a stabilized humidity of 35 per cent ± 15 per cent
condition: Upper legform to bumper test applies to the vehicle
test_case: Check storage logs for ≥ 4 h at 35 ± 15 % RH and 20 ± 4 °C.

text: A minimum of three upper legform to bumper tests shall be carried out, one each to the middle and the outer thirds of the bumper test area at positions judged to be the most likely to cause injury, to different types of structure where they vary, with measuring points a minimum of 84 mm apart as measured horizontally and perpendicular to the longitudinal median plane of the vehicle.
quote: A minimum of three upper legform to bumper tests shall be carried out, one each to the middle and the outer thirds of the bumper test area
condition: Upper legform to bumper test applies to the vehicle
test_case: Review test plan for ≥ 3 tests covering each third, different structures and ≥ 84 mm spacing.

text: For the upper legform to bumper test, the direction of impact shall be parallel to the longitudinal axis of the vehicle, with the axis of the upper legform vertical at the time of first contact, with a tolerance of ±2°.
quote: The direction of impact shall be parallel to the longitudinal axis of the vehicle, with the axis of the upper legform vertical at the time of first contact.
condition: Upper legform to bumper test applies to the vehicle
test_case: Measure impact direction and impactor axis; pass if within ±2°.

text: At the time of first contact the upper legform impactor centre line shall be vertically midway between the upper bumper reference line and the lower bumper reference line with a ±10 mm tolerance, and the impactor vertical centre line shall be positioned laterally with the selected impact location with a tolerance of ±10 mm.
quote: the impactor centre line shall be vertically midway between the upper bumper reference line and the lower bumper reference line with a ±10 mm tolerance
condition: Upper legform to bumper test applies to the vehicle
test_case: Measure impactor position at first contact against bumper reference lines; pass if within ±10 mm vertically and laterally.

text: Adult headform tests shall be made to the front structure within the boundaries as defined in paragraph 2.1. of this UN Regulation.
quote: Tests shall be made to the front structure within the boundaries as defined in paragraph 2.1. of this UN Regulation.
condition: Bumper fascia or its upper parts lie within the adult bonnet top test area (bumper geometry unknown)
test_case: Map the bumper surface against the adult headform test area boundaries of paragraph 2.1. and confirm impact points are selected within them.

text: The selected measuring points for the adult headform impactor shall be a minimum of 165 mm apart and within the adult headform test areas defined in paragraphs 2.1. and 2.44. of this UN Regulation.
quote: The selected measuring points for the adult headform impactor shall be a minimum of 165 mm apart and within the adult headform test areas
condition: Bumper fascia or its upper parts lie within the adult bonnet top test area (bumper geometry unknown)
test_case: Measure distances between selected points with a taut flexible tape along the outer surface; pass if each is at least 165 mm and inside the test area.

text: No adult headform measuring point shall be located so that the impactor will impact the test area with a glancing blow resulting in a more severe second impact outside the test area.
quote: No measuring point shall be located so that the impactor will impact the test area with a glancing blow resulting in a more severe second impact
condition: Bumper fascia or its upper parts lie within the adult bonnet top test area (bumper geometry unknown)
test_case: Review impact point selection near the bumper/bonnet edge; pass if no point produces a glancing blow with a more severe second impact outside the test area.

text: For the adult headform testing, a longitudinal and transversal impact tolerance of ±10 mm shall apply, measured along the surface of the bonnet or the windscreen.
quote: For the adult headform testing, a longitudinal and transversal impact tolerance of ±10 mm shall apply.
condition: Bumper fascia or its upper parts lie within the adult bonnet top test area (bumper geometry unknown)
test_case: Measure actual impact location versus target point along the surface; pass if deviation is within ±10 mm longitudinally and transversally.

text: The adult headform velocity at the time of impact shall be 9.7 m/s ± 0.2 m/s.
quote: The headform velocity at the time of impact shall be 9.7 m/s ± 0.2 m/s.
condition: Bumper fascia or its upper parts lie within the adult bonnet top test area (bumper geometry unknown)
test_case: Record impactor speed at impact; pass if within 9.5 to 9.9 m/s.

text: The direction of adult headform impact shall be in the longitudinal vertical plane of the vehicle to be tested at an angle of 65° ± 2° to the horizontal.
quote: The direction of impact shall be in the longitudinal vertical plane of the vehicle to be tested at an angle of 65° ± 2° to the horizontal.
condition: Bumper fascia or its upper parts lie within the adult bonnet top test area (bumper geometry unknown)
test_case: Verify impactor launch direction in the longitudinal vertical plane; pass if angle to horizontal is 63° to 67°.

text: The direction of adult headform impact of tests to the front structure shall be downward and rearward.
quote: The direction of impact of tests to the front structure shall be downward and rearward.
condition: Bumper fascia or its upper parts lie within the adult bonnet top test area (bumper geometry unknown)
test_case: Check test setup; pass if impactor travels downward and rearward onto the front structure.

text: The flexible lower legform impactor used for the lower legform to bumper tests shall be certified according to the inverse certification (IC) test procedure prescribed in paragraph 1.4. of this annex before starting a vehicle test series.
quote: First, the certification shall be conducted according to the inverse certification (IC) test procedure prescribed in paragraph 1.4. of this annex before starting a vehicle test series.
test_case: Review the impactor certification records and confirm that a valid IC certification exists before the first bumper test of the series.

text: The ongoing certification testing of the flexible lower legform impactor shall follow the sequence IC - PC - PC - IC - PC - PC - etc. with a maximum of 10 tests between each certification.
quote: Ongoing certification testing then shall constitute the sequence IC - PC - PC - IC - PC - PC - etc. with a maximum of 10 tests between each certification.
test_case: Check the test log and confirm that no more than 10 bumper tests were run between consecutive impactor certifications in the IC-PC-PC sequence.

text: The flexible lower legform impactor shall be certified according to the static certification procedures prescribed in paragraph 1.2. at least once a year.
quote: In addition, the impactor shall be certified according to the procedures prescribed in paragraph 1.2. below at least once a year.
test_case: Confirm that the static certification record of the impactor is dated within one year of the bumper test.

text: Where the upper legform impactor is used for the bumper test, the upper legform impactor shall be re-certified if more than one year has elapsed since the previous certification or if any impactor transducer output, in any impact, has exceeded the specified CAC.
quote: The impactor shall also be re-certified if more than one year has elapsed since the previous certification or if any impactor transducer output, in any impact, has exceeded the specified CAC.
condition: Upper legform to bumper test applies (lower bumper height above the limit for lower legform testing); bumper height not stated.
test_case: Check the upper legform certification date and the test data for CAC exceedances before accepting the bumper test results.

text: A separate approval is required for each lamp listed in paragraph 1 (e.g. the front direction indicator lamp).
quote: A separate approval is required for each lamp listed in paragraph 1.
test_case: Check that a separate R148 approval exists for the front direction indicator lamp function.

text: When two or more lamps are part of the same unit of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, approval may be granted only if each of these lamps satisfies the provisions set out in this Regulation or in another Regulation.
quote: approval may be granted only if each of these lamps satisfy the provisions set out in this Regulation or in another Regulation.
condition: The front direction indicator is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with another lamp (e.g. fog lamp, position lamp, DRL).
test_case: Review approvals of each function in the unit; each function must comply with R148 or another applicable Regulation.

text: Lamps not satisfying the provisions of any of those Regulations shall not be part of such unit of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps.
quote: Lamps not satisfying the provisions of any of those Regulations shall not be part of such unit of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps.
condition: The front direction indicator is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with another lamp.
test_case: Verify no non-approved lighting function is integrated into the lamp unit.

text: All the devices of an interdependent lamp system must be submitted for type approval by the same applicant.
quote: All the devices of an interdependent lamp system must be submitted for type approval by the same applicant.
condition: The direction indicator is an interdependent lamp system.
test_case: Check approval documentation shows all interdependent lamps submitted by one applicant.

text: The front direction indicator lamp shall be identified by the symbol 1, 1a, 1b, 11, 11a, 11b or 11c (paragraph 5.6.) as listed in Table 1.
quote: Front direction indicator lamp 1, 1a, 1b, 11, 11a, 11b, 11c 5.6.
test_case: Check the approval marking on the indicator shows the correct category symbol from Table 1.

text: The front position lamp shall be identified by the symbol A (paragraph 5.1.) as listed in Table 1.
quote: Front position lamp A 5.1.
condition: A front position lamp is integrated in the bumper lamps.
test_case: Check marking shows symbol A.

text: The daytime running lamp shall be identified by the symbol RL (paragraph 5.4.) as listed in Table 1.
quote: Daytime running lamp RL 5.4.
condition: A daytime running lamp is integrated in the bumper lamps.
test_case: Check marking shows symbol RL.

text: The side marker lamp shall be identified by the symbol SM1 (all vehicle categories) or SM2 (M1 vehicles) (paragraph 5.7.) as listed in Table 1.
quote: Side marker lamp for all vehicle categories SM1 5.7. Side marker lamp for M1 vehicles SM2 5.7.
condition: A side marker lamp is integrated in the bumper lamps.
test_case: Check marking shows symbol SM1 or SM2.

text: Every device belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the approval marking and other markings as defined in paragraphs 3.3.3.2. to 3.3.3.6.
quote: Every device belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the approval marking and other markings
test_case: Inspect lamp drawings/sample for a marking space large enough for all required markings.

text: All markings shall be clearly legible and indelible.
quote: All markings shall be clearly legible and indelible,
test_case: Visually inspect markings and perform rub test; markings remain legible.

text: With regard to the size of the approval marking, the value for "a" shall be at least 5 mm.
quote: With regard to the size of the approval marking the value for “a” shall be at least 5 mm.
test_case: Measure the approval mark dimension "a"; it must be ≥ 5 mm.

text: The approval marking shall consist of the approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.
quote: The approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.
test_case: Inspect marking for circle with E and country number.

text: The approval marking shall consist of the four to six-digit sequential number, being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2.
quote: The four to six-digit sequential number, being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2.
test_case: Inspect marking for a 4–6 digit sequential number matching the approval number.

text: The sequential number shall be placed close to the approval mark.
quote: This sequential number shall be placed close to the approval mark.
test_case: Verify sequential number is positioned adjacent to the E-circle.

text: The approval marking shall consist of the symbols identifying the light signalling lamps prescribed in paragraph 3.2.4.
quote: The symbols identifying the light signalling lamps prescribed in paragraph 3.2.4.
test_case: Inspect marking for the function symbol(s) according to Table 1.

text: The approval marking shall consist of the number of this Regulation followed by the letter 'R' and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force at the time of issue of the approval.
quote: The number of this Regulation followed by the letter 'R' and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force
test_case: Inspect marking for "148R" followed by the two-digit series (e.g. 00/01).

text: On lamps which cannot be mounted on either side of the vehicle indiscriminately, the approval marking shall include a horizontal arrow showing in which position the lamp is to be mounted.
quote: On lamps which cannot be mounted on either side of the vehicle indiscriminately, a horizontal arrow showing in which position the lamp is to be mounted.
condition: The side-corner indicator lamps are handed (not mountable on either side).
test_case: Inspect handed lamps for a horizontal arrow in the marking.

text: For direction indicators of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a, 2b, 11, 11a, 11b, 11c and 12, the arrow shall be directed outwards from the vehicle.
quote: The arrow shall be directed outwards from the vehicle in the case of: (a) Direction indicators categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a, 2b, 11, 11a, 11b, 11c and 12;
condition: The front direction indicator lamps are handed.
test_case: Verify arrow on handed indicator points outwards from vehicle when installed.

text: For front position lamps or front end-outline marker lamps, the arrow shall be directed outwards from the vehicle.
quote: (b) Front or rear position lamps, front or rear end-outline marker lamps;
condition: A handed front position lamp or end-outline marker lamp is integrated.
test_case: Verify arrow points outwards from vehicle.

text: If applicable, to the right side of the symbol mentioned in paragraph 3.2.4., the additional letter "D" shall be marked on lamps which may be used as part of an assembly of two independent lamps.
quote: (a) The additional letter "D", on lamps which may be used as part of an assembly of two independent lamps;
condition: The lamp may be used as part of an assembly of two independent lamps.
test_case: Inspect marking for letter D to the right of the function symbol.
merged: If applicable, to the right side of the symbol mentioned in paragraph 3.2.4., the additional letter "Y" shall be marked on lamps which are used as part of an interdependent lamps system.

text: On lamps with reduced light distribution (see paragraph 1.1. of Annex 3), the approval marking shall include a vertical arrow starting from a horizontal segment and directed downwards.
quote: On lamps with reduced light distribution, see paragraph 1.1. of Annex 3, a vertical arrow starting from a horizontal segment and directed downwards.
condition: The lamp has reduced light distribution (low mounting height).
test_case: Inspect marking for downward vertical arrow from horizontal segment.

text: Lamps shall bear the approval marking.
quote: Lamps shall bear the approval marking.
test_case: Inspect lamp sample for the complete approval marking.

text: Lamps shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
quote: Lamps shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant
test_case: Inspect lamp for applicant trade name or mark.

text: Lamps, with the exception of lamps with non-replaceable light sources, shall bear a marking indicating the category or categories of light source(s) prescribed.
quote: Lamps shall, with the exception of lamps with non-replaceable light sources, bear a marking indicating: (a) The category or categories of light source(s) prescribed;
condition: The lamp uses replaceable light sources.
test_case: Inspect lamp for light source category marking.

text: Where the lamp has been approved for LED substitute light source(s), the lamp shall also bear a marking indicating the category or categories of the LED substitute light source(s).
quote: in the case where the lamp has been approved for LED substitute light source(s), also the category or categories of the LED substitute light source(s);
condition: The lamp is approved for LED substitute light sources.
test_case: Inspect lamp for LED substitute light source category marking.

text: Lamps with non-replaceable light sources shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage.
quote: in the case of lamps with: ... (d) Non-replaceable light sources.
condition: The LED light sources are non-replaceable.
test_case: Inspect lamp for rated voltage or voltage range marking.

text: Lamps with an electronic light source control gear shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage.
quote: Lamps shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage, in the case of lamps with: (a) An electronic light source control gear;
condition: The lamp has an electronic light source control gear.
test_case: Inspect lamp for rated voltage or voltage range marking.

text: Lamps with a variable luminous intensity control shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage.
quote: in the case of lamps with: ... (b) A variable luminous intensity control;
condition: The lamp has variable luminous intensity control.
test_case: Inspect lamp for rated voltage or voltage range marking.

text: Lamps with a secondary operating mode shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage.
quote: in the case of lamps with: ... (c) A secondary operating mode;
condition: The lamp has a secondary operating mode.
test_case: Inspect lamp for rated voltage or voltage range marking.

text: In case replaceable light source module(s) are used, the light source module(s) shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
quote: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, bear the following markings. (a) On the light source module(s): (i) The trade name or mark of the applicant;
condition: Replaceable light source modules are used.
test_case: Inspect module for applicant trade name or mark.

text: In case replaceable light source module(s) are used, the light source module(s) shall bear the specific identification code of the module, comprising the starting letters "MD" followed by the approval mark without the circle as prescribed in paragraph 3.3.2.1.1, followed by additional symbols or characters where several non-identical modules are used.
quote: This specific identification code shall comprise the starting letters “MD” for “MODULE” followed by the approval mark without the circle
condition: Replaceable light source modules are used.
test_case: Inspect module for identification code starting with MD and approval mark without circle.

text: In case replaceable light source module(s) are used, the light source module(s) shall bear the rated voltage(s) or the range of voltage.
quote: (iii) The rated voltage(s) or the range of voltage.
condition: Replaceable light source modules are used.
test_case: Inspect module for rated voltage or voltage range marking.
merged: In case replaceable light source module(s) are used, the lamp shall bear the rated voltage(s) or the range of voltage.

text: In case replaceable light source module(s) are used, the lamp shall bear the specific identification code of the module as prescribed in paragraph 3.3.3.5. (a), (ii).
quote: (b) On the lamp: (i) The specific identification code of the module as prescribed in paragraph 3.3.3.5. (a), (ii);
condition: Replaceable light source modules are used.
test_case: Inspect lamp for module identification code.

text: The approval mark in the module identification code does not have to be the same as the one on the lamp in which the module is used, but both marks shall be from the same applicant.
quote: The approval mark does not have to be the same as the one on the lamp in which the module is used, but both marks shall be from the same applicant;
condition: Replaceable light source modules are used.
test_case: Compare module and lamp approval marks; both from same applicant.

text: An electronic light source control gear or variable luminous intensity control being part of the lamp, but not included into the lamp body, shall be marked with its identification number and the name of the manufacturer.
quote: An electronic light source control gear or variable luminous intensity control being part of the lamp, but not included into the lamp body, shall be marked
condition: The lamp has external electronic light source control gear or variable intensity control not included in the lamp body.
test_case: Inspect external control gear for identification number and manufacturer name.

text: The approval marking shall be placed on an inner or outer part (transparent or not) of the lamp which is not designed to be separated from the transparent part of the lamp emitting the light.
quote: The approval marking shall be placed on an inner or outer part (transparent or not) of the lamp which is not designed to be separated
test_case: Verify marking location is on a part not separable from the light-emitting lens.

text: The approval marking as well as the category or categories of LED substitute light source(s) prescribed, if any, shall be visible when the lamp is fitted on the vehicle or when a movable part such as the hood or boot lid or a door is opened.
quote: the approval marking as well as the category or categories of LED substitute light source(s) prescribed, if any, shall be visible when the lamp is fitted
test_case: With lamp installed in the bumper on the vehicle, verify the approval marking is visible (possibly after opening a movable part).

text: If the outer lens of a device is designed to be separated from the main body, the approval marking shall be placed on both the detachable lens and the main body.
quote: If the outer lens of a device is designed to be separated from the main body, the approval marking shall be placed on both
condition: The outer lens is designed to be detachable from the main body.
test_case: Inspect detachable lens and main body; both bear the approval marking.

text: In case an outer lens is used for several devices and bearing different approval markings, the main body of each device shall bear only the approval marking of the function(s) of that device.
quote: the main body of each device shall bear only the approval marking of the function(s) of that device.
condition: A common outer lens is shared by several devices with different approvals (e.g. indicator and fog lamp).
test_case: Inspect each device main body; only its own function approval markings present.

text: The approval marking and the markings in paragraphs 3.3.3.2., 3.3.3.3., 3.3.3.4., 3.3.3.5. (b) and 3.3.3.6. shall be affixed on the lamp.
quote: The approval marking and the markings in paragraphs 3.3.3.2., 3.3.3.3., 3.3.3.4., 3.3.3.5. (b) and 3.3.3.6. shall be affixed on the lamp.
test_case: Verify all listed markings are physically on the lamp.

text: The markings in paragraph 3.3.3.5.(a) shall be affixed on the component (light source module).
quote: The markings in paragraphs 3.3.3.5.(a) shall be affixed on the component.
condition: Replaceable light source modules are used.
test_case: Verify module markings are on the module itself.

text: Where a single approval mark is affixed to grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps complying with the requirements of several UN Regulations, the approval mark shall be visible after their installation.
quote: This marking may be located anywhere on the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, provided that: It is visible after their installation;
condition: Direction indicator is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with other lamps and a single approval mark is used
test_case: Inspect the lamp installed in the bumper and confirm the single approval mark is visible.

text: Where a single approval mark is affixed to grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, no part of the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps that transmits light can be removed without at the same time removing the approval mark.
quote: No part of the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps that transmits light can be removed without at the same time removing the approval mark.
condition: Direction indicator is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with other lamps and a single approval mark is used
test_case: Inspect the lamp construction and confirm no light-transmitting part can be removed without removing the approval mark.

text: The size of the components of a single approval mark shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks by the pertinent UN Regulations under which approval has been granted.
quote: The size of the components of a single approval mark shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks
condition: A single approval mark is used for grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps
test_case: Measure the components of the single approval mark and compare with the minimum sizes of the individual marks.

text: Each lamp submitted for approval shall conform to the requirements set forth in paragraphs 4. and 5.
quote: Each lamp submitted for approval shall conform to the requirements set forth in paragraphs 4. and 5.
test_case: Review the test report to confirm the direction indicator lamp meets all requirements of paragraphs 4 and 5.

text: The requirements contained in sections 5 "General specifications" and 6 "Individual specifications" (and in the Annexes referenced in the said sections) of UN Regulations Nos. 48, 53, 74 or 86, and their series of amendments in force at the time of application for the lamp type approval shall apply to the lamp.
quote: The requirements contained in sections 5 "General specifications" and 6 "Individual specifications" (and in the Annexes referenced in the said sections) of UN Regulations Nos. 48, 53, 74 or 86
test_case: Verify the lamp against the applicable sections 5 and 6 of UN R48 in force at the time of application.

text: The requirements pertinent to each lamp and to the category/ies of vehicle on which the lamp is intended to be installed shall be applied, where its verification at the moment of lamp type approval is feasible.
quote: The requirements pertinent to each lamp and to the category/ies of vehicle on which the lamp is intended to be installed shall be applied
test_case: Check that the R48 requirements pertinent to the front direction indicator on M1 vehicles that are verifiable at lamp approval were verified.

text: The lamps must be so designed and constructed that in normal conditions of use, and notwithstanding the vibrations to which they may be subjected in such use, their satisfactory operation remains assured and they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation.
quote: The lamps must be so designed and constructed that in normal conditions of use, and notwithstanding the vibrations to which they may be subjected in such use
test_case: Perform vibration/durability assessment and confirm the lamp still operates and meets photometric and colorimetric requirements.

text: If a front position lamp incorporates one or more infrared radiation generators, the photometric and colour requirements for this front position lamp shall be met with and without the operation of the infrared radiation generator(s).
quote: the photometric and colour requirements for this front position lamp shall be met with and without the operation of the infrared radiation generator(s).
condition: Bumper contains a front position lamp incorporating infrared radiation generators
test_case: Measure photometry and colour of the front position lamp with IR generators on and off.

text: Direction indicator lamps shall not incorporate a logo.
quote: Stop lamps, direction indicator lamps, and reversing lamps shall not incorporate a logo.
test_case: Inspect the direction indicator lamp optics and outer lens and confirm no logo is incorporated.

text: If a manufacturer logo is incorporated in the internal structure of the optical components and/or the texture of the outer lens inside the apparent surface of a lamp (function), only one manufacturer logo shall be incorporated and all requirements for the specific function of this Regulation shall be fulfilled.
quote: may incorporate only one manufacturer logo build by transparent or non-transparent components provided that all requirements for the specific function of this Regulation are fulfilled
condition: A lamp function other than the direction indicator (e.g. position lamp, DRL) is present and incorporates a logo
test_case: Inspect the lamp for number of logos and verify photometric compliance of the function with the logo.

text: If a logo is incorporated in a lamp, irrespective of the marking requirements in paragraph 3.3., only the logo of the brand name of the vehicle manufacturer or the body manufacturer is allowed.
quote: Irrespective of the marking requirements in paragraph 3.3., only the logo of the brand name of the vehicle manufacturer or the body manufacturer is allowed.
condition: A lamp function other than the direction indicator is present and incorporates a logo
test_case: Inspect the logo and confirm it is the vehicle or body manufacturer brand logo.

text: If a logo is incorporated in a lamp, the enclosed light emitting surface of the logo (incorporating transparent and non-transparent components of the logo) of such a lamp in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 100 cm2.
quote: the enclosed light emitting surface of the logo (incorporating transparent and non-transparent components of the logo) of such a lamp in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 100 cm2.
condition: A lamp function other than the direction indicator is present and incorporates a logo
test_case: Measure the logo light emitting surface projected in the reference axis direction and confirm it is at most 100 cm2.

text: In a single lamp containing more than one light source, a group of light sources, wired so that the failure of any one of them causes all of them to stop emitting light, shall be considered to be one light source.
quote: a group of light sources, wired so that the failure of any one of them causes all of them to stop emitting light, shall be considered to be one light source.
condition: The LED lamp contains more than one light source
test_case: Review the LED wiring schematic and confirm series-wired groups are treated as one light source in the failure analysis.

text: In case of failure of any one light source in a single lamp containing more than one light source, either the light intensity shall comply with the minimum intensity required in the pertinent table of standard light distribution as shown in Annex 3 and when all light sources are illuminated the maximum intensities shall not be exceeded, or a signal for activation of a tell-tale indicating failure, as indicated in paragraphs 6.4.8., 6.7.8., 6.9.8, 6.10.8., 6.11.8., 6.12.8., 6.13.8. and 6.18.8. of UN Regulation No. 48, shall be produced.
quote: In case of failure of any one light source in a single lamp containing more than one light source, at least one of the following provisions shall apply
condition: Bumper contains a lamp other than the direction indicator (e.g. front position or side marker lamp) with more than one light source
test_case: Simulate failure of each light source and measure intensities against Annex 3 minima, or verify the tell-tale failure signal is produced.

text: For daytime running lamps, in case of failure of any one light source in a single lamp containing more than one light source, either the light intensity at the points of standard light distribution defined in paragraph 2.2. of Annex 3 shall be at least 80 per cent of the minimum intensity required, or a signal for activation of a tell-tale indicating failure, as indicated in paragraph 6.19.8. of UN Regulation No. 48, shall be produced.
quote: The light intensity at the points of standard light distribution defined in paragraph 2.2. of Annex 3 shall be at least 80 per cent of the minimum intensity required
condition: Bumper contains a daytime running lamp with more than one light source
test_case: Simulate single light source failure and confirm intensities are at least 80 % of minimum or a tell-tale signal is produced.

text: For direction-indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a, 2b, 11, 11a, 11b, 11c and 12 containing more than one light source, a signal for activation of the tell-tale prescribed in paragraph 6.5.8. of Regulation No. 48 or paragraph 6.3.8. of Regulation No. 53 shall be produced on the basis of either option (a) any one light source has failed; (b) in the case of a lamp designed for only two light sources, the intensity in the axis of reference is less than 50 per cent of the minimum intensity required; or (c) as a consequence of a failure of one or more light sources, the intensity in one of the directions H=0°, V=0°; H=20° outwards to the outside of the vehicle, V=+5°; H=10° inwards to the inside of the vehicle, V=0°, as indicated in paragraph 2.1. of Annex 3, is less than the minimum intensity required.
quote: A signal for activation of the tell-tale prescribed in paragraph 6.5.8. of Regulation No. 48 or paragraph 6.3.8. of Regulation No. 53 shall be produced on the basis of either option a), b) or c)
condition: The LED front direction indicator contains more than one light source
test_case: Simulate light source failures and verify the failure signal for the tell-tale is produced according to the declared option (a), (b) or (c).

text: The lamp shall only be equipped with replaceable light source(s) approved according to UN Regulations Nos. 37, 99 and/or 128, provided that no restriction on the use is made at the time of application for type approval, and/or light source module(s) and/or non-replaceable light source(s).
quote: The lamp shall only be equipped with: - replaceable light source(s) approved according to UN Regulations Nos. 37, 99 and/or 128
test_case: Inspect the lamp and confirm its LED light sources are R128-approved replaceable sources, light source modules or non-replaceable light sources.

text: In case of replaceable UN approved light source(s), the design of the lamp shall be such that the light source(s) can be fixed in no other position but the correct one.
quote: The design of the lamp shall be such that the light source(s) can be fixed in no other position but the correct one;
condition: Lamp uses replaceable UN approved LED light sources
test_case: Attempt to fit the light source in incorrect orientations and confirm only the correct position is possible.

text: In case of replaceable UN approved light source(s), the light source(s) holder shall conform to the characteristics given in IEC Publication 60061, applying the holder data sheet relevant to the category of light source(s) prescribed and, where a category of LED substitute light source(s) is also prescribed, the holder data sheet relevant to the category of LED substitute light source(s).
quote: The light source(s) holder shall conform to the characteristics given in IEC Publication 60061. The holder data sheet relevant to the category of light source(s) prescribed, applies.
condition: Lamp uses replaceable UN approved LED light sources
test_case: Gauge the holder against the relevant IEC 60061 data sheet.

text: Light Signalling Devices shall not generate radiated or power line disturbances, which cause a malfunction of other electric/electronic systems of the vehicle.
quote: Light Signalling Devices shall not generate radiated or power line disturbances, which cause a malfunction of other electric/electronic systems of the vehicle.
test_case: Perform EMC emission testing (e.g. per UN R10) and confirm no malfunction of other vehicle electronic systems.

text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that it can only be fitted in the designated and correct position and can only be removed with the use of tool(s).
quote: it can only be fitted in the designated and correct position and can only be removed with the use of tool(s);
condition: Lamp uses replaceable light source modules
test_case: Attempt incorrect fitting and tool-less removal of the module; both must be impossible.

text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that it is tamperproof.
quote: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that (a) ... (b) it is tamperproof;
condition: Lamp uses replaceable light source modules
test_case: Inspect the module design and confirm it cannot be opened or manipulated without destruction.

text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), regardless of the use of tool(s), the light source module shall not be interchangeable with any replaceable UN approved light source and/or any other replaceable light source module having different characteristics that is located in the same lamp housing.
quote: regardless of the use of tool(s), it is not interchangeable with: - any replaceable UN approved light source; and/or, - any other replaceable light source module
condition: Lamp uses replaceable light source modules
test_case: Attempt to fit approved light sources and other modules of the same housing into the module seat; none must fit.

text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), when the light source module is removed and replaced by another module provided by the applicant and bearing the same light source module identification code, the photometric requirements of the device shall be met.
quote: when the light source module is removed and replaced by another module provided by the applicant and bearing the same light source module identification code, the photometric requirements of device shall be met.
condition: Lamp uses replaceable light source modules
test_case: Replace the module with another of the same identification code and re-measure photometry against the requirements.

text: All measurements, photometric and colorimetric, shall be made with respect to the conditions of paragraph 4.8., with the particulars of the methods of measurement given in Annex 3.
quote: All measurements, photometric and colorimetric, shall be made with respect to the following conditions. (Particulars of the methods of measurement to be used are given in Annex 3):
test_case: Review the test report to confirm photometric and colorimetric measurements followed paragraph 4.8 and Annex 3.

text: In the case of replaceable UN approved light sources, all measurements shall be made using standard light sources as specified in R.E.5.
quote: In the case of replaceable UN approved light sources, all measurements shall be made using standard light sources as specified in R.E.5.
condition: Lamp uses replaceable UN approved LED light sources
test_case: Confirm the test report records use of R.E.5 standard light sources for measurements.

text: In the case of replaceable UN approved light source(s) controlled by an electronic light source control gear or variable intensity control, the standard light source(s) shall have a luminous flux value that does not deviate more than 5 per cent from its reference/objective luminous flux value when test voltage is applied.
quote: the standard light source(s) shall have a luminous flux value that does not deviate more than 5 per cent from its reference/objective luminous flux value
condition: Lamp uses replaceable UN approved light sources controlled by electronic light source control gear or variable intensity control
test_case: Measure luminous flux of the standard light source at test voltage; pass if within ±5 % of reference/objective flux.

text: In the case of a lamp equipped with light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s), all measurements shall be made with the light source(s) present in the lamp.
quote: all measurements shall be made with the light source(s) present in the lamp
condition: LED front direction indicator uses light source modules or non-replaceable light sources
test_case: Verify photometric test report shows measurements performed with the LED sources installed in the lamp.

text: In case of a lamp (function) using light sources which are subject to more than one of the conditions prescribed in paragraph 4.8., the photometric measurements shall be made separately, in accordance with each applicable condition(s) set forth in paragraph 4.8.
quote: the photometric measurements shall be made separately, in accordance with each applicable condition(s) set forth in paragraph 4.8.
condition: Lamp uses light sources subject to more than one condition of paragraph 4.8
test_case: Check test report for separate photometric measurements per applicable light source condition.

text: In case of a lamp (function) using light sources which are subject to more than one of the conditions prescribed in paragraph 4.8., all separate measurement results shall be added together.
quote: All separate measurement results shall be added together.
condition: Lamp uses light sources subject to more than one condition of paragraph 4.8
test_case: Verify reported intensities equal the sum of the separate measurement results.

text: During photometric measurements of the front direction indicator, stray reflections shall be avoided by appropriate masking.
quote: During photometric measurements, stray reflections shall be avoided by appropriate masking.
test_case: Inspect photometric setup for masking that prevents stray reflections.

text: In the case where the lamp may be installed on the vehicle in more than one or in a field of different positions, the photometric measurements shall be repeated for each position or for the extreme positions of the field of the reference axis specified by the manufacturer.
quote: the photometric measurements shall be repeated for each position or for the extreme positions of the field of the reference axis specified by the manufacturer
condition: Lamp may be installed in more than one or a field of positions
test_case: Check that photometric measurements were repeated for each position or extreme positions of the reference axis field.

text: In the case where the lamp, at the discretion of the applicant, also has to be approved with LED substitute light source(s), all measurements, photometric and colorimetric, shall be repeated using the LED substitute light source(s) prescribed.
quote: all measurements, photometric and colorimetric, shall be repeated using the LED substitute light source(s) prescribed
condition: Lamp is also to be approved with LED substitute light sources
test_case: Verify photometric and colorimetric measurements are repeated with the prescribed LED substitute light sources.

text: If not otherwise specified, the intensities of the front direction indicator shall be measured with the light source continuously lit.
quote: If not otherwise specified, the intensities shall be measured with the light source continuously lit.
test_case: Verify photometric measurements are taken with steady (non-flashing) operation.

text: In case the results of measurements should be challenged, the distance of measurement shall be such that the law of the inverse of the square of the distance is applicable.
quote: The distance of measurement shall be such that the law of the inverse of the square of the distance is applicable
test_case: Check measurement distance satisfies inverse-square law conditions.

text: In case the results of measurements should be challenged, the measuring equipment shall be such that the angular aperture of the receiver viewed from the reference centre of the light is comprised between 10' and 1 degree.
quote: the angular aperture of the receiver viewed from the reference centre of the light is comprised between 10' and 1 degree
test_case: Verify receiver angular aperture is between 10' and 1°.

text: In case the results of measurements should be challenged, the intensity requirement for a particular direction of observation shall be deemed to be satisfied if that requirement is met in a direction deviating by not more than one-quarter of a degree from the direction of observation.
quote: shall be deemed to be satisfied if that requirement is met in a direction deviating by not more than one-quarter of a degree
test_case: Check intensity compliance within ±0.25° of each test direction.

text: The limits of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the front direction indicator lamp shall be determined.
quote: The limits of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of a light-signalling lamp shall be determined.
test_case: Verify the apparent surface limits in the reference axis direction are documented.

text: Unless otherwise specified, the voltage supplied at the lamp for testing shall be either 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems).
quote: the voltage supplied at the lamp shall be either 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems)
test_case: Verify test supply voltage at lamp terminals is 13.5 V (12 V system) or as applicable.

text: In case of a lamp controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control, the lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant.
quote: In case of a lamp controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control, the lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant
condition: Lamp is controlled by electronic light source control gear or variable intensity control
test_case: Verify lamp operated per applicant's specified conditions during tests.

text: In case of a lamp not controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control, in the case of light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s), the lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant.
quote: in the case of light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s) the lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant
condition: LED lamp has modules/non-replaceable sources and no electronic control gear
test_case: Verify lamp operated per applicant's specification during tests.

text: In case of a lamp not controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control, in the case of replaceable UN approved light source(s), the light sources shall be operated at the reference/objective luminous flux or alternatively at a different luminous flux with a proportional correction on the measured luminous intensities.
quote: the light sources shall be operated at the reference/objective luminous flux or alternatively at a different luminous flux with a proportional correction
condition: Lamp uses replaceable UN approved light sources without control gear
test_case: Verify sources operated at reference flux or intensities proportionally corrected.

text: In case of lamps equipped with multiple replaceable UN approved light sources, the light sources shall be operated at a voltage or electrical current setting such that the actual luminous fluxes of the light sources do not deviate by more than 5 per cent from the average luminous flux of the light sources.
quote: shall be operated at a voltage or electrical current setting such that the actual luminous fluxes of the light sources do not deviate by more than 5 per cent
condition: Lamp has multiple replaceable UN approved light sources
test_case: Measure each source flux; pass if within ±5 % of average.

text: In case of lamps equipped with multiple replaceable UN approved light sources, the measured luminous intensities shall be corrected proportionally for the difference between the average luminous flux and the applicable reference/objective luminous flux.
quote: The measured luminous intensities shall be corrected proportionally for the difference between the average luminous flux and the applicable reference/objective luminous flux.
condition: Lamp has multiple replaceable UN approved light sources
test_case: Verify intensities in the report are proportionally corrected to reference flux.

text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, on the reference axis (HV), be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
quote: On the reference axis (HV), be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
test_case: Measure intensity at HV on both samples; pass if ≥ minimum of paragraph 5 table.

text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall in no direction where the lamp is visible exceed the maximum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
quote: In no direction where the lamp is visible, exceed the maximum, specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
test_case: Scan visible directions on both samples; pass if no value exceeds the paragraph 5 maximum.

text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, outside the reference axis, be not less than the product of the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5 by the percentage specified in the pertinent light distribution figure in Annex 3 for each direction in question, or be not less than the intensity value specified in the pertinent light distribution figure in Annex 3 for each direction in question.
quote: Outside the reference axis, - be not less than the product of the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
test_case: Measure grid points of Annex 3 figure; pass if each ≥ required percentage or value.

text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, within the angles of geometric visibility defined in the tables in Annex 2, be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
quote: Within the angles of geometric visibility defined in the tables in Annex 2, be not less than the minimum specified in the table
test_case: Measure within Annex 2 geometric visibility angles; pass if ≥ specified minimum.

text: The provisions of the relevant paragraphs of Annex 3 on local variations of intensity shall be observed.
quote: The provisions of the relevant paragraphs of Annex 3 on local variations of intensity shall be observed.
test_case: Check measured distribution against Annex 3 local variation provisions.

text: When an assembly of two independent lamps, to be type approved as lamps marked "D" and having the same function, is deemed to be a single lamp, it shall comply with the requirements for maximum intensity if all lamps together are lit.
quote: it shall comply with the requirements for: (a) Maximum intensity if all lamps together are lit
condition: Lamp is an assembly of two independent lamps marked "D"
test_case: Measure with both lamps lit; pass if maximum not exceeded.

text: When an assembly of two independent lamps, to be type approved as lamps marked "D" and having the same function, is deemed to be a single lamp, it shall comply with the requirements for minimum intensity if either lamp has failed.
quote: (b) Minimum intensity if either lamp has failed.
condition: Lamp is an assembly of two independent lamps marked "D"
test_case: Measure with each lamp failed in turn; pass if minimum met.

text: An interdependent lamp system shall meet the requirements when all its interdependent lamps are operated together.
quote: An interdependent lamp system shall meet the requirements when all its interdependent lamps are operated together.
condition: Direction indicator is an interdependent lamp system
test_case: Measure with all interdependent lamps operated together; pass if requirements met.

text: The variable intensity control shall not generate signals which cause luminous intensities outside the range specified in paragraph 5.
quote: The variable intensity control shall not generate signals which cause luminous intensities: Outside the range specified in paragraph 5.
condition: Lamp has a variable intensity control
test_case: Operate variable intensity control across range; pass if intensities stay within paragraph 5 range.

text: The variable intensity control shall not generate signals which cause luminous intensities exceeding the respective steady luminous intensity maximum specified in paragraph 5 for the specific lamp: for systems depending only on daytime and night-time conditions under night-time conditions; for other systems under standard conditions.
quote: Exceeding the respective steady luminous intensity maximum specified in paragraph 5. for the specific lamp
condition: Lamp has a variable intensity control
test_case: Measure under night-time/standard conditions; pass if steady maximum not exceeded.

text: Tests for compliance of the luminous intensities shall be carried out according to Annex 8.
quote: Tests for compliance of the luminous intensities shall be carried out according to Annex 8.
test_case: Verify luminous intensity tests follow Annex 8 procedure.

text: The colour of the light emitted shall be measured inside the field of the light distribution grid defined for the specific function in the relevant paragraph of Annex 3.
quote: The colour of the light emitted shall be measured inside the field of the light distribution grid defined for the specific function
test_case: Measure chromaticity within the Annex 3 grid field.

text: Outside the field of the light distribution grid no sharp variation of colour shall be observed.
quote: Outside this field no sharp variation of colour shall be observed.
test_case: Visually inspect colour outside the grid field; pass if no sharp variation.

text: To check the colorimetric characteristics, the test procedure described in paragraph 4.8. shall be applied.
quote: To check these colorimetric characteristics, the test procedure described in paragraph 4.8. shall be applied.
test_case: Verify colorimetric tests use paragraph 4.8 conditions.

text: For lamps equipped with non-replaceable light sources, the colorimetric characteristics should be verified with the light sources present in the lamp, in accordance with relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 4.8.
quote: for lamps equipped with non-replaceable light sources, the colorimetric characteristics should be verified with the light sources present in the lamp
condition: LED light sources are non-replaceable
test_case: Verify colorimetry measured with LEDs installed in the lamp.

text: For lamps (functions) using different light source technologies, the colorimetric characteristics shall be checked for each light source technology separately according to the applicable provisions in paragraphs 4.8.1. and 4.8.2.
quote: the colorimetric characteristics shall be checked for each light source technology separately
condition: Lamp uses different light source technologies
test_case: Check colorimetric results reported separately per light source technology.

text: For front position lamps (A, MA) and front end-outline marker lamps (AM), the light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall have a minimum luminous intensity of 4 cd on the reference axis as given in Table 3.
quote: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 3.
condition: Bumper includes a front position lamp
test_case: Measure HV intensity; pass if ≥ 4 cd.

text: For front position lamps (A, MA) and front end-outline marker lamps (AM), the maximum luminous intensity shall not exceed 140 cd when used as a single lamp and 70 cd when used as a lamp marked "D", as given in Table 3.
condition: Bumper includes a front position lamp
test_case: Scan intensity; pass if ≤ 140 cd (single) or ≤ 70 cd ("D").

text: For front position lamps (A, MA) and front end-outline marker lamps (AM), the standard light distribution shall meet Figure A3-I as given in Table 3.
quote: Standard light distribution (Par. 4.8.3.1. (c)) Angles of geometric visibility (Par. 4.8.3.1. (d))
condition: Bumper includes a front position lamp
test_case: Measure Figure A3-I grid; pass if each point meets required percentage.

text: For front position lamps (A, MA) and front end-outline marker lamps (AM), the minimum luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility of Table A2-1 shall be 0.05 cd as given in Table 3.
quote: Minimum luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility: See Table 3.
condition: Bumper includes a front position lamp
test_case: Measure within Table A2-1 angles; pass if ≥ 0.05 cd.

text: For front position lamps (A, MA) and front end-outline marker lamps (AM), the failure provisions of paragraph 4.6 shall apply.
quote: Failure provisions: See paragraph 4.6.
condition: Bumper includes a front position lamp
test_case: Verify compliance with paragraph 4.6 failure provisions.

text: The colour of the light emitted by front position lamps (A) and front end-outline marker lamps (AM) shall be white; the lamp identified by symbol MA may be amber.
quote: The colour of the light emitted shall be white, however the lamp identified by symbol MA may be amber.
condition: Bumper includes a front position lamp
test_case: Measure chromaticity; pass if within white boundaries (or amber for MA).

text: The colour of light emitted by front parking lamps shall be white.
quote: The colour of light emitted shall: (a) For front parking lamps be white
condition: A front parking lamp function is integrated in the bumper.
test_case: Colorimetric measurement; pass if white.

text: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied of the daytime running lamp shall meet the requirements in Table 6: minimum 4.00∙10² cd, maximum 1.20∙10³ cd as a single lamp or 6.00∙10² cd for a lamp marked "D", standard light distribution of Figure A3-II and angles of geometric visibility of Table A2-1 with a minimum of 1.0 cd.
quote: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 6.
condition: A daytime running lamp is integrated in the bumper.
test_case: Photometric measurement against Table 6; pass if within limits.

text: In case the luminous intensity of the daytime running lamp is intended to be reduced according to paragraph 6.19.7. of the 08 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 48, the reduced designed maximum luminous intensity shall not exceed 1.40∙10² cd.
quote: the reduced designed maximum luminous intensity shall not exceed 1.40∙102 cd
condition: A daytime running lamp with reduced intensity mode is integrated.
test_case: Measure in reduced mode; pass if maximum ≤140 cd.

text: The area of the apparent surface in the direction of the axis of reference of the daytime running lamp shall be not less than 25 cm² and not more than 200 cm².
quote: shall be not less than 25 cm2 and not more than 200 cm2
condition: A daytime running lamp is integrated in the bumper.
test_case: Measure apparent surface; pass if 25–200 cm².

text: When a daytime running lamp is to be type approved as a lamp marked "D", the apparent surface of such a lamp shall not be more than 100 cm².
quote: the apparent surface of such a lamp shall not be more than 100 cm2
condition: An integrated DRL is approved as a lamp marked "D".
test_case: Measure apparent surface; pass if ≤100 cm².

text: The daytime running lamp shall be subjected to the heat resistance test specified in Annex 6.
quote: The daytime running lamp shall be subjected to the heat resistance test specified in Annex 6.
condition: A daytime running lamp is integrated in the bumper.
test_case: Perform Annex 6 heat test; pass if Annex 6 criteria are met.

text: The daytime running lamp shall meet the failure provisions of paragraph 4.6.
quote: Failure provisions: See paragraph 4.6.
condition: A daytime running lamp is integrated in the bumper.
test_case: Apply paragraph 4.6 failure tests; pass if met.

text: The colour of the light emitted by the daytime running lamp shall be white.
quote: Colour: The colour of the light emitted shall be white.
condition: A daytime running lamp is integrated in the bumper.
test_case: Colorimetric measurement; pass if within white boundaries.

text: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied of the direction indicator lamp shall meet the requirements in Table 8.
quote: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 8
test_case: Goniophotometric measurement of both samples against Table 8 values; pass if all limits are met.

text: In the case of direction indicators of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a, 2b, 11, 11a, 11b, 11c and 12, the minimum luminous intensities of Table 8 shall be fulfilled in the reference axis.
quote: In the case of direction indicators of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a, 2b, 11, 11a, 11b, 11c and 12 in the reference axis
test_case: Measure intensity on the reference axis; pass if at least the Table 8 minimum for the category.

text: For a direction indicator of category 1, the luminous intensity shall be at least 1.75∙10² cd minimum, not exceed 1.20∙10³ cd when used as a single lamp or 6.00∙10² cd for a lamp marked "D", meet the standard light distribution of Figure A3-I and the angles of geometric visibility of Table A2-1 with a minimum luminous intensity of 3∙10⁻¹ cd.
condition: Front direction indicator is of category 1.
test_case: Photometric measurement per Figure A3-I and Table A2-1; pass if within category 1 limits.
merged: For a direction indicator of category 1a, the luminous intensity shall be at least 2.50∙10² cd minimum, not exceed 1.20∙10³ cd when used as a single lamp or 6.00∙10² cd for a lamp marked "D", meet the standard light distribution of Figure A3-I and the angles of geometric visibility of Table A2-1 with a minimum luminous intensity of 3∙10⁻¹ cd.

text: For a direction indicator of category 1b, the luminous intensity shall be at least 4.00∙10² cd minimum, not exceed 1.20∙10³ cd when used as a single lamp or 6.00∙10² cd for a lamp marked "D", meet the standard light distribution of Figure A3-I and the angles of geometric visibility of Table A2-1 with a minimum luminous intensity of 7∙10⁻¹ cd.
condition: Front direction indicator is of category 1b.
test_case: Photometric measurement per Figure A3-I and Table A2-1; pass if within category 1b limits.

text: The minimum luminous intensity of the direction indicator lamp within the angles of geometric visibility shall be as specified in Table 8.
quote: Minimum luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility See Table 8.
test_case: Measure intensity across Table A2-1 angles; pass if not below the Table 8 minimum.

text: In general, the intensities of the direction indicator lamp shall be measured with the light source(s) continuously alight.
quote: In general, the intensities shall be measured with the light source(s) continuously alight.
test_case: Verify test report states measurement with light sources continuously alight, or justified flashing mode.

text: When the direction indicator lamp (e.g. using LEDs) is measured in flashing mode, this shall be achieved by switching with a frequency of f = 1.5 ± 0.5 Hz with the pulse width greater than 0.3 s, measured at 95 per cent peak light intensity.
quote: This shall be achieved by switching with a frequency of f = 1.5 ± 0.5 Hz with the pulse width greater than 0.3 s
condition: Lamp is measured in flashing mode.
test_case: Check flashing test setup frequency and pulse width; pass if 1.5 ± 0.5 Hz and >0.3 s.

text: In all other cases of flashing-mode measurement of the direction indicator lamp, the voltage as required in paragraph 4.8. shall be switched with a rise time and fall time shorter than 0.01 s, with no overshoot.
quote: the voltage as required in paragraph 4.8. shall be switched with a rise time and fall time shorter than 0.01 s; no overshoot is allowed
condition: Lamp is measured in flashing mode.
test_case: Oscilloscope check of supply switching; pass if rise/fall <0.01 s and no overshoot.

text: In the case of measurements of the direction indicator lamp taken in flashing mode, the reported luminous intensity shall be represented by the maximum intensity.
quote: In the case of measurements taken in flashing mode the reported luminous intensity shall be represented by the maximum intensity.
condition: Lamp is measured in flashing mode.
test_case: Review report; pass if maximum intensity is reported for flashing measurements.

text: If the flash of the direction indicator lamp is produced by sequential activation of its light sources, each light source, after its activation, shall remain lit until the end of the ON cycle.
quote: Each light source, after its activation, shall remain lit until the end of the ON cycle
condition: Direction indicator uses sequential activation.
test_case: Observe in flashing mode; pass if each activated segment stays lit until end of ON cycle.

text: If the flash of the direction indicator lamp is produced by sequential activation, the sequence of activation of the light sources shall produce a signal which proceeds in a uniform progressive manner from inboard towards the outboard edge of the light emitting surface.
quote: The sequence of activation of the light sources shall produce a signal which proceeds in a uniform progressive manner from inboard towards the outboard edge
condition: Direction indicator uses sequential activation.
test_case: Visual/video check in flashing mode; pass if progression is uniform inboard to outboard.

text: If the flash of the direction indicator lamp is produced by sequential activation, it shall be one signal with no interruption and no vertical oscillations (e.g. not more than one change of direction along the vertical axis).
quote: It shall be one signal with no interruption and no vertical oscillations (e.g. not more than one change of direction along the vertical axis)
condition: Direction indicator uses sequential activation.
test_case: Video analysis; pass if single uninterrupted signal with at most one vertical direction change.

text: For a sequential direction indicator, the distance between two adjacent/tangential distinct parts of the light emitting surface shall not exceed 50 mm, when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis.
