quote: The distance between two adjacent/tangential distinct parts of the light emitting surface of the sequential direction indicator shall not exceed 50mm
condition: Direction indicator uses sequential activation.
test_case: Measure gaps perpendicular to reference axis; pass if ≤50 mm.

text: For a sequential direction indicator, the variation shall finish no more than 200 ms after the beginning of the ON cycle.
quote: The variation shall finish no more than 200ms after the beginning of the ON cycle
condition: Direction indicator uses sequential activation.
test_case: Time-resolved measurement; pass if sequence completes ≤200 ms after ON start.

text: For a sequential direction indicator, the orthogonal projection of the light emitting surfaces in the direction of the axis of reference shall be circumscribed by a rectangle on a plane normal to the axis of reference with its longer sides parallel to the H-plane, and the ratio of the horizontal to the vertical sides shall not be less than 1.7.
quote: The ratio of the horizontal to the vertical sides shall not be less than 1.7.
condition: Direction indicator uses sequential activation.
test_case: Measure circumscribing rectangle of projected surface; pass if ratio ≥1.7.

text: For a sequential direction indicator, the interruptions of the signal shall not create any overlap in the vertical axis between the different parts, from inboard towards the outboard of the vehicle, and shall not be used for any other lighting or light signalling functions.
quote: These interruptions of the signal shall not create any overlap in the vertical axis between the different parts
condition: Direction indicator uses sequential activation.
test_case: Inspect drawing/lamp; pass if no vertical overlap and gaps not used by other functions.

text: Compliance of the sequential direction indicator with the sequential activation conditions shall be verified in flashing mode.
quote: Compliance to the conditions mentioned above shall be verified in flashing mode.
condition: Direction indicator uses sequential activation.
test_case: Confirm verification performed with lamp operated in flashing mode.

text: The direction indicator lamp shall meet the failure provisions of paragraph 4.6.
quote: Failure provisions. See paragraph 4.6.
test_case: Apply paragraph 4.6 failure tests; pass if requirements are met.

text: The colour of light emitted by the direction indicator lamp shall be amber.
quote: Colour: The colour of light emitted shall be amber.
test_case: Colorimetric measurement; pass if chromaticity within amber boundaries.

text: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied of the side marker lamp shall meet the requirements in Table 9 (SM1: minimum 4.0 cd in the axis of reference, 0.6 cd within the standard light distribution, maximum 25 cd; SM2: minimum 0.6 cd, maximum 25 cd).
quote: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 9.
condition: A side marker lamp is integrated in the bumper corner.
test_case: Photometric measurement against Table 9; pass if within limits.

text: The colour of the light emitted by the side marker lamp shall be amber.
quote: Colour: The colour of the light emitted shall be amber.
condition: A side marker lamp is integrated in the bumper corner.
test_case: Colorimetric measurement; pass if amber.

text: The front direction indicator (categories 1, 1a, 1b) shall have minimum horizontal angles of geometric visibility of 45° inboard and 80° outboard, as specified in Table A2-1.
quote: Front direction indicator (1, 1a, 1b) 45°/80° (20°/80°) a 15°/15° (15°/5°) b
test_case: Measure the unobstructed apparent surface visibility horizontally; pass if visible from 45° inboard to 80° outboard.

text: The front direction indicator (categories 1, 1a, 1b) shall have minimum vertical angles of geometric visibility of 15° above and 15° below the horizontal, as specified in Table A2-1.
quote: Front direction indicator (1, 1a, 1b) 45°/80° (20°/80°) a 15°/15° (15°/5°) b
test_case: Measure vertical visibility; pass if the lamp is visible from 15° above to 15° below the H-plane.

text: The angles of geometric visibility shown in Annex 2 are correct for lamps to be mounted on the right side of the vehicle; the front direction indicators mounted on the left side shall meet the mirror-symmetrical angles.
quote: The angles shown in these arrangements are correct for lamps to be mounted on the right side of the vehicle.
test_case: Check the geometric visibility for left- and right-side front direction indicators using mirrored angle sets; pass if both sides comply.

text: For front direction indicators (categories 1, 1a, 1b) mounted with the H-plane below 750 mm, the reduced minimum horizontal angles of 20° inboard and 80° outboard shall be used only below the H-plane.
quote: a Reduced angles used only below the H-plane for lamps mounted with the H-plane below 750 mm.
condition: Front direction indicator H-plane mounting height below 750 mm (mounting height unknown)
test_case: Verify mounting height < 750 mm and check horizontal visibility below the H-plane is at least 20° inboard / 80° outboard.

text: For front direction indicators (categories 1, 1a, 1b) to be installed with the H-plane of the lamp at a mounting height of less than 750 mm, the minimum vertical angles of geometric visibility shall be 15° above and 5° below.
quote: b For lamps to be installed with the H-plane of the lamp at a mounting height of less than 750 mm.
condition: Front direction indicator H-plane mounting height below 750 mm (mounting height unknown)
test_case: Verify mounting height < 750 mm and check vertical visibility of at least 15° above and 5° below.

text: If the bumper incorporates front position lamps (category A), the front position lamp shall have minimum horizontal angles of 45° inboard / 80° outboard (20°/80° below the H-plane for lamps mounted with the H-plane below 750 mm) and minimum vertical angles of 15° above / 15° below (15°/5° for lamps with the H-plane at a mounting height of less than 750 mm).
condition: Presence of front position lamps in the bumper is unknown
test_case: Measure geometric visibility of the front position lamp; pass if the tabulated angles for its mounting height are met.

text: If the bumper incorporates daytime running lamps (RL), the daytime running lamp shall have minimum horizontal angles of 20° inboard / 20° outboard and minimum vertical angles of 10° above / 5° below.
quote: Daytime running lamps (RL) 20°/20° 10° / 5°
condition: Presence of daytime running lamps in the bumper is unknown
test_case: Measure geometric visibility of the DRL; pass if visible over 20°/20° horizontally and 10° above / 5° below.

text: If the bumper incorporates side direction indicators (category 5), the side direction indicator shall have horizontal angles of 5° / 55° (applying to direction A) and minimum vertical angles of 15° above / 15° below (15° / 5° for lamps mounted with the H-plane below 750 mm).
quote: Side direction indicators (5) 5° / 55° 15° / 15° 15° / 5° b Horizontal angles apply to direction A
condition: Presence of category 5 side direction indicators in the bumper corners is unknown
test_case: Measure geometric visibility of the side direction indicator; pass if tabulated angles are met.

text: If the bumper incorporates side marker lamps of category SM1, the side marker lamp shall have minimum horizontal angles of 45° / 45° and minimum vertical angles of 10° above / 10° below (10° / 5° for lamps mounted with the H-plane below 750 mm).
condition: Presence of SM1 side marker lamps in the bumper is unknown
test_case: Measure geometric visibility of the SM1 side marker; pass if tabulated angles are met.
merged: If the bumper incorporates side marker lamps of category SM2, the side marker lamp shall have minimum horizontal angles of 30° / 30° and minimum vertical angles of 10° above / 10° below (10° / 5° for lamps mounted with the H-plane below 750 mm).

text: Unless specified otherwise, the values shown in Figures A3-I to A3-XV give, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities of the front direction indicator lamps as a percentage of the minimum intensities required, which shall be mathematically rounded down to three significant digits.
quote: the minimum intensities as a percentage of the minimum intensities required, which shall be mathematically rounded down to three significant digits
test_case: Goniophotometric measurement of the front direction indicator; compare each measured direction to the rounded-down percentage of the required minimum and pass if all are met.

text: In the case where the front direction indicator lamps are intended to be installed at a mounting height (using the H plane specified by the manufacturer) equal to or less than 750 mm above the ground, the photometric intensity is verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards.
quote: intended to be installed at a mounting height (using the H plane specified by the manufacturer) equal to or less than 750 mm above the ground
condition: Mounting height of the front direction indicators (H plane) is equal to or less than 750 mm above the ground.
test_case: Check manufacturer's declared mounting height; if ≤750 mm, verify photometric intensities only down to 5° below horizontal and pass if minima are met within that field.

text: In the case where the front position lamps or side marker lamps of the bumper are intended to be installed at a mounting height (using the H plane specified by the manufacturer) equal to or less than 750 mm above the ground, the photometric intensity is verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards.
quote: the photometric intensity is verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards: (a) Front and rear direction indicators lamps; (b) Front and rear position lamps;
condition: Bumper contains front position lamps or side marker lamps mounted at or below 750 mm.
test_case: If such lamps are present and mounted ≤750 mm, verify photometry only down to 5° downwards and pass if minima are met.

text: Within the field of light distribution schematically shown as a grid, the light intensity of the front direction indicator lamps in each direction of a part of the field formed by the grid lines shall meet at least the lowest minimum value being shown on the grid lines surrounding the questioned direction as a percentage.
quote: the light intensity in each direction of a part of the field formed by the grid lines shall meet at least the lowest minimum value
test_case: Scan intensity between grid points of the light distribution; pass if every intermediate direction meets at least the lowest surrounding grid percentage value.

text: The front direction indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a or 1b shall meet the standard light distribution of Figure A3-I, the values giving, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities as a percentage of the minimum intensities required (see Table 8).
quote: direction indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a, 2b, 11, 11a, 11b, 11c, 12. The values shown give, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities
condition: Category of the front direction indicators (1, 1a or 1b) is not stated.
test_case: Measure intensities at Figure A3-I grid points; pass if each value is at least the stated percentage of the Table 8 minimum for the category.

text: If the bumper contains front position lamps, the front position lamps shall meet the standard light distribution of Figure A3-I, the values giving the minimum intensities as a percentage of the minimum intensities required (see Table 3).
quote: Standard light distribution for front and rear position lamps, parking lamps, front and rear end-outline marker lamps
condition: Presence of front position lamps in the bumper is unknown.
test_case: If present, measure at Figure A3-I grid points; pass if each value meets the percentage of the Table 3 minimum.

text: If the bumper contains daytime running lamps, the daytime running lamps shall meet the standard light distribution of Figure A3-II, the values giving the minimum intensities as a percentage of the minimum intensity required (see Table 6).
quote: Standard light distribution for daytime running lamps The values shown give, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities
condition: Presence of daytime running lamps in the bumper is unknown.
test_case: If present, measure at Figure A3-II grid points; pass if each value meets the percentage of the Table 6 minimum.

text: If the bumper contains side marker lamps of category SM1, the SM1 side marker lamps shall meet the light distribution of Figure A3-VII.
quote: SM1 category of side marker lamps Figure A3-VII Light distribution for side marker lamps SM1
condition: Presence of SM1 side marker lamps in the bumper is unknown.
test_case: If present, measure at Figure A3-VII points; pass if minimum values are met.
merged: If the bumper contains side marker lamps of category SM2, the SM2 side marker lamps shall meet the light distribution of Figure A3-VIII.

text: With respect to photometric performance, when testing the photometric performances set forth in paragraph 4.8. of this Regulation of any mass-produced lamp chosen at random, no measured value shall deviate from the values prescribed in paragraph 6.1.3. of this Regulation.
quote: No measured value deviates from the values prescribed in paragraph 6.1.3. of this Regulation.
test_case: Measure the photometric performance of randomly chosen production front direction indicators per paragraph 4.8. and confirm that no value deviates from paragraph 6.1.3.

text: In the case of a lamp equipped with a replaceable light source, if the results of the photometric test do not meet the requirements, tests on lamps shall be repeated using another standard light source.
quote: If, in the case of a lamp equipped with a replaceable light source and if results of the test described above do not meet the requirements
condition: The direction indicator lamp uses a replaceable light source (not stated).
test_case: If a lamp with a replaceable light source fails photometry, repeat the test with another standard light source and check compliance.

text: The chromaticity coordinates of mass-produced lamps shall be complied with when tested under the conditions of paragraph 4.9. of this Regulation.
quote: The chromaticity coordinates shall be complied when tested under conditions of paragraph 4.9. of this Regulation.
test_case: Measure the chromaticity coordinates of production lamps under the conditions of paragraph 4.9. and confirm they lie within the prescribed colour boundaries.

text: If the bumper incorporates a daytime running lamp, the lamp shall be subjected to a one-hour test of continuous operation following a warm-up period of 20 minutes.
quote: The lamp shall be subjected to a one-hour test of continuous operation following a warm-up period of 20 minutes.
condition: A daytime running lamp is integrated in the bumper assembly (not stated in the specification).
test_case: Operate the DRL for a 20 min warm-up and then 1 h continuously, and verify that the test duration is recorded.

text: During the heat resistance test of the daytime running lamp, the ambient temperature shall be 23 °C ± 5 °C.
quote: The ambient temperature shall be 23 °C ± 5 °C.
condition: A daytime running lamp is integrated in the bumper assembly.
test_case: Monitor the ambient temperature during the heat test and verify that it stays within 18-28 °C.

text: For daytime running lamps equipped with non-replaceable light sources (filament light sources and other), the heat resistance test shall be made with the light sources present in the lamp, in accordance with paragraph 5.4.5. of this Regulation.
quote: for lamps equipped with non-replaceable light sources (filament light sources and other), the test shall be made with the light sources present in the lamp
condition: A daytime running lamp with non-replaceable LED light sources is integrated in the bumper assembly.
test_case: Perform the heat test with the lamp's own LED sources under the conditions of paragraph 5.4.5., and verify by test report.

text: For the heat resistance test of the daytime running lamp, the light source used shall be a light source of the category specified for the lamp and shall be supplied with a current at a voltage such that it gives the specified average power at the corresponding test voltage.
quote: The light source used shall be a light source of the category specified for the lamp and shall be supplied with a current
condition: A daytime running lamp with replaceable light sources is integrated in the bumper assembly.
test_case: Verify the light source category, and verify that the supply voltage gives the specified average power during the test.

text: Where only the maximum power is specified, the heat resistance test of the daytime running lamp shall be carried out by regulating the voltage to obtain a power equal to 90 per cent of the specified power.
quote: Where only the maximum power is specified, the test shall be carried out by regulating the voltage to obtain a power equal to 90 per cent
condition: A daytime running lamp is integrated in the bumper assembly and only its maximum power is specified.
test_case: Measure the power during the test and verify that it equals 90 % of the specified maximum power.

text: For daytime running lamps equipped with non-replaceable light sources, the test conditions set in paragraph 5.4.5. or 5.9.5. of this Regulation shall be applied for the heat resistance test.
quote: for lamps equipped with non-replaceable light sources the test conditions set in paragraph 5.4.5. or 5.9.5. of this Regulation shall be applied
condition: A daytime running lamp with non-replaceable light sources is integrated in the bumper assembly.
test_case: Verify that the test voltage and conditions follow paragraph 5.4.5. or 5.9.5.

text: The specified average or maximum power for the heat resistance test shall in all cases be chosen from the rated voltage(s) of 6, 12 or 24 V at which it reaches the highest value.
quote: shall in all cases be chosen from the rated voltage(s) of 6, 12 or 24 V at which it reaches the highest value
condition: A daytime running lamp is integrated in the bumper assembly.
test_case: Check that the test power corresponds to the rated voltage giving the highest power value.

text: In the case of light sources operated by an electronic control gear to obtain variable luminous intensity, the heat resistance test of the daytime running lamp shall be carried out under the conditions given at minimum 90 per cent of the higher luminous intensity.
quote: In the case of light sources operated by an electronic control gear to obtain variable luminous intensity, the test shall be carried out
condition: A daytime running lamp with electronic control gear for variable luminous intensity is integrated in the bumper assembly.
test_case: Set the control gear to give at least 90 % of the higher intensity during the heat test, and verify by measurement.

text: After the daytime running lamp has been stabilized at the ambient temperature following the heat resistance test, no distortion, deformation, cracking or colour modification shall be perceptible.
quote: After the lamp has been stabilized at the ambient temperature, no distortion, deformation, cracking or colour modification shall be perceptible.
condition: A daytime running lamp is integrated in the bumper assembly.
test_case: Visually inspect the lamp after stabilization, and verify that there is no perceptible distortion, deformation, cracking or colour change.

text: In case of doubt after the heat resistance test, the intensity of light of the daytime running lamp shall be measured, and the values shall reach at least 90 per cent of the values obtained before the heat resistance test on the same lamp.
quote: At that measurement the values shall reach at least 90 per cent of the values obtained before the heat resistance test on the same lamp.
condition: A daytime running lamp is integrated in the bumper assembly.
test_case: Measure the photometric values before and after the heat test, and verify that the post-test values are at least 90 % of the pre-test values.

text: For the LED front direction indicator lamps (light source technology other than incandescent), the luminous intensities measured after 1 min and either after 30 minutes of operation or after photometric stability has occurred shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
quote: the luminous intensities measured after 1 min and either - after 30 minutes of operation, or - after photometric stability has occurred shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements
test_case: Measure the luminous intensity distribution after 1 min and after 30 min (or at photometric stability) and verify all test points are within the min/max limits.

text: For the photometric tests of the LED front direction indicator lamps, operation of direction indicator lamps shall be done in flashing mode (f = 1.5 Hz, duty factor 50 per cent).
quote: Operation of direction indicator lamps shall be done in flashing mode (f = 1.5 Hz, duty factor 50 per cent).
test_case: Check the test record shows the indicator was operated at 1.5 Hz with 50 per cent duty factor during the photometric measurements.

text: For any LED front position lamps, daytime running lamps or side marker lamps integrated in the bumper (light source technology other than incandescent), the luminous intensities measured after 1 min and either after 30 minutes of operation or after photometric stability has occurred shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
quote: For all other lamps, the luminous intensities measured after 1 min and either - after 30 minutes of operation, or - after photometric stability has occurred shall comply
condition: Presence of front position lamps, DRL or side marker lamps in the bumper is unknown.
test_case: Measure intensities after 1 min and after 30 min or photometric stability and verify min/max compliance at all test points.

text: Depending on the light source technology, the luminous intensity distribution of the front direction indicator lamps (Cat 1, 2, 11, 12) shall in addition be checked for compliance at 0.2 seconds after switch ON, with HV as reference coordinate, as listed in Table A8-1.
quote: Direction Indicator Cat 1, 2, 11, 12 0.2 HV
test_case: Measure or calculate (via ratio at HV) the intensity distribution at 0.2 s after switch ON and verify compliance with the intensity requirements.

text: Depending on the light source technology, the luminous intensity distribution of any front position lamps shall in addition be checked for compliance at 4 seconds after switch ON, with HV as reference coordinate, as listed in Table A8-1.
quote: Front and rear position 4 HV
condition: Presence of front position lamps in the bumper is unknown.
test_case: Check the intensity distribution at 4 s after switch ON referenced at HV for compliance.
merged: Depending on the light source technology, the luminous intensity distribution of any daytime running lamps shall in addition be checked for compliance at 4 seconds after switch ON, with HV as reference coordinate, as listed in Table A8-1.

Depending on the light source technology, the luminous intensity distribution of any side marker lamps shall in addition be checked for compliance at 4 seconds after switch ON, with HV as reference coordinate, as listed in Table A8-1.

text: In case the front direction indicator lamp (function) uses LED technology only, the lamp (function) is deemed to comply with the corresponding intensity requirements at all points in time, if the values measured according to paragraph 1.2. are compliant.
quote: In case a lamp (function) uses LED technology only, a lamp (function) is deemed to comply with the corresponding intensity requirements at all points in time
test_case: Confirm the lamp uses LED technology only and that the paragraph 1.2 measurements are compliant.

text: In case the lamp (function) uses more than one light generating technology, the corresponding intensity requirements of the lamp (function) shall be tested following the strictest time requirements according to paragraphs 2.1.1. to 2.1.3. for the combination of them and checked for compliance.
quote: the corresponding intensity requirements of a lamp (function) are tested following the strictest time requirements according to paragraphs 2.1.1. to 2.1.3.
condition: Only if a lamp function combines LED with another light generating technology.
test_case: Verify the test timing follows the strictest applicable time requirement and results comply.

text: In case of doubt (e.g. unexpected run-up behaviour), the corresponding minimum intensity requirements of the front direction indicator lamp (function) shall be tested and checked for compliance at all points in time starting at the corresponding point in time listed in Table A8-1 and ending when photometric stability is reached.
quote: In case of doubt (e.g. unexpected run-up behaviour), the corresponding minimum intensity requirements of a lamp (function) are tested and checked for compliance at all points in time
condition: Only in case of doubt about run-up behaviour.
test_case: Record intensity continuously from 0.2 s after switch ON until photometric stability and verify minimum values are met throughout.

text: A separate approval is required for the front fog lamp as a lamp listed in paragraph 1.
quote: A separate approval is required for each lamp listed in paragraph 1.
test_case: Check that the front fog lamp holds its own type approval under UN R149.

text: When the front fog lamp is part of the same assembly of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, approval is granted only if each of these lamps satisfies the requirements of this Regulation or of another Regulation.
quote: approval is granted only if each of these lamps satisfies the requirements of this Regulation or of another Regulation
condition: The front fog lamp is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with other lamps (e.g. direction indicator) in one assembly.
test_case: Check that every lamp in the assembly has a valid approval under R149 or another applicable Regulation.

text: Lamps not satisfying any one of those Regulations shall not be part of an assembly of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps including the front fog lamp.
quote: Lamps not satisfying any one of those Regulations shall not be part of such an assembly of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps.
condition: The front fog lamp is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with other lamps in one assembly.
test_case: Review the assembly's lamp list and confirm no non-compliant lamp is included.

text: The approval number assigned to the front fog lamp type shall be marked on the device following the requirements of paragraph 3.3.
quote: An approval number shall be assigned to each type approved and shall be marked on the device following the requirements of paragraph 3.3.
test_case: Inspect the front fog lamp for the approval number marked as per paragraph 3.3.

text: The front fog lamp shall be identified by the symbol "F3" for a front fog lamp of Class F3, or "YF3" if the device is part of a matched pair, as given in Table 1.
quote: Front fog lamp of Class F3 F3 YF3
test_case: Inspect the approval marking on the fog lamp for the symbol F3 (or YF3 if matched pair).

text: The change index for the front fog lamp of Class F3 shall be 0 for the 00 series of amendments and 1 for the 01 series of amendments, as given in Table 2.
quote: Front fog lamp of Class F3 0 1
test_case: Check that the marked change index matches the series of amendments of the approval per Table 2.

text: Every front fog lamp belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the Unique Identifier as referred to in the 1958 Agreement and other markings as defined in paragraph 3.3.4. or the approval marking and other markings as defined in paragraph 3.3.4.
quote: Every device belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the Unique Identifier as referred to in the 1958 Agreement
test_case: Inspect the fog lamp drawing/sample for a marking space sufficient for the UI or approval marking and other markings.

text: All markings on the front fog lamp shall be clearly legible and indelible.
quote: All markings shall be clearly legible and indelible.
test_case: Visually inspect markings and perform a rub/durability check; markings remain legible.

text: The value for "a" in part 1 of Annex 13 shall be at least 5 mm on plastic material and at least 8 mm on glass.
quote: The value for “a” in part 1 of Annex 13 shall be at least 5 mm on plastic material and at least 8 mm on glass.
test_case: Measure the approval mark dimension "a" on the lamp; ≥5 mm on plastic, ≥8 mm on glass.

text: The approval mark of the front fog lamp shall consist of a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.
quote: The approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.
test_case: Inspect the lamp marking and confirm a circle with letter E and the approving country number is present.

text: The approval mark of the front fog lamp shall include the four to six-digit sequential number being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.2.
quote: The four to six-digit sequential number being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.2.
test_case: Inspect the marking and verify the 4-6 digit sequential approval number matches the approval certificate.

text: The approval mark of the front fog lamp shall include the number of this Regulation followed by the letter 'R' and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force at the time of issue of the approval.
quote: The number of this Regulation followed by the letter 'R' and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force
test_case: Inspect the marking for '149R' followed by the two-digit series of amendments.

text: The approval mark of the front fog lamp shall include the symbol(s) according to Table 1 and, if applicable, the additional symbol(s).
quote: Symbol(s), according to Table 1, and, if applicable, the following additional symbol(s):
test_case: Inspect the marking and verify the front fog lamp class symbol per Table 1 (e.g. F3) is present.

text: Front fog lamps of Class F3 having asymmetric light distribution and which must not be indiscriminately mounted on either side of the vehicle shall bear an arrow pointing to the outside of the vehicle.
quote: Front fog lamps of Class F3 having asymmetric light distribution and which must not be indiscriminately mounted on either side of the vehicle, shall bear an arrow
condition: Fog lamp is Class F3 with asymmetric light distribution not mountable on either side
test_case: For asymmetric F3 lamps, inspect the marking for an arrow pointing to the vehicle outside on each side-specific lamp.

text: In the case of road illumination devices incorporating an outer lens of plastic material, the group of letters "PL" shall be affixed near the symbols identifying the function(s).
quote: In the case of road illumination devices incorporating an outer lens of plastic material, the group of letters "PL" to be affixed near the symbols
test_case: Verify the PC outer lens fog lamp marking shows 'PL' adjacent to the function symbol.

text: The approval number, the symbols and the additional symbols shall be placed close to the circle and either above or below the letter "E", or to the right or left of that letter.
quote: The approval number, the symbols and the additional symbols shall be placed close to the circle and either above or below the letter “E”
test_case: Inspect the marking layout and confirm number and symbols are adjacent to the circle above/below/left/right of the E.

text: The digits of the approval number shall be on the same side of the letter "E" and face the same direction.
quote: The digits of the approval number shall be on the same side of the letter “E” and face the same direction.
test_case: Inspect the marking and confirm all approval number digits are on one side of the E and oriented identically.

text: Unless otherwise specified, each symbol shall be marked individually in accordance with Table 1.
quote: Unless otherwise specified, each symbol shall be marked individually in accordance with Table 1.
test_case: Inspect the marking and confirm each function symbol is marked separately per Table 1.

text: Where the approval marking is replaced by the Unique Identifier, the Unique Identifier mark shall follow the format shown in Figure I.
quote: The Unique Identifier mark shall follow the format in the example shown below: Figure I Unique Identifier (UI)
condition: Unique Identifier used instead of approval marking
test_case: If UI used, compare the marked UI against the Figure I format and check database reference.

text: The front fog lamp shall bear the approval marking or the Unique Identifier.
quote: Road illumination functions or systems shall bear the approval marking or the Unique Identifier, the trade name or mark of the applicant
test_case: Inspect the fog lamp for an approval marking or UI.

text: The front fog lamp shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
quote: Road illumination functions or systems shall bear the approval marking or the Unique Identifier, the trade name or mark of the applicant
test_case: Inspect the fog lamp housing or lens for the applicant's trade name or mark.

text: In the case of front fog lamps with replaceable UN approved light source(s) or with replaceable light source modules, the lamp shall bear a marking indicating the category or categories of light source(s) prescribed and, where approved for LED substitute light source(s), also the category or categories of the LED substitute light source(s).
quote: In the case of lamps with replaceable UN approved light source(s) or with replaceable light source modules, a marking indicating: (a) The category or categories
condition: Lamp uses replaceable UN approved light sources
test_case: If replaceable light sources are used, inspect the marking for the prescribed light source category(ies).

text: In the case of front fog lamps with replaceable light source modules, the lamp shall bear a marking indicating the specific identification code(s) of the light source module(s).
quote: (b) The specific identification code(s) of light source module(s) and
condition: Lamp uses replaceable light source modules
test_case: If replaceable modules are used, check the lamp marking shows the module identification code(s).

text: In the case of front fog lamps with replaceable UN approved light source(s) or with replaceable light source modules, the lamp shall bear a marking indicating the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage.
quote: (c) The rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage.
condition: Lamp uses replaceable light sources or replaceable light source modules
test_case: Inspect the lamp marking for rated voltage or voltage range.

text: In the case of front fog lamps with non-replaceable light source modules, the lamp shall bear a marking indicating the rated voltage(s) or the range of voltage.
quote: In the case of lamps with non-replaceable light source modules a marking indicating the rated voltage(s) or the range of voltage;
condition: Lamp uses non-replaceable LED light source modules
test_case: If modules are non-replaceable, inspect the lamp for rated voltage or voltage range marking.

text: In the case of front fog lamps with replaceable light source module(s), the light source module(s) shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
quote: In the case of lamps with light source module(s), a marking on the light source module(s) indicating: (a) The trade name or mark of the applicant;
condition: Lamp uses replaceable light source modules (non-replaceable modules need not be marked)
test_case: Inspect each replaceable module for the applicant's trade name or mark.

text: In the case of front fog lamps with replaceable light source module(s), the light source module(s) shall bear a specific identification code comprising the starting letters "MD" followed by the markings described in paragraphs 3.3.2.1. (without the circle) and 3.3.2.2. and, where several non-identical modules are used, additional symbols or characters; this code shall be shown in the drawings and the module mark shall be from the same applicant as the lamp mark.
quote: This specific identification code shall comprise the starting letters “MD” for “MODULE” followed by the markings as described in paragraphs 3.3.2.1. (without the circle) and 3.3.2.2.
condition: Lamp uses replaceable light source modules
test_case: Inspect each module for an 'MD' code with E-number and sequential number and compare to drawings.

text: In the case of front fog lamps with replaceable light source module(s), the light source module(s) shall bear the rated voltage or the range of voltage.
quote: (c) The rated voltage or the range of voltage. In the case where the light-source module(s) is non-replaceable, it does not need to be marked;
condition: Lamp uses replaceable light source modules
test_case: Inspect each replaceable module for rated voltage or voltage range marking.

text: In the case an electronic light source control gear, which is part of the front fog lamp but not included into the lamp body, is used to operate a light source or light source module(s), it shall be marked with its specific identification code and the rated input voltage or range of voltage.
quote: In the case an electronic light source control gear, which is part of the lamp but not included into the lamp body, is used
condition: Separate electronic light source control gear outside the lamp body is used
test_case: If external control gear exists, inspect it for identification code and rated input voltage marking.

text: In the case of front fog lamps meeting the requirements of Annex 7 only when supplied with a voltage of 12V, a marking consisting of the Number 24 crossed out by an oblique cross (X) shall be placed near the holders of the light source(s) as shown in Annex 12.
quote: In the case of AFS, front fog lamps and headlamps except Class AS, BS, CS, and DS meeting the requirements of Annex 7 only when supplied with a voltage of 12V
condition: Fog lamp meets Annex 7 only at 12V supply
test_case: If the lamp is 12V-only for Annex 7, verify the crossed-out '24' marking near the light source holders.

text: The Unique Identifier or the approval marking shall be placed on an inner or outer part (transparent or not) of the front fog lamp.
quote: The Unique Identifier or the approval marking shall be placed on an inner or outer part (transparent or not) of the lamp.
test_case: Inspect the lamp and confirm the marking is on an inner or outer part of the lamp.

text: The Unique Identifier or the approval marking, as well as the category or categories of LED substitute light source(s) prescribed, if any, shall be visible when the front fog lamp is fitted on the vehicle or when a movable part such as the hood or boot lid or a door is opened.
quote: the Unique Identifier or the approval marking as well as the category or categories of LED substitute light source(s) prescribed, if any, shall be visible when the lamp is fitted
test_case: With the bumper fitted on the vehicle, check the fog lamp approval marking is visible (possibly after opening a movable part).

text: If the outer lens of the front fog lamp is designed to be separated from the main body, the Unique Identifier or the approval marking shall be placed on both the detachable lens and the main body.
quote: If the outer lens of a device is designed to be separated from the main body, the Unique Identifier or the approval marking shall be placed on both
condition: Outer lens designed to be detachable from the main body
test_case: If the lens is detachable, verify the marking appears on both lens and housing.

text: In case an outer lens is used for several devices and bears different approval markings, the main body of each device shall bear only the approval marking of the function(s) of that device.
quote: In case an outer lens is used for several devices and bearing different approval markings, the main body of each device shall bear only the approval marking
condition: Common outer lens shared with other devices (e.g. direction indicator)
test_case: If the lens is shared, inspect each device body and confirm it bears only its own function's marking.

text: In the case of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps bearing a single Unique Identifier or approval mark, all the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps shall satisfy the pertinent Regulation and the requirements of paragraph 3.3.2. shall apply.
quote: a single Unique Identifier or approval mark may be applied, provided that all the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps satisfy the pertinent Regulation
condition: Fog lamp grouped/combined/reciprocally incorporated with other lamps under a single mark
test_case: If a single mark is used, verify each incorporated lamp's approval and paragraph 3.3.2 marking content.

text: In the case of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps bearing a single Unique Identifier or approval mark, no part of the lamps that transmits light can be removed without at the same time removing the approval mark.
quote: No part of the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps that transmits light can be removed without at the same time removing the approval mark
condition: Fog lamp grouped/combined/reciprocally incorporated with other lamps under a single mark
test_case: Check that every light-transmitting part removed also removes the approval mark.

text: In the case of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps bearing a single Unique Identifier or approval mark, the symbols for each lamp, appropriate to each UN Regulation under which approval has been granted, shall be marked either on the appropriate light-emitting surface or in a group in such a way that each lamp may be clearly identified.
quote: The symbols for each lamp, appropriate to each UN Regulation under which approval has been granted, shall be marked: (i) Either on the appropriate light-emitting surface
condition: Fog lamp grouped/combined/reciprocally incorporated with other lamps under a single mark
test_case: Inspect the marking and confirm each function's symbol is on its light-emitting surface or clearly identifiable in a group.

text: The front fog lamps submitted for approval shall conform to the requirements set forth in paragraphs 4 and 5.
quote: Lamps submitted for approval shall conform to the requirements set forth in paragraphs 4 and 5.
test_case: Verify by test report that the fog lamp meets paragraphs 4 and 5 requirements.

text: The requirements of sections 5 and 6 of UN Regulation No. 48 (and referenced Annexes) pertinent to the front fog lamp and to the M1 category of vehicle on which it is intended to be installed shall be applied, where verification at the moment of lamp type approval is feasible.
quote: The requirements pertinent to each lamp and to the category/ies of vehicle on which the lamp is intended to be installed shall be applied
test_case: Check installation-related R48 provisions verifiable at lamp level (e.g. geometric visibility) are documented as met.

text: The front fog lamps must be so designed and constructed that under normal conditions of use and notwithstanding the vibrations to which they may be subjected in such use, their satisfactory operation remains assured and they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation.
quote: The lamps must be so designed and constructed that under normal conditions of use and notwithstanding the vibrations to which they may be subjected
test_case: Perform vibration/durability evaluation and confirm photometry remains within limits afterwards.

text: The front fog lamps shall be fitted with a device enabling them to be so adjusted on the vehicles as to comply with the rules applicable to them, unless the reflector and diffusing lens cannot be separated and the use of such units is confined to vehicles on which the lamp setting can be adjusted by other means.
quote: Lamps shall be fitted with a device enabling them to be so adjusted on the vehicles as to comply with the rules applicable to them.
test_case: Inspect the fog lamp for an aiming adjustment device or confirm vehicle-side adjustment for indivisible units.

text: For front fog lamps whose adjusting device does not provide horizontal adjustment, the front fog lamps shall be so designed that they can maintain a proper horizontal aiming even after the vertical aiming adjustment.
quote: such a device may or may not provide horizontal adjustment, provided that the headlamps are so designed that they can maintain a proper horizontal aiming
condition: Adjusting device provides vertical adjustment only
test_case: Adjust vertical aim through its range and verify horizontal aim remains within tolerance.

text: The front fog lamp shall only be equipped with replaceable light source(s) approved according to UN Regulations Nos. 37, 99 and/or 128, provided that no restriction on the use is made at the time of application for type approval, and/or light source module(s) and/or non-replaceable light source(s).
quote: The lamp shall only be equipped with: - replaceable light source(s) approved according to UN Regulations Nos. 37, 99 and/or 128
test_case: Inspect the lamp's light source(s) and confirm each is an approved replaceable light source, a light source module or a non-replaceable light source.

text: In case of replaceable UN approved light source(s), the design of the front fog lamp shall be such that the light source(s) can be fixed in no other position but the correct one.
quote: The design of the lamp shall be such that the light source(s) can be fixed in no other position but the correct one
condition: Lamp uses replaceable UN approved light source(s)
test_case: Attempt to insert the light source in incorrect orientations; pass if only the correct position is possible.

text: In case of replaceable UN approved light source(s), the light source(s) holder of the front fog lamp shall conform to the characteristics given in IEC Publication 60061, the holder data sheet relevant to the category of light source(s) prescribed applying.
quote: The light source(s) holder shall conform to the characteristics given in IEC Publication 60061. The holder data sheet relevant to the category
condition: Lamp uses replaceable UN approved light source(s)
test_case: Check holder dimensions against the relevant IEC 60061 data sheet; pass if within the specified characteristics.

text: In case of replaceable UN approved light source(s), where a category of LED substitute light source(s) is also prescribed, the light source holder of the front fog lamp shall conform to the holder data sheet relevant to the category of LED substitute light source(s).
quote: where a category of LED substitute light source(s) is also prescribed, the holder data sheet relevant to the category of LED substitute light source(s) applies
condition: Lamp uses replaceable light sources and an LED substitute light source category is also prescribed
test_case: Check holder against the IEC 60061 data sheet for the LED substitute light source category; pass if conforming.

text: The front fog lamp shall not generate radiated or power line disturbances which cause a malfunction of other electric/electronic systems of the vehicle.
quote: Road illumination devices shall not generate radiated or power line disturbances, which cause a malfunction of other electric/electronic systems of the vehicle.
test_case: Perform EMC emission testing at vehicle level; pass if no malfunction of other vehicle electric/electronic systems occurs.

text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) of the front fog lamp shall be such that it can only be fitted in the designated and correct position.
quote: the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that (a) it can only be fitted in the designated and correct position
condition: Lamp uses replaceable light source module(s)
test_case: Attempt to fit the module in other positions; pass if only the designated correct position is possible.

text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) of the front fog lamp shall be such that it can only be removed with the use of tool(s).
quote: it can only be fitted in the designated and correct position and can only be removed with the use of tool(s)
condition: Lamp uses replaceable light source module(s)
test_case: Attempt removal of the module by hand; pass if removal requires tool(s).

text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) of the front fog lamp shall be such that it is tamperproof.
quote: (b) it is tamperproof
condition: Lamp uses replaceable light source module(s)
test_case: Inspect module construction; pass if it cannot be opened or modified without visible damage.

text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), regardless of the use of tool(s), the light source module(s) of the front fog lamp shall not be mechanically interchangeable with any replaceable UN approved light source.
quote: regardless of the use of tool(s), it is not mechanically interchangeable with: - any replaceable UN approved light source
condition: Lamp uses replaceable light source module(s)
test_case: Attempt to fit UN approved light sources into the module seat and vice versa; pass if not possible.

text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), regardless of the use of tool(s), the light source module(s) shall not be mechanically interchangeable with any other replaceable light source module having different characteristics that is located in the same lamp housing.
quote: any other replaceable light source module having different characteristics that is located in the same lamp housing
condition: Lamp uses more than one replaceable light source module type in the same housing
test_case: Attempt to swap modules of different characteristics within the housing; pass if mechanically impossible.

text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), when the light source module is removed and replaced by another module provided by the applicant and bearing the same light source module identification code, the photometric requirements of the front fog lamp shall be met.
quote: when the light source module is removed and replaced by another module provided by the applicant and bearing the same light source module identification code
condition: Lamp uses replaceable light source module(s)
test_case: Replace the module with another bearing the same identification code and repeat photometry; pass if requirements are met.

text: If applicable, the light source modules of the front fog lamp shall comply with the requirements specified in Annex 9.
quote: If applicable, light source modules shall comply with the requirements specified in Annex 9.
condition: Lamp uses light source module(s)
test_case: Test light source modules to Annex 9; pass if all Annex 9 requirements are met.

text: The luminous flux of the light source(s) of the front fog lamp shall be determined according to the provisions in paragraph 4.6.
quote: The luminous flux of the light source(s), or the luminous flux of the principal passing-beam, shall be determined according to the provisions in paragraph 4.6.
test_case: Verify the luminous flux measurement was carried out under the conditions of paragraph 4.6.

text: In case of a front fog lamp incorporating one or more light source(s) or light source module(s) producing the front fog beam and having a total objective luminous flux which exceeds 2.00·10^3 lumens, a reference shall be made in the communication form in Annex 1.
quote: producing the principal passing-beam or the front fog beam and having a total objective luminous flux which exceeds 2.00∙103 lumens
condition: Total objective luminous flux of the fog beam light sources exceeds 2000 lm
test_case: Determine total objective luminous flux; if above 2000 lm, check the communication form contains the reference.

text: All photometric and colorimetric measurements of the front fog lamp shall be made with respect to the conditions of paragraph 4.6.1, with the methods of measurement given in Annex 4.
quote: All measurements, photometric and colorimetric, shall be made with respect to the following conditions (Particulars of the methods of measurement to be used are given in Annex 4)
test_case: Review test report to confirm measurements followed paragraph 4.6.1 conditions and Annex 4 methods.

text: In the case of replaceable UN approved light sources, all measurements of the front fog lamp shall be made using standard light sources as specified in R.E.5.
quote: In the case of replaceable UN approved light sources, all measurements shall be made using standard light sources as specified in R.E.5.
condition: Lamp uses replaceable UN approved light source(s)
test_case: Confirm that standard light sources per R.E.5 were used for measurements.

text: In the case of replaceable UN approved light source(s) controlled by an electronic light source control gear or variable intensity control, the standard light source(s) shall have a luminous flux value that does not deviate more than 5 per cent from its reference/objective luminous flux value when test voltage is applied.
quote: the standard light source(s) shall have a luminous flux value that does not deviate more than 5 per cent from its reference/objective luminous flux value
condition: Replaceable UN approved light sources controlled by electronic control gear or variable intensity control
test_case: Measure standard light source flux at test voltage; pass if within ±5 % of reference/objective value.

text: In the case of a front fog lamp equipped with light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s), all measurements shall be made with the light source(s) present in the lamp.
quote: In the case of a lamp equipped with light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s), all measurements shall be made with the light source(s) present in the lamp.
condition: Lamp uses LED module(s) or non-replaceable LED light sources
test_case: Confirm measurements were made with the lamp's own light sources installed.

text: In case of a front fog lamp using light sources which are subject to more than one of the conditions prescribed in paragraph 4.6., all separate photometric measurement results, if any, shall be added together.
quote: All separate measurement results, if any, shall be added together.
condition: Lamp uses light sources subject to more than one condition of paragraph 4.6
test_case: Check the report sums the separately measured results for each direction.

text: During photometric measurements of the front fog lamp, stray reflections shall be avoided by appropriate masking.
quote: During photometric measurements, stray reflections shall be avoided by appropriate masking.
test_case: Inspect photometric set-up for appropriate masking against stray reflections.

text: In the case where the front fog lamp may be installed on the vehicle in more than one or in a field of different positions, the photometric measurements shall be repeated for each position or for the extreme positions of the field of the reference axis specified by the manufacturer.
quote: In the case where a front fog lamp or a cornering lamp may be installed on the vehicle in more than one or in a field of different positions
condition: Fog lamp can be installed in more than one position or a field of positions
test_case: Repeat photometry at each position or extreme positions of the reference axis field; pass if all meet requirements.

text: In the case where the front fog lamp shall also be approved with LED substitute light source(s), all photometric and colorimetric measurements shall be repeated using the LED substitute light source(s) prescribed.
quote: In the case where the lamp shall also be approved with LED substitute light source(s), all measurements, photometric and colorimetric, shall be repeated
condition: Lamp is also to be approved with LED substitute light sources
test_case: Repeat photometric and colorimetric measurements with the prescribed LED substitute light sources; pass if compliant.

text: Unless otherwise specified, the voltage supplied at the front fog lamp for testing shall be either 6.3 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.2 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28.0 V (24 Volt-Systems).
quote: the voltage supplied at the lamp shall be either 6.3 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.2 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28.0 V (24 Volt-Systems)
test_case: Verify the test supply voltage at the lamp was 13.2 V (12 V system) or as applicable.

text: In case of a front fog lamp and/or a light source module controlled by an electronic light source control gear, the lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant.
quote: In case of a lamp and/or a light source module controlled by an electronic light source control gear, the lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant.
condition: Lamp or module is controlled by electronic light source control gear
test_case: Confirm the lamp was operated during testing per the applicant's specification with the control gear.

text: In case of a front fog lamp not controlled by an electronic light source control gear, with light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s), the voltage supplied at the input terminals of the lamp shall be as specified by the applicant.
quote: in case of light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s) the voltage supplied at the input terminals of the lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant
condition: Lamp not controlled by electronic control gear and uses LED modules or non-replaceable light sources
test_case: Verify the test voltage at the lamp input terminals matches the applicant's specification.

text: In case of a front fog lamp not controlled by an electronic light source control gear with replaceable UN approved light sources, the light sources shall be operated at the reference/objective luminous flux or alternatively at a different luminous flux with a proportional correction on the measured luminous intensities.
quote: the light sources shall be operated at the reference/objective luminous flux or alternatively at a different luminous flux with a proportional correction
condition: Lamp not controlled by electronic control gear and uses replaceable UN approved light sources
test_case: Check light sources were run at reference flux or intensities were proportionally corrected.

text: In case of front fog lamps equipped with multiple replaceable UN approved light sources, the light sources shall be operated at a voltage or electrical current setting such that the actual luminous fluxes do not deviate by more than 5 per cent from the average luminous flux, and the measured luminous intensities shall be corrected proportionally for the difference between the average and the reference/objective luminous flux.
quote: shall be operated at a voltage or electrical current setting such that the actual luminous fluxes of the light sources do not deviate by more than 5 per cent
condition: Lamp is equipped with multiple replaceable UN approved light sources
test_case: Measure each light source flux; pass if within 5 % of the average and intensities are corrected proportionally.

text: Tests for compliance of the luminous intensities and colorimetric characteristics of the front fog lamp shall be carried out according to Annex 10.
quote: Tests for compliance of the luminous intensities and colorimetric characteristics shall be carried out according to Annex 10.
test_case: Perform luminous intensity and colorimetric tests per Annex 10; pass if compliant.

text: For front fog lamps using different light source technologies, the colorimetric characteristics shall be checked for each light source technology separately according to the applicable provisions in paragraphs 4.6.1. and 4.6.2.
quote: For lamps (functions) using different light source technologies, the colorimetric characteristics shall be checked for each light source technology separately
condition: Lamp uses more than one light source technology
test_case: Measure chromaticity separately for each light source technology; pass if each complies.

text: If the outer lens of the front fog lamp is made of plastic material, tests shall be done according to the requirements in Annex 8.
quote: If the outer lens of the lamp is made of plastic material tests shall be done according to the requirements in Annex 8.
test_case: Perform the Annex 8 plastic material tests on the PC outer lens; pass if all Annex 8 criteria are met.

text: The UV resistance of light transmitting components located inside a front fog lamp and made of plastic material shall be tested according to Annex 8, paragraph 3.3, unless low-UV type light sources as specified in the relevant UN Regulation or in Annex 9 are used or provisions are taken to shield the relevant lamp components from UV radiation.
quote: The UV resistance of light transmitting components located inside a front fog lamp and made of plastic material shall be tested according to Annex 8, paragraph 3.3.
condition: Lamp has internal plastic light-transmitting components and does not use low-UV light sources or UV shielding
test_case: Perform the UV resistance test of Annex 8 paragraph 3.3 on internal plastic components, or verify low-UV light sources/UV shielding.

text: The sharpness and linearity of the cut-off of the front fog lamp, if applicable, shall be tested according to the requirements in Annex 6.
quote: The sharpness and linearity of the cut-off, if applicable, shall be tested according to the requirements in Annex 6.
test_case: Test cut-off sharpness and linearity per Annex 6; pass if Annex 6 criteria are met.

text: Complementary tests shall be done on the front fog lamp according to the requirements in Annex 7 to ensure that in use there is no excessive change in photometric performance.
quote: complementary tests shall be done according to the requirements in Annex 7 to ensure that in use there is no excessive change in photometric performance
test_case: Perform Annex 7 stability-of-photometric-performance tests; pass if changes stay within Annex 7 limits.

text: If required by the provisions of the relevant UN Regulations Nos. 48, 53, 74 or 86, the front fog lamp shall be so made that, if a light source and/or a light source module has failed, a signal indicating the failure is provided.
quote: the device (lamp) shall be so made that, if a light source and/or a light source module has failed, a signal indicating the failure is provided.
condition: Failure signal required by UN R48 installation provisions for the front fog lamp function
test_case: Simulate failure of the light source/LED module and verify that a failure signal is provided.

text: In case the front fog lamp function is realised with more than one element for visible radiation wired so that a failure of any one of them does not cause all of them to stop emitting light, a signal indicating the failure of that specific function shall be provided, according to the applicant's selection of one or more of the options (a) to (e) of paragraph 4.13.1.
quote: a signal indicating the failure of that specific function shall be provided, according to the applicant’s selection of one or more of the following options
condition: Failure signal required and the fog lamp uses multiple LEDs wired so that one failure does not extinguish all
test_case: Disable LED elements according to the selected option and verify the failure signal is triggered at the declared threshold.

text: The component(s) of the front fog lamp to which a replaceable light source is assembled shall be so made that the light source fits easily and, even in darkness, can be fitted in no position but the correct one.
quote: The component(s) to which a replaceable light source is assembled shall be so made that the light source fits easily and, even in darkness
condition: Front fog lamp uses replaceable light sources
test_case: Inspect and trial-fit the replaceable light source; verify it fits easily and only in the correct position.

text: For photometric adjustment and measuring conditions of the front fog lamp, Annex 4 shall be applied.
quote: For photometric adjustment and measuring conditions, see Annex 4.
test_case: Verify photometric tests are conducted with adjustment and measuring conditions per Annex 4.

text: In the case of front fog lamps with replaceable light sources, the lamp shall be considered acceptable if it meets the requirements of paragraph 5. with at least one standard (étalon) light source.
quote: the lamp shall be considered acceptable if it meets the requirements of paragraph 5. with at least one standard (étalon) light source
condition: Front fog lamp uses replaceable light sources
test_case: Perform photometric testing with a standard (étalon) light source and verify compliance with paragraph 5 requirements.

text: The colour of the light emitted by the front fog lamp shall be white, or selective yellow if requested by the applicant.
quote: The colour of the light emitted shall be white for all lamps. However, for front fog lamps the colour of the light emitted may be selective yellow
test_case: Measure chromaticity coordinates of the emitted light and verify they lie within the white (or selective yellow, if requested) boundaries.

text: Front fog lamps may be approved as a matched pair; where a matched pair is used, the pair shall meet the applicable matched-pair provisions.
quote: A matched pair is allowed for: -passing-beams of class C, V, AS, BS, CS or DS, -driving-beams of class A, B, BS, CS, DS or ADB, -front fog lamps.
condition: Front fog lamps submitted as a matched pair
test_case: Check approval documentation declares matched pair and verify photometry of the pair per the matched-pair provisions.

text: If requested by the applicant, the front fog lamp shall show that in the angular field from 165° to 180° outboard in horizontal direction and -2.5° to +5° in vertical direction, the maximum luminous intensity is not more than 2.5∙10-1 cd.
quote: in the angular field from 165° to 180° outboard in horizontal direction and -2.5° to +5° in vertical direction, the maximum luminous intensity is not more than 2.5∙10-1 cd
condition: Applicant requests the rearward white light visibility test
test_case: Measure luminous intensity in the 165°–180° outboard, -2.5° to +5° field and verify maximum ≤ 0.25 cd.

text: The front fog lamp shall be aimed according to Annex 5, paragraph 3.4. including the allowed specific tolerances of paragraph 4.
quote: The front fog lamp shall be aimed according to Annex 5, paragraph 3.4. including the allowed specific tolerances of paragraph 4.
test_case: Aim the fog lamp on the goniometer per Annex 5 para 3.4 and confirm the aim is within the para 4 tolerances.

text: If vertical adjustment of the front fog lamp cannot be performed repeatedly to the required position within the allowed tolerances, the instrumental method of Annex 6, paragraph 2. shall be applied to test compliance with the required minimum quality of the symmetric "cut-off" line and to perform the beam vertical adjustment.
quote: If, however, vertical adjustment cannot be performed repeatedly to the required position within the allowed tolerances, the instrumental method of Annex 6, paragraph 2. shall be applied
condition: Vertical adjustment of the fog lamp cannot be repeated within the allowed tolerances
test_case: If repeated visual aiming fails, apply the Annex 6 para 2 instrumental method and verify cut-off quality meets the minimum.

text: When so adjusted, the front fog lamp shall meet the requirements as shown in Table 17 and Figure A4-X.
quote: When so adjusted the front fog lamp shall meet the requirements as shown in Table 17 and Figure A4-X.
test_case: Measure the aimed fog lamp at all Table 17 points, lines and zones and confirm every value is within limits.

text: At points P1 and P2 (60°U, 45°L and 45°R), the luminous intensity of the front fog lamp shall not exceed 8.5∙10^1 cd at all points.
quote: P1 and P2 60°U 45°L and 45°R -8.5∙101 All points
test_case: Goniophotometric measurement at P1 and P2; pass if each value ≤ 85 cd.
merged: At points P3 and P4 (40°U, 30°L and 30°R), the luminous intensity of the front fog lamp shall not exceed 8.5∙10^1 cd at all points.
At points P5 and P6 (30°U, 60°L and 60°R), the luminous intensity of the front fog lamp shall not exceed 8.5∙10^1 cd at all points.
At points P7 and P10 (20°U, 40°L and 40°R), the luminous intensity of the front fog lamp shall not exceed 8.5∙10^1 cd at all points.
At points P8 and P9 (20°U, 15°L and 15°R), the luminous intensity of the front fog lamp shall not exceed 8.5∙10^1 cd at all points.

text: On Line 1 (8°U, 26°L to 26°R), the luminous intensity of the front fog lamp shall not exceed 1.30∙10^2 cd along the whole line.
quote: Line 1 8°U 26°L to 26°R -1.30∙102 All line
test_case: Scan Line 1; pass if maximum ≤ 130 cd.
merged: On Line 2 (4°U, 26°L to 26°R), the luminous intensity of the front fog lamp shall not exceed 1.50∙10^2 cd along the whole line.
On Line 3 (2°U, 26°L to 26°R), the luminous intensity of the front fog lamp shall not exceed 2.45∙10^2 cd along the whole line.
On Line 4 (1°U, 26°L to 26°R), the luminous intensity of the front fog lamp shall not exceed 3.60∙10^2 cd along the whole line.
On Line 5 (0°, 10°L to 10°R), the luminous intensity of the front fog lamp shall not exceed 4.85∙10^2 cd along the whole line.

text: On Line 6 (2.5°D, from 5° inwards to 10° outward), the luminous intensity of the front fog lamp shall be at least 2.70∙10^3 cd along the whole line; in case of lamps constituting a matched pair, the half of the sum of the measured values from both lamps does not apply to this element.
quote: Line 6 a 2.5°D from 5° inwards to 10° outward 2.70∙103 -All line
test_case: Scan Line 6 on each individual lamp; pass if minimum ≥ 2700 cd.

text: On Line 7 (6°D, from 5° inwards to 10° outward), the luminous intensity of the front fog lamp shall not exceed 0.5 x the actual measured maximum value on Line 6 along the whole line; in case of lamps constituting a matched pair, the half of the sum of the measured values from both lamps does not apply to this element.
quote: Line 7 a 6°D from 5° inwards to 10° outward -0.5 x the actual measured max. value on Line 6 All line
test_case: Scan Line 7 and compare with Line 6 maximum; pass if every value ≤ 0.5 × Line 6 maximum.

text: On Lines 8L and 8R (1.5°D to 3.5°D, 22°L and 22°R), the luminous intensity of the front fog lamp shall be at least 1.10∙10^3 cd at one or more points.
quote: Line 8L and 8R 1.5°D to 3.5°D 22°L and 22°R 1.10∙103 -One or more points
test_case: Scan Lines 8L and 8R; pass if at least one point on each line ≥ 1100 cd.
merged: On Lines 9L and 9R (1.5°D to 4.5°D, 35°L and 35°R), the luminous intensity of the front fog lamp shall be at least 4.50∙10^2 cd at one or more points.

text: In Zone D (1.5°D to 3.5°D, 10°L to 10°R), the luminous intensity of the front fog lamp shall not exceed 1.20∙10^4 cd in the whole zone.
quote: Zone D 1.5°D to 3.5°D 10°L to 10°R -1.20∙104 Whole zone
test_case: Map Zone D; pass if maximum ≤ 12000 cd.

text: Variations in homogeneity of the front fog lamp beam detrimental to satisfactory visibility in the zone above the line 5 from 10°L to 10°R are not permitted.
quote: Variations in homogeneity detrimental to satisfactory visibility in the zone above the line 5 from 10°L to 10°R are not permitted.
test_case: Inspect the beam pattern above line 5 between 10°L and 10°R; pass if no detrimental homogeneity variations.

text: The luminous intensity of the front fog lamp shall be measured either with white light or coloured light as prescribed by the applicant for use of the fog lamp in normal service.
quote: The luminous intensity shall be measured either with white light or coloured light as prescribed by the applicant for use of the fog lamp in normal service.
test_case: Confirm photometric measurement was made with the light colour declared for normal service.

text: Discontinuities in intensities of the front fog lamp beam detrimental to satisfactory visibility between the lines 6, 7, 8 and 9 are not permitted.
quote: Discontinuities in intensities detrimental to satisfactory visibility between the lines 6, 7, 8 and 9 are not permitted.
test_case: Inspect the beam between lines 6, 7, 8 and 9; pass if no detrimental intensity discontinuities.

text: Inside the field between lines 1 to 5 in Figure A4-X, the beam pattern of the front fog lamp should be substantially uniform.
quote: Inside the field between lines 1 to 5 in Figure A4-X, the beam pattern should be substantially uniform.
test_case: Inspect the isocandela map between lines 1 and 5 for substantial uniformity.

text: In the light-distribution of the front fog lamp as specified in Table 17, single narrow spots or stripes inside the area including the measuring points 1 to 10 and line 1 or inside the area of line 1 and line 2 are allowed only with not more than 1.75∙10^2 cd and if not extending beyond a conical angle of 2° aperture or a width of 1°.
quote: single narrow spots or stripes inside the area including the measuring points 1 to 10 and line 1 or inside the area of line 1 and line 2 with not more than 1.75∙102 cd are allowed
condition: Beam pattern contains narrow spots or stripes in the specified areas
test_case: Identify any spots/stripes in the area; pass if each ≤ 175 cd and within a 2° cone or 1° width.

text: If multiple spots or stripes are present in the front fog lamp light-distribution, they shall be separated by a minimum angle of 10°.
quote: If multiple spots or stripes are present, they shall be separated by a minimum angle of 10°.
condition: Multiple spots or stripes present in the beam pattern
test_case: Measure angular separation between spots/stripes; pass if ≥ 10°.

text: To adapt to dense fog or similar conditions of reduced visibility, automatic variation of the luminous intensities of the front fog lamp is permitted only if an active electronic light source control gear is incorporated into the front fog lamp function system.
quote: it is permitted to automatically vary the luminous intensities provided that: (a) An active electronic light source control gear is incorporated into the front fog lamp function system
condition: Fog lamp has automatically variable luminous intensity
test_case: Verify by design documentation and inspection that an active electronic light source control gear is part of the fog lamp system.

text: To adapt to dense fog or similar conditions of reduced visibility, automatic variation of the luminous intensities of the front fog lamp is permitted only if all intensities are varied proportionately.
quote: (b) All intensities are varied proportionately.
condition: Fog lamp has automatically variable luminous intensity
test_case: Measure the beam at several intensity states; pass if all point intensities scale proportionately.

text: The front fog lamp system with automatically varied luminous intensities, when checked for compliance according to the provisions of paragraph 4.6.2.1., is considered acceptable if the luminous intensities remain within 60 per cent and 100 per cent of the values specified in Table 17.
quote: is considered acceptable if the luminous intensities remain within 60 per cent and 100 per cent of the values specified in Table 17.
condition: Fog lamp has automatically variable luminous intensity
test_case: Check per para 4.6.2.1; pass if intensities in all states stay within 60–100 % of Table 17 values.

text: The front fog lamp system with automatic intensity variation shall provide automatic modifications such that good road illumination is achieved and no discomfort is caused to the driver or to other road users.
quote: shall verify that the system provides automatic modifications, such that good road illumination is achieved and no discomfort is caused to the driver or to other road users.
condition: Fog lamp has automatically variable luminous intensity
test_case: Technical Service assessment of the variable system; pass if road illumination is good and no discomfort is caused.

text: For a front fog lamp with automatic intensity variation, photometric measurements shall be performed according to the applicant's description.
quote: Photometric measurements shall be performed according to the applicant's description.
condition: Fog lamp has automatically variable luminous intensity
test_case: Confirm photometric tests follow the applicant's described operating states.

text: Road illumination devices (front fog lamps) approved under this Regulation shall be so manufactured as to conform to the type approved by meeting the requirements set forth in paragraphs 4.16. and 5. and in Annex 8, paragraph 4.
quote: Road illumination devices approved under this Regulation shall be so manufactured as to conform to the type approved by meeting the requirements
test_case: Check production front fog lamps against the requirements of paragraphs 4.16., 5. and Annex 8 paragraph 4; pass if all are met.

text: With respect to photometric performances of mass-produced front fog lamps tested with a standard (étalon) light source and/or non-replaceable light source(s) and/or light source module(s), as present in the lamp, if not otherwise specified, no measured value shall deviate unfavourably by more than 20 per cent from the value prescribed in this Regulation.
quote: If not otherwise specified, no measured value deviates unfavorably by more than 20 per cent from the value prescribed in this Regulation.
test_case: Measure photometry of a randomly chosen production lamp; pass if no value deviates unfavourably by more than 20 per cent.

text: For front fog lamps corresponding to paragraph 5.5. of this Regulation, the conformity of production photometric requirements of Table 19 shall apply (including the 20 per cent and 30 per cent equivalent limits for points P1 to P10, lines 1 to 9 and zone D).
quote: For front fog lamps corresponding to paragraph 5.5. of this Regulation, Table 19 shall apply
test_case: Measure a randomly chosen production front fog lamp on a goniometer at the Table 19 points, lines and zone; pass if values are within the 20/30 per cent equivalent limits.

text: In the front fog lamp light distribution as specified in Table 19, single narrow spots or stripes inside the area including measuring points 1 to 10 and line 1 or inside the area of line 1 and line 2 with not more than 2.10∙10² cd are allowed only if not extending beyond a conical angle of 2° aperture or a width of 1°, and if multiple spots or stripes are present, they shall be separated by a minimum angle of 10°.
quote: If multiple spots or stripes are present, they shall be separated by a minimum angle of 10°.
test_case: Scan the area of points 1 to 10 and lines 1-2 of a production lamp; pass if spots are ≤210 cd, within 2° aperture/1° width and separated by at least 10°.
