text: For the verification of the change in vertical position of the cut-off line under the influence of heat, one of the sampled front fog lamps shall be tested according to the procedure described in paragraph 3.1. of Annex 7 after being subjected three consecutive times to the cycle described in paragraph 3.2.2. of Annex 7.
quote: One of the sampled lamps or systems shall be tested according to the procedure described in paragraph 3.1. of Annex 7
test_case: Subject a sampled fog lamp three times to the Annex 7 para 3.2.2 cycle, then measure the cut-off shift per Annex 7 para 3.1; verify the procedure was followed.

text: A front fog lamp shall be considered as acceptable if the change in vertical position of the cut-off line under the influence of heat, Δr, does not exceed 3.0 mrad.
quote: A front fog lamp shall be considered as acceptable if Δr does not exceed 3.0 mrad.
test_case: Measure Δr after the Annex 7 heat test; pass if Δr ≤ 3.0 mrad.

text: If the Δr value of the front fog lamp exceeds 3.0 mrad but is not more than 4.0 mrad, a second front fog lamp shall be subjected to the test, after which the mean of the absolute values recorded on both samples shall not exceed 3.0 mrad.
quote: a second front fog lamp shall be subjected to the test after which the mean of the absolute values recorded on both samples shall not exceed 3.0 mrad
test_case: If first-sample Δr is between 3.0 and 4.0 mrad, test a second fog lamp; pass if the mean of absolute Δr values ≤ 3.0 mrad.

text: The chromaticity coordinates of the light emitted by the front fog lamps shall be complied with.
quote: The chromaticity coordinates shall be complied with.
test_case: Measure the chromaticity coordinates of the fog lamp light on sampled lamps; pass if within the specified colour boundaries.

text: The conformity requirements of the front fog lamps shall be considered satisfied from a mechanical and a geometric standpoint, in accordance with the requirements of this Regulation, if the differences do not exceed inevitable manufacturing deviations.
quote: The conformity requirements shall be considered satisfied from a mechanical and a geometric standpoint, in accordance with the requirements of this Regulation
test_case: Compare dimensions and construction of production fog lamp samples with the approved type; pass if differences are within inevitable manufacturing deviations.

text: With respect to photometric performance, when testing any front fog lamp chosen at random and equipped with a standard (étalon) light source and/or non-replaceable light source(s) and/or light source module(s), as present in the lamp, no measured value shall deviate from the values prescribed in paragraph 6 of this Regulation.
quote: No measured value deviates from the values prescribed in paragraph6 of this Regulation
test_case: Photometrically measure a randomly selected production fog lamp with its light source(s)/module(s); pass if all values meet paragraph 6.

text: In the case of a front fog lamp equipped with a replaceable light source, if the photometric test results do not meet the requirements, the tests on the lamps shall be repeated using another standard light source.
quote: If, in the case of a lamp equipped with a replaceable light source and if results of the test described above do not meet the requirements
condition: Fog lamp uses a replaceable LED light source
test_case: Where initial photometric test fails, repeat with another standard light source and check compliance with paragraph 6.

text: The conformity of mass-produced front fog lamps shall not be contested if the deviation of any specimen of samples A and B (all four lamps) is not more than 20 per cent.
quote: The conformity of mass-produced lamps shall not be contested if the deviation of any specimen of samples A and B (all four lamps) is not more than 20 per cent.
test_case: Measure four randomly selected production lamps; pass if no specimen deviates by more than 20 per cent.

text: In the case of front fog lamps in accordance with paragraph 5.5. of this Regulation, with respect to verification of the change in vertical position of the cut-off line under the influence of heat, the front fog lamp shall be considered as acceptable if Δr does not exceed 3.0 mrad.
quote: In the case of front fog lamps in accordance with paragraph 5.5. to this Regulation the lamp shall be considered as acceptable if r does not exceed 3.0 mrad.
test_case: Test one fog lamp of sample A per Annex 7 paragraph 3 after three cycles of Annex 7 paragraph 3.2.2; pass if Δr ≤ 3.0 mrad.

text: For front fog lamps, if the value of Δr exceeds 3.0 mrad but is not more than 4.0 mrad, the second front fog lamp of sample A shall be subjected to the test, after which the mean of the absolute values recorded in both samples shall not exceed 3.0 mrad.
quote: If this value exceeds 3.0 mrad but is not more than 4.0 mrad, the second front fog lamp of sample A shall be subjected to the test
test_case: Test the second fog lamp of sample A; pass if the mean of absolute Δr values of both lamps ≤ 3.0 mrad.

text: For front fog lamps, if the value of 3.0 mrad on sample A is not complied with, the two front fog lamps of sample B shall be subjected to the same procedure and the value of Δr for each of them shall not exceed 3.0 mrad.
quote: the two front fog lamps of sample B shall be subjected to the same procedure and the value of r for each of them shall not exceed 3.0 mrad
test_case: Test both fog lamps of sample B per Annex 7; pass if Δr ≤ 3.0 mrad for each.

text: For photometric measurement, the front fog lamp or part(s) thereof shall be mounted on a goniometer with a fixed horizontal axis and moveable axis perpendicular to the fixed horizontal axis.
quote: The device or part(s) thereof shall be mounted on a goniometer with a fixed horizontal axis and moveable axis perpendicular to the fixed horizontal axis.
test_case: Check the photometric test setup: the fog lamp is mounted on a goniometer with a fixed horizontal axis and a perpendicular moveable axis.

text: The luminous intensity values of the front fog lamp shall be determined by means of a photoreceptor contained within a square of 65 mm side and set up to a distance of at least 25 m forward of the centre of reference of each lamp perpendicular to the measurement axis from the origin of the goniometer.
quote: The luminous intensity values shall be determined by means of a photoreceptor contained within a square of 65 mm side
test_case: Verify in the test report that the photoreceptor fits within a 65 mm square and is placed at least 25 m from the centre of reference.

text: The angular co-ordinates for the front fog lamp photometric measurement shall be specified in deg on a sphere with a vertical polar axis according to the gonio-photometer as defined in Figure A4-I.
quote: The angular co-ordinates are specified in deg on a sphere with a vertical polar axis according to the gonio-photometer as defined in Figure A4-I.
test_case: Check that measurement points are expressed in degrees in the spherical coordinate system with vertical polar axis of Figure A4-I.

text: An aiming screen shall be used for the front fog lamp photometric measurement; it may be located at a shorter distance than that of the photoreceptor.
quote: An aiming screen shall be used and may be located at a shorter distance than that of the photoreceptor.
test_case: Confirm an aiming screen is used in the photometric test setup.

text: Before starting the measurements, the front fog lamp or part(s) thereof shall be aimed as described in Annex 5.
quote: Before starting the measurements, the device or part(s) thereof shall be aimed as described in Annex 5.
test_case: Verify the fog lamp was aimed per Annex 5 before photometric measurement, as recorded in the test report.

text: Upon request of the applicant, in case of a matched pair of front fog lamps, the photometric requirements for each single measuring point, segment or zone (angular position) apply to half of the sum of the respective measured values from both lamps together.
quote: in case of a matched pair of lamps the photometric requirements for each single measuring point, segment or zone (angular position) apply to half of the sum
condition: Applicant requests evaluation of the front fog lamps as a matched pair.
test_case: For a matched pair, compute half the sum of both lamps' measured values at each point and compare against the photometric limits.

text: In the case of a matched pair of front fog lamps, where a provision is specified for one side only (paragraph 5.1.4.2. and the footnotes of Tables 5, 6, 14, 15, 16, 17 and 19), the division by the factor of 2 does not apply.
quote: where a provision is specified for one side only, the division by the factor of 2 does not apply.
condition: Applicant requests evaluation of the front fog lamps as a matched pair.
test_case: Check that one-side-only provisions are assessed on the individual lamp values without halving the sum.

text: The aiming of the front fog lamp shall be carried out using a flat vertical screen set up at a distance of 10 m or 25 m (as indicated in item 9 of Annex 1) forward of the device and at right angles to the H-V axis as shown in Annex 4.
quote: The aiming shall be carried out using a flat vertical screen set up at a distance of 10 m or 25 m
test_case: Check the test report confirms aiming on a flat vertical screen at 10 m or 25 m, perpendicular to the H-V axis.

text: The aiming screen shall be sufficiently wide to allow examination and adjustment of the front fog lamp over at least 5° on either side of the V-V line.
quote: The screen shall be sufficiently wide to allow examination and adjustment of the device over at least 5° on either side of the V-V line.
test_case: Verify the screen covers at least ±5° from the V-V line at the test distance.

text: The luminous intensity distribution of the front fog lamp in its neutral state shall incorporate a "cut-off".
quote: The luminous intensity distribution of a principal passing-beam headlamp or of at least one lighting unit for a class C passing-beam of an AFS or of a front fog lamp in its neutral state shall incorporate a "cut-off".
test_case: Project the fog lamp beam on the aiming screen and verify a visible cut-off line is present.

text: The symmetric "cut-off" line of the front fog lamp shall provide a straight "horizontal part" towards the left and the right (see Figure A5-II).
quote: The symmetric "cut-off" line shall provide a straight "horizontal part" towards the left and the right (see Figure A5-II)
test_case: Visually inspect the projected beam on the screen and confirm a straight horizontal cut-off extending to both left and right.

text: In the case of a road illumination device providing a front fog lamp, the device shall be visually aimed by means of the "cut-off" (see Figure A5-II).
quote: In the case of a road illumination device providing a front fog lamp, the device shall be visually aimed by means of the "cut-off"
test_case: Confirm in the test report that the fog lamp was aimed visually using the symmetric cut-off line.

text: For vertical adjustment of the front fog lamp, the "cut-off" is moved upward from below line B and adjusted to its nominal position 1 degree below the H-H line.
quote: For vertical adjustment: the "cut-off" is moved upward from below line B and adjusted to its nominal position 1 degrees below the H-H line;
test_case: Aim the fog lamp moving the cut-off upward from below line B and verify it is set at 1° below H-H.

text: For horizontal adjustment of the front fog lamp, the cut-off line shall be so positioned that the projected beam pattern appears approximately symmetrical to the V-V line (according to paragraph 3.3.1.2.).
quote: For horizontal adjustment: according to paragraph 3.3.1.2.
test_case: Verify the projected beam pattern appears approximately symmetrical about the V-V line after horizontal aiming.

text: When the front fog lamp is designed for use in pairs or has otherwise an asymmetric beam pattern, it shall be horizontally aligned according to the specification of the applicant, or otherwise in such a way that the cut-off line appears symmetrical to the V-V line.
quote: When the front fog lamp is designed for use in pairs or has otherwise an asymmetric beam pattern, it shall be horizontally aligned according to the specification of the applicant
condition: Front fog lamp designed for use in pairs or with an asymmetric beam pattern
test_case: Check horizontal alignment follows the applicant's specification, or that the cut-off appears symmetrical to V-V.

text: Where the front fog lamp aimed as described in paragraph 3. does not meet the device specific requirements set out in paragraphs 5. or 6.2. of this Regulation, its alignment may be changed only provided that the axis of the beam is not displaced horizontally by more than 2° to the left or to the right.
quote: 2° to the left or to the right for device designed to provide a front fog lamp or a cornering lamp
test_case: If re-aiming was used, verify the recorded horizontal beam axis shift does not exceed 2° left or right.
merged: Where the front fog lamp aimed as described in paragraph 3. does not meet the device specific requirements set out in paragraphs 5. or 6.2. of this Regulation, its alignment may be changed only provided that the axis of the beam is not displaced vertically by more than 0.5° up or down.

text: If vertical adjustment of the front fog lamp cannot be performed repeatedly to the required position within the tolerances described in paragraph 4.1., the instrumental method of Annex 6 shall be applied to test compliance with the required minimum quality of the "cut-off" and to perform the vertical and horizontal adjustment of the beam.
quote: the instrumental method of Annex 6 shall be applied to test compliance with the required minimum quality of the "cut-off"
condition: Visual vertical adjustment of the front fog lamp is not repeatable within tolerances
test_case: Where visual vertical aiming is not repeatable within tolerance, verify the Annex 6 instrumental method was used and the cut-off quality requirements are met.

text: The instrumental aiming method shall be applied to test compliance of the front fog lamp with the required minimum quality of the "cut-off" and to perform the vertical and horizontal adjustment of the beam only if the vertical adjustment of the front fog lamp cannot be performed repeatedly to the required position and tolerances described in Annex 5.
quote: The instrumental aiming method shall be applied to test compliance with the required minimum quality of the "cut-off" and to perform the vertical and horizontal adjustment
condition: Vertical adjustment of the front fog lamp cannot be performed repeatedly to the required position and tolerances of Annex 5
test_case: Attempt visual vertical aim per Annex 5 repeatedly; if not repeatable within tolerances, verify instrumental method is used for cut-off quality and aiming.

text: In the case where paragraph 1.2. applies, the quality of the "cut-off" line of the front fog lamp shall be tested according to the requirements set out in paragraph 2.2.
quote: In the case where paragraph 1.2. applies, the quality of the "cut-off" line shall be tested according to the requirements set out in paragraph 2.2.
condition: Instrumental aiming method applies (paragraph 1.2.)
test_case: Verify cut-off quality test records follow Annex 6 paragraph 2.2.

text: In the case where paragraph 1.2. applies, the instrumental vertical and horizontal adjustment of the front fog lamp beam shall be performed according to the requirements set out in paragraph 2.3.
quote: the instrumental vertical and horizontal adjustment of the beam shall be performed according to the requirements set out in paragraph 2.3.
condition: Instrumental aiming method applies (paragraph 1.2.)
test_case: Verify beam adjustment records follow Annex 6 paragraph 2.3.

text: Before carrying out the measurement of the quality of "cut-off" and the instrumental aiming procedure of the front fog lamp, a visual pre-aim in accordance with device specific paragraph(s) of Annex 5 is required.
quote: Before carrying out the measurement of the quality of "cut-off", and the instrumental aiming procedure, a visual pre-aim in accordance with device specific paragraph(s) of Annex 5 is required.
condition: Instrumental aiming method applies (paragraph 1.2.)
test_case: Check test procedure includes visual pre-aim per Annex 5 before instrumental measurement.

text: To determine the minimum sharpness of the front fog lamp "cut-off", measurements shall be performed by vertically scanning through the horizontal part of the "cut-off" in angular steps of 0.05° at either a measurement distance of 10 m with a detector having a diameter of approximately 10 mm, or 25 m with a detector having a diameter of approximately 30 mm.
quote: To determine the minimum sharpness, measurements shall be performed by vertically scanning through the horizontal part of the "cut-off" in angular steps of 0.05°
condition: Instrumental aiming method applies (paragraph 1.2.)
test_case: Verify scan step 0.05° and distance/detector combination of 10 m/10 mm or 25 m/30 mm in test report.

text: The "cut-off" quality of the front fog lamp shall be considered acceptable if the requirements of paragraphs 2.2.1. to 2.2.3. comply with at least one set of measurements.
quote: The "cut-off" quality shall be considered acceptable if the requirements of paragraphs 2.2.1. to 2.2.3. comply with at least one set of measurements.
condition: Instrumental aiming method applies (paragraph 1.2.)
test_case: Check that at least one measurement set meets all of paragraphs 2.2.1 to 2.2.3.

text: To determine the linearity of the front fog lamp "cut-off", measurements shall be performed by vertically scanning through the horizontal part of the "cut-off" in angular steps of 0.05° exclusively at a measurement distance of 25 m and with a detector having a diameter of approximately 30 mm.
quote: To determine the maximum sharpness and linearity, measurements shall be performed by vertically scanning through the horizontal part of the "cut-off" in angular steps of 0.05° exclusively at a measurement distance of 25 m
condition: Instrumental aiming method applies (paragraph 1.2.)
test_case: Verify linearity scans made at 25 m with ~30 mm detector in 0.05° steps.

text: Not more than one "cut-off" of the front fog lamp shall be visible.
quote: Not more than one "cut-off" shall be visible
condition: Instrumental aiming method applies (paragraph 1.2.)
test_case: Visually inspect beam on aiming screen; pass if only one cut-off is visible.

text: For a front fog lamp designed to provide a symmetric "cut-off" line, the sharpness factor G, determined by scanning vertically through the horizontal part of the "cut-off" at 2.5° left and right from the V-V line, shall not be less than 0.08 (minimum sharpness).
quote: The value of G shall not be less than: ... (b) 0.08 (minimum sharpness) for passing-beam and front fog lamp designed to provide symmetric “cut-off” line
condition: Instrumental aiming method applies (paragraph 1.2.)
test_case: Compute G = log Eβ − log E(β+0.1°) from vertical scans at 2.5°L and 2.5°R; pass if G ≥ 0.08.

text: For a front fog lamp designed to provide a symmetric "cut-off" line, the part of the horizontal "cut-off" shall be horizontal between 3° left and right from the V-V line (see Figure A6-II).
quote: For passing-beam and front fog lamp designed to provide symmetric “cut-off” line the part of the horizontal "cut-off" shall be horizontal between 3° left and right
condition: Instrumental aiming method applies (paragraph 1.2.)
test_case: Scan cut-off between 3°L and 3°R and verify it is horizontal.

text: For a front fog lamp designed to provide a symmetric "cut-off" line, the maximum vertical distance between the inflection points of the "cut-off" gradient determined by the equation d2(log E)/dβ2 = 0 shall not exceed 0.5°.
quote: The maximum vertical distance between the inflection points determined shall not exceed: ... (b) 0.5° for passing-beam and front fog lamp designed to provide symmetric “cut-off” line
condition: Instrumental aiming method applies (paragraph 1.2.)
test_case: Determine inflection points at the specified vertical lines; pass if maximum vertical spread ≤ 0.5°.

text: For vertical adjustment of a front fog lamp designed to provide a symmetric "cut-off" line, a vertical scan moving upward from below line B shall be carried out on the V-V line and the inflection point (where d2(log E)/dβ2 = 0) shall be positioned on the line B situated 1° below H-H line.
quote: The inflection point (where d2 (log E) / dβ2 = 0) is determined and positioned on the line B situated: ... (b) 1° below H-H line for front fog lamp
condition: Instrumental aiming method applies (paragraph 1.2.) and cut-off complies with paragraph 2.2.
test_case: Perform vertical scan on V-V line and verify inflection point is set at 1° below H-H.

text: For horizontal adjustment of a front fog lamp designed to provide a symmetric "cut-off" line, the cut-off line shall be so positioned that the projected beam pattern appears approximately symmetrical to the V-V line.
quote: The cut-off line shall be so positioned that the projected beam pattern appears approximately symmetrical to the V-V line.
condition: Instrumental aiming method applies (paragraph 1.2.)
test_case: Inspect projected beam on screen; pass if pattern is approximately symmetrical to V-V line.

text: In case of front fog lamps designed for use in pairs or having otherwise an asymmetric beam pattern, the "cut-off" line shall be horizontally aligned according to the specification of the applicant, or otherwise in such a way that the cut-off line appears symmetrical to the V-V line.
quote: In case of front fog lamps designed for use in pairs or has otherwise an asymmetric beam pattern, the “cut-off” line shall be horizontally aligned according to the specification of the applicant
condition: Front fog lamps designed for use in pairs or with an asymmetric beam pattern
test_case: Verify horizontal alignment matches applicant specification, or else cut-off appears symmetrical to V-V line.

text: Once the photometric values of the front fog lamp have been measured according to this Regulation at the point of maximum illumination in zone D (Imax) and in the point HV, a complete sample shall be tested for stability of photometric performance in operation.
quote: In the case of front fog lamps: at the point of maximum illumination in zone D (Imax) and in the point HV; A complete sample shall be tested
test_case: Record Imax in zone D and HV values, then run the Annex 7 stability test on a complete fog lamp sample.

text: For front fog lamps, the complete sample tested shall be the complete lamp itself including ballast(s) and those surrounding body parts, light sources or light source module(s) which could influence its thermal dissipation.
quote: "Complete sample" shall be understood to mean the complete lamp itself including ballast(s) and those surrounding body parts, light sources or light source module(s)
test_case: Check that the test sample includes the lamp, LED modules, any control gear and the surrounding bumper/bezel parts affecting heat dissipation.

text: The stability tests on the front fog lamp shall be carried out in a dry and still atmosphere at an ambient temperature of 23 °C ± 5 °C, the test sample being mounted on a base representing the correct installation on the vehicle.
quote: In a dry and still atmosphere at an ambient temperature of 23 °C ± 5 °C, the test sample being mounted on a base representing the correct installation
test_case: Verify test records show ambient 23 °C ± 5 °C, still air and a fixture representing vehicle installation.

text: In case of replaceable light sources in the front fog lamp, the tests shall be carried out using mass production LED light sources and LED modules which have been aged for at least 48 hours and cooled down to ambient temperature before starting the tests.
quote: mass production LED light source and LED modules which have been aged for at least 48 hours and cooled down to ambient temperature before starting the tests
condition: Front fog lamp uses replaceable LED light sources
test_case: Check ageing log shows at least 48 h ageing and cool-down to ambient before testing.

text: The LED modules supplied by the applicant shall be used for the stability tests of the front fog lamp.
quote: The LED modules supplied by the applicant shall be used.
condition: Front fog lamp uses LED modules
test_case: Verify the LED modules tested are those supplied by the applicant.

text: The front fog lamp test sample shall be operated without being dismounted from or readjusted in relation to its test fixture.
quote: The test sample shall be operated without being dismounted from or readjusted in relation to its test fixture.
test_case: Verify the sample remained on the fixture without readjustment throughout the test.

text: The measuring equipment for the stability tests of the front fog lamp shall be equivalent to that used during type approval tests.
quote: The measuring equipment shall be equivalent to that used during type approval tests.
test_case: Confirm the same/equivalent goniophotometer was used as for initial photometry.

text: The light source used in the front fog lamp for the stability test shall be a light source of the category specified for that lamp.
quote: The light source used shall be a light source of the category specified for that headlamp.
condition: Front fog lamp uses replaceable light sources
test_case: Check the light source category used matches the category specified for the lamp.

text: The clean front fog lamp shall be operated for 12 hours as described in paragraph 2.1.1. and checked as prescribed in paragraph 2.1.2.
quote: The device shall be operated for 12 hours as described in paragraph 2.1.1. and checked as prescribed in paragraph 2.1.2.
test_case: Operate the clean lamp for 12 h and then perform visual and photometric checks.

text: Where the front fog lamp is designed to provide only one lighting function (front fog lamp), the corresponding light emitting element(s) shall be lit for the time specified in paragraph 2.1.
quote: In the case where a device is designed to provide only one lighting function (driving-beam or passing-beam or front fog lamp)
test_case: Verify the fog lamp light emitting elements were lit continuously for 12 h.

text: Where the device is designed to provide two or more lighting functions, the device shall be subjected to a cycle of 15 minutes main mode lit and 5 minutes all other functions in the same body intended to be used simultaneously which in combination draw the highest total wattage lit, until the time specified is reached.
quote: -15 minutes, main mode lit -5 minutes, all other functions which, according to the manufacturer's specifications, in the same body are intended to be used simultaneously
condition: Fog lamp body provides two or more lighting functions
test_case: Check the test log shows the 15 min / 5 min cycle with the highest-wattage combination.

text: When the tested lamp includes signalling lamps, the latter shall be lit for the duration of the test, except for a daytime running lamp; a direction indicator lamp shall be lit in flashing mode with an on/off time of approximately one to one.
quote: In the case of a direction indicator lamp, it shall be lit in flashing mode with an on/ off time of approximately one to one.
condition: Front fog lamp includes signalling lamps (e.g. direction indicator) in the same test sample
test_case: Verify signalling lamps were lit and the direction indicator flashed at ~1:1 during the test.

text: For front fog lamps with non-replaceable light sources operated directly under vehicle voltage system conditions, all measurements shall be made at 6.3 V, 13.2 V or 28.0 V or at other voltages according to the vehicle voltage system as specified by the applicant.
quote: All measurements on lighting units equipped with non-replaceable light sources (filament light sources and/ or others) shall be made at 6.3 V, 13.2 V or 28.0 V
condition: Fog lamp uses non-replaceable LED light sources operated directly at vehicle voltage
test_case: Verify the applied terminal voltage was 13.2 V (or declared value) during the test.

text: LED light source(s) and light source module(s) of the front fog lamp shall be measured at 6.3 V, 13.2 V or 28.0 V respectively, if not otherwise specified; those operated by an electronic light source control gear shall be measured as specified by the applicant.
quote: LED light source(s) and light source module(s) shall be measured at 6.3 V, 13.2 V or 28.0 V respectively, if not otherwise specified
test_case: Verify LED modules were operated at 13.2 V (12 V system) or as specified by the applicant for control gear.

text: For light sources operated independently from vehicle supply voltage and fully controlled by the system, or supplied by a supply and operating device, the test voltages shall be applied to the input terminals of that device.
quote: the test voltages as specified above shall be applied to the input terminals of that device
condition: Fog lamp light sources are supplied by a supply and operating device / electronic control gear
test_case: Check test voltage was applied at the input terminals of the supply and operating device.

text: Where signalling lamps are grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated into the test sample and operating at voltages other than the nominal rated voltages, the voltage shall be adjusted as declared by the manufacturer for the correct photometric functioning of that lamp.
quote: the voltage shall be adjusted as declared by the manufacturer for the correct photometric functioning of that lamp
condition: Signalling lamps are grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with the fog lamp
test_case: Check signalling lamp voltage matches the manufacturer declaration.

text: After the stability test, on visual inspection no distortion, deformation, cracking or change in colour of either the lens or the external lens, if any, of the front fog lamp shall be noticeable.
quote: no distortion, deformation, cracking or change in colour of either the headlamp lens or the external lens, if any, shall be noticeable
test_case: Visually inspect the lens; pass if no distortion, deformation, cracking or colour change.

text: Once the front fog lamp has been stabilized to the ambient temperature, the lens and the external lens, if any, shall be cleaned with a clean, damp cotton cloth.
quote: the headlamp lens and the external lens, if any, shall be cleaned with a clean, damp cotton cloth
test_case: Verify lens cleaning with a damp cotton cloth after cool-down.

text: After the stability test, the photometric values of the front fog lamp shall be verified on point HV and Imax in zone D, with a 10 per cent discrepancy between the photometric characteristics and the values measured prior to the test permissible including the tolerances of the photometric procedure.
quote: In the case of front fog lamps on point HV and Imax in zone D.
test_case: Measure HV and Imax in zone D after the test; pass if within 10 % of pre-test values.

text: After being tested as specified in paragraph 2.1., the front fog lamp shall be operated for one hour as described in paragraph 2.1.1. after being prepared as prescribed in paragraph 2.2.1., and checked as prescribed in paragraph 2.1.2.
quote: the headlamp shall be operated for one hour as described in paragraph 2.1.1. for each function after being prepared as prescribed in paragraph 2.2.1.
test_case: Operate the soiled lamp for 1 h and repeat visual and photometric checks.

text: After each dirty lamp test a sufficient cooling down period must be assured.
quote: after each test a sufficient cooling down period must be assured
test_case: Check the test log records a cool-down period after each test.

text: For the front fog lamp, the test mixture shall be uniformly applied to the entire light-emitting surface and then left to dry, repeated until the illumination value has dropped to 15-20 per cent of the value measured at Imax in zone D.
quote: This procedure shall be repeated until the illumination value has dropped to 15-20 per cent of the values measured
test_case: Apply the Appendix 2 mixture repeatedly and confirm Imax in zone D is reduced to 15-20 % before operation.

text: The vertical drift of the cut-off line of the front fog lamp under the influence of heat shall not exceed a specified value; the device tested in accordance with paragraph 2. shall be subjected to the test of paragraph 3.1. without being removed from or readjusted in relation to its test fixture.
quote: The device tested in accordance with paragraph 2., shall be subjected to the test described in paragraph 3.1., without being removed from or readjusted
test_case: Perform the cut-off drift test on the same fixture-mounted sample after paragraph 2 tests.

text: For the cut-off drift test of the front fog lamp, the voltage shall be adjusted as specified in paragraph 2.1.1.2. and the test shall be carried out in a dry and still atmosphere at an ambient temperature of 23 °C ± 5 °C, with the device operated without being dismounted from or readjusted in relation to its test fixture.
quote: The test shall be carried out in a dry and still atmosphere at an ambient temperature of 23 °C ± 5 °C.
test_case: Verify voltage, ambient 23 °C ± 5 °C and undisturbed fixture in the test record.

text: The cut-off drift test of the front fog lamp shall use mass production LED light source(s) and/or LED module(s) as submitted with the device, which have been aged for at least 48 hours.
quote: Using mass production LED light source(s) and/or the LED module(s) as submitted with the device, which has been aged for at least 48 hours
test_case: Check the LED modules used are production parts aged at least 48 h.

text: For front fog lamps, the position of the cut-off line between a point situated 3.0° left and a point situated 3.0° right of the line V-V shall be verified 3 minutes (r3) and 60 minutes (r60) respectively after operation.
quote: the position of the "cut-off" line between a point situated 3.0° left and a point situated 3.0° right of the cut-off line V-V shall be verified
test_case: Measure cut-off vertical position at 3 min and 60 min between 3.0°L and 3.0°R.

text: The measurement of the variation in the cut-off line position of the front fog lamp shall be carried out by any method giving acceptable accuracy and reproducible results.
quote: shall be carried out by any method giving acceptable accuracy and reproducible results
test_case: Review the measurement method for accuracy and reproducibility.

text: For front fog lamps, the result shall be considered acceptable when the absolute value Δr1 = |r3 - r60| recorded on the device is not more than 2.0 mrad (Δr1 ≤ 2.0 mrad).
quote: In case of front fog lamps, the absolute value Δ r1 = | r3 - r60 | recorded on this device is not more than 2.0 mrad
test_case: Compute |r3 - r60|; pass if ≤ 2.0 mrad.

text: After the three stabilisation cycles, the front fog lamp shall be considered as acceptable if the absolute values Δr measured according to paragraph 3.2. on the further sample meet the requirements in paragraph 3.2.1.
quote: the device shall be considered as acceptable if the absolute values Δr measured according to paragraph 3.2. on this further sample meet the requirements in paragraph 3.2.1.
condition: Only if the further-sample procedure is triggered.
test_case: Measure Δr on the further sample after the three cycles; pass if Δr meets paragraph 3.2.1 limits.

text: If the result of the test for change in vertical position of the cut-off line does not comply with the requirements in paragraph 3.2.1. and does not exceed the values in Table A7-1, a further sample of the front fog lamp mounted on a test fixture representative of the correct installation on the vehicle shall be tested as described in paragraph 3.1. after being subjected three consecutive times to the cycle of one hour operation (voltage adjusted as specified in paragraph 2.1.1.2.) and one hour with the lamp switched OFF, in order to stabilise the position of the mechanical parts of the device.
quote: a further sample mounted on a test fixture representative of the correct installation on the vehicle shall be tested as described in paragraph 3.1.
condition: Only if the first sample's result does not comply with paragraph 3.2.1. but does not exceed the Table A7-1 values.
test_case: Mount a further sample on a representative fixture, run three cycles of 1 h ON / 1 h OFF at the specified voltage, then repeat the paragraph 3.1 test; check the procedure is followed.

text: For the further-sample procedure to be applicable to a front fog lamp, the upward movement of the cut-off line shall not exceed 3.0 mrad as given in Table A7-1.
quote: Table A7-1 Movement values Movement Device Value Upward Headlamp or AFS 1.5 mrad Front fog lamp 3.0 mrad
condition: Only if the first sample's result does not comply with paragraph 3.2.1.
test_case: Measure the upward movement of the first sample; further-sample retest allowed only if it is ≤ 3.0 mrad.
merged: For the further-sample procedure to be applicable to a front fog lamp, the downward movement of the cut-off line shall not exceed 3.0 mrad as given in Table A7-1.

text: For front fog lamps with the outer lens made of glass, the mixture of water and a polluting agent to be applied to the device shall be composed of: 9 parts by weight of silica sand with a particle size of 0-100 μm; 1 part by weight of vegetal carbon dust produced from beech wood with a particle size of 0-100 μm; 0.2 parts by weight of NaCMC; 5 parts by weight of sodium chloride (pure at 99 per cent); and an appropriate quantity of distilled water with a conductivity of ≤ 1 mS/m, and the mixture shall not be more than 14 days old.
quote: For devices with the outer lens made of glass: The mixture of water and a polluting agent to be applied to the device shall be composed of:
condition: Only if the fog lamp outer lens is glass (BOM states PC, to be confirmed).
test_case: If a glass lens is used, verify the dirt mixture composition and age against the specification.

text: For front fog lamps with outer lens made of plastic material, the mixture of water and polluting agent to be applied to the device shall be composed of: 9 parts by weight of silica sand with a particle size of 0-100 μm; 1 part by weight of vegetal carbon dust produced from beech wood with a particle size of 0-100 μm; 0.2 parts by weight of NaCMC; 5 parts by weight of sodium chloride (pure at 99 per cent); 13 parts by weight of distilled water with a conductivity of ≤ 1 mS/m; and 2 ± 1 drops by weight of surfactant.
quote: For devices with outer lens made of plastic material: The mixture of water and polluting agent to be applied to the device shall be composed of:
test_case: Review the test laboratory's dirt mixture preparation record against the specified composition for plastic lenses.

text: For front fog lamps with outer lens made of plastic material, the test mixture shall not be more than 14 days old.
quote: The mixture shall not be more than 14 days old.
test_case: Check the preparation date of the mixture is no more than 14 days before the test.

text: The NaCMC used in the dirt mixture shall have a degree of substitution (DS) of 0.6-0.7 and a viscosity of 200-300 cP for a 2 per cent solution at 20° C.
quote: The NaCMC used in the dirt mixture shall have a degree of substitution (DS) of 0.6-0.7 and a viscosity of 200-300 cP
test_case: Check the NaCMC certificate for DS 0.6-0.7 and viscosity 200-300 cP (2 % solution, 20 °C).

text: Every lens or sample of plastic material of the front fog lamp submitted for testing shall be produced by the method to be used in mass production.
quote: Every such lens or sample of material shall be produced by the method to be used in mass production;
test_case: Review the production process records for the test lenses and samples; pass if they were produced by the series-production method.

text: For testing the UV-resistance of light transmitting components made of plastic material against UV radiation of LED modules inside the lamp, each material sample shall have the same appearance and surface treatment, if any, as intended for use in the lamp to be approved; this testing is not necessary if only low-UV-type LED modules as specified in Annex 9 are applied or if the relevant components are shielded from UV radiation.
quote: Each material sample shall have the same appearance and surface treatment, if any, as intended for use in the headlamp to be approved
condition: LED modules other than low-UV-type are used and the internal plastic components are not shielded from UV radiation
test_case: Compare the UV test samples with the series parts; pass if appearance and surface treatment are identical, or if the low-UV / shielding exemption is documented.

text: The samples of plastic lenses or material of the front fog lamp supplied pursuant to paragraph 1.2. shall satisfy the requirements indicated in paragraphs 3.1. to 3.6.
quote: The samples supplied pursuant to paragraph 1.2. shall satisfy the requirements indicated in paragraphs 3.1. to 3.6.
test_case: Perform tests 3.1 to 3.6 on the lens/material samples; pass if all results meet the stated limits.

text: The two samples of complete front fog lamps supplied pursuant to paragraph 3.1.2.4. of this Regulation and incorporating lenses of plastic material shall, with regard to the lens material, satisfy the requirements indicated in paragraph 3.7.
quote: The two samples of complete road illumination devices supplied pursuant to paragraph 3.1.2.4. of this Regulation and incorporating lenses of plastic material shall
test_case: Perform the paragraph 3.7 tests on the two complete lamps; pass if the photometric and coating adherence results comply.

text: The samples (lenses of plastic material or samples of material) shall be subjected, with the optical assembly to which they are intended to be fitted (where applicable), to approval tests in the chronological order indicated in Table A8-1.
quote: shall be subjected, with the optical assembly to which they are intended to be fitted (where applicable), to approval tests in the chronological order indicated in Table A8-1.
test_case: Check the test report sequence against Table A8-1; pass if the tests were done in the prescribed order.

text: If the lamp manufacturer can prove that the product has already passed the tests prescribed in paragraphs 3.1. to 3.5., or the equivalent tests pursuant to another regulation, only the tests prescribed in Table A8-2 shall be mandatory.
quote: if the lamp manufacturer can prove that the product has already passed the tests prescribed in paragraphs 3.1. to 3.5.
condition: The lens material has already passed tests 3.1 to 3.5 or equivalent tests under another regulation
test_case: Review the prior test evidence; pass if it covers tests 3.1 to 3.5 and the Table A8-2 tests have been performed.

text: Three new samples (lenses) of the front fog lamp shall be subjected to five cycles of temperature and humidity change: 3 h at 40 °C ± 2 °C and 85-95 per cent RH; 1 h at 23 °C ± 5 °C and 60-75 per cent RH; 15 h at -30 °C ± 2 °C; 1 h at 23 °C ± 5 °C and 60-75 per cent RH; 3 h at 80 °C ± 2 °C; 1 h at 23 °C ± 5 °C and 60-75 per cent RH.
quote: Three new samples (lenses) shall be subjected to five cycles of temperature and humidity (RH = relative humidity) change in accordance with the following programme
test_case: Run five climatic cycles per the programme on three new lenses and record the chamber profile; pass if the profile complies.

text: Before the temperature change test, the samples shall be kept at 23 °C ± 5 °C and 60-75 per cent RH for at least four hours.
quote: Before this test, the samples shall be kept at 23 °C ± 5 °C and 60-75 per cent RH for at least four hours.
test_case: Check the conditioning log; pass if the samples were held at 23 °C ± 5 °C and 60-75 % RH for at least 4 h.

text: Photometric measurements shall be carried out on the samples before and after the temperature change test.
quote: Photometric measurements shall be carried out on the samples before and after the test.
test_case: Verify that the test report contains photometric measurements taken before and after cycling.

text: In the case of front fog lamps, the photometric measurements shall be made after photometric stability using a standard (étalon) light source, or with the light source(s) and/or light source module(s) present in the lamp, at the intersection of the V-V line with line 6 and the intersection of the V-V line with line 4.
quote: In the case of front fog lamps: -intersection V-V line with line 6 and -intersection V-V line with line 4
test_case: Measure luminous intensity at V-V/line 6 and V-V/line 4 after photometric stability; pass if measurements were taken at these points.

text: The variation between the photometric values measured on each sample before and after the temperature change test shall not exceed 10 per cent including the tolerances of the photometric procedure.
quote: The variation between the photometric values measured on each sample before and after the test shall not exceed 10 per cent
test_case: Compare the before and after photometric values per sample; pass if the variation is ≤ 10 %.

text: Three new samples (lenses or samples of material) shall be exposed to radiation from a source with a spectral energy distribution similar to a black body at 5,500 K to 6,000 K, filtered to reduce wavelengths below 295 nm and above 2,500 nm, at an energetic illumination of 1,200 W/m2 ± 200 W/m2 until they receive a luminous energy of 4,500 MJ/m2 ± 200 MJ/m2.
quote: The samples shall be exposed to an energetic illumination of 1,200 W/m2 ± 200 W/m2 for a period such that the luminous energy that they receive is equal to 4,500 MJ/m2
test_case: Review the weathering test record; pass if irradiance, spectrum, filtering and total radiant exposure comply.

text: During the atmospheric agents exposure, the black panel temperature on a level with the samples shall be 50 °C ± 5 °C, the samples shall revolve around the source at 1 to 5 1/min, and the samples shall be sprayed with distilled water of conductivity lower than 1 mS/m at 23 °C ± 5 °C in cycles of 5 minutes spraying and 25 minutes drying.
quote: Within the enclosure, the temperature measured on the black panel placed on a level with the samples shall be 50 °C ± 5 °C.
test_case: Check the chamber log for black panel temperature, rotation speed and spray cycle; pass if all are within the specified values.

text: After the atmospheric agents test and the measurement of paragraph 3.2.3.1., the outer face of the three samples shall be treated as described in paragraph 3.2.2.2. with the test mixture of 61.5 per cent n-heptane, 12.5 per cent toluene, 7.5 per cent ethyl tetrachloride, 12.5 per cent trichloroethylene and 6 per cent xylene (volume per cent).
quote: the outer face of the said three samples shall be treated as described in paragraph 3.2.2.2. with the mixture defined in paragraph 3.2.2.1.
test_case: Apply the defined mixture with a saturated cotton pad at 50 N/cm2 for 10 min; pass if the procedure was followed.

text: After the test of resistance to atmospheric agents, the outer face of the samples shall be free from cracks, scratches, chipping and deformation.
quote: After the test of resistance to atmospheric agents, the outer face of the samples shall be free from cracks, scratches, chipping and deformation
test_case: Visually inspect the samples after weathering; pass if there are no cracks, scratches, chipping or deformation.

text: After the test of resistance to atmospheric agents, the mean variation in transmission measured on the three samples according to Appendix 2 to this Annex shall not exceed 0.020 (Δtm < 0.020).
quote: measured on the three samples according to the procedure described in Appendix 2 to this Annex shall not exceed 0.020 (Δtm < 0.020).
test_case: Measure transmission per Appendix 2 before and after weathering; pass if the mean Δt < 0.020.

text: After the test of resistance to chemical agents, the samples shall not bear any traces of chemical staining likely to cause a variation of flux diffusion, whose mean variation measured on the three samples according to Appendix 2 to this Annex shall not exceed 0.020 (Δdm < 0.020).
quote: After the test of resistance to chemical agents, the samples shall not bear any traces of chemical staining likely to cause a variation of flux diffusion
test_case: Inspect for staining and measure diffusion per Appendix 2; pass if no staining is present and the mean Δd < 0.020.

text: If necessary, flat samples of each light transmitting plastic component of the front fog lamp, with the same colour and surface treatment as the lamp parts and at the same angles and distances as in the lamp, shall be exposed to the light of the light source(s); after 1,500 hours of continuous operation, the colorimetric requirements of the transmitted light must be met with a new light source.
quote: After 1,500 hours of continuous operation, the colorimetric requirements of the transmitted light must be met with a new light source
condition: The LED modules are not low-UV-type and the components are not shielded from UV radiation
test_case: Expose the samples for 1,500 h, then measure chromaticity with a new light source; pass if within the colour limits.

text: After 1,500 hours of continuous exposure to the light source radiation, the surfaces of the samples shall be free of cracks, scratches, scalings or deformation.
quote: the surfaces of the samples shall be free of cracks, scratches, scalings or deformation.
condition: The LED modules are not low-UV-type and the components are not shielded from UV radiation
test_case: Visually inspect the samples after 1,500 h exposure; pass if there are no cracks, scratches, scaling or deformation.

text: For the resistance to detergents test, the outer face of three samples shall be heated to 50 °C ± 5 °C and immersed for five minutes in a mixture at 23 °C ± 5 °C of 99 parts distilled water (not more than 0.02 per cent impurities) and one part alkylaryl sulphonate, then dried at 50 °C ± 5 °C and cleaned with a moist cloth.
quote: The outer face of three samples (lenses or samples of material) shall be heated to 50 °C ± 5 °C and then immersed for five minutes
test_case: Review the detergent test record; pass if temperatures, duration and mixture comply.

text: For the resistance to hydrocarbons test, the outer face of the three samples shall be lightly rubbed for one minute with a cotton cloth soaked in a mixture of 70 per cent n-heptane and 30 per cent toluene (volume per cent), and then dried in the open air.
quote: lightly rubbed for one minute with a cotton cloth soaked in a mixture composed of 70 per cent n-heptane and 30 per cent toluene
test_case: Review the hydrocarbon test record; pass if the mixture and rubbing duration comply.

text: After the detergent and hydrocarbon tests have been performed successively, the mean value of the variation in transmission measured on the three samples according to Appendix 2 shall not exceed 0.010 (Δtm < 0.010).
quote: measured on the three samples according to the procedure described in Appendix 2 shall not exceed 0.010 (Δtm < 0.010).
test_case: Measure transmission per Appendix 2 before and after both tests; pass if the mean Δt < 0.010.

text: The outer face of three new samples (lenses) shall be subjected to the uniform mechanical deterioration test by the method described in Appendix 3.
quote: The outer face of the three new samples (lenses) shall be subjected to the uniform mechanical deterioration test by the method described in Appendix 3.
test_case: Perform the Appendix 3 abrasion test on three new lenses; pass if the method was followed.

text: After the mechanical deterioration test, the mean variations measured on the three samples according to Appendix 2 in the area specified in paragraph 1.2.1.1. shall be Δtm < 0.100 in transmission and Δdm < 0.050 in diffusion.
quote: The mean value of the three samples shall be such that: Δtm < 0.100; Δdm < 0.050.
test_case: Measure transmission and diffusion per Appendix 2; pass if the mean Δt < 0.100 and the mean Δd < 0.050.

text: For the coating adherence test, a 20 mm x 20 mm area of the lens coating shall be cut with a razor blade or needle into a grid of approximately 2 mm x 2 mm squares, with pressure sufficient to cut at least the coating.
quote: A surface of 20 mm x 20 mm in area of the coating of a lens shall be cut with a razor blade or a needle into a grid
test_case: Check the prepared grid dimensions; pass if a 20 x 20 mm area is cut into approx. 2 x 2 mm squares through the coating.

text: An adhesive tape at least 25 mm wide with an adhesion force of 2 N/(cm of width) ± 20 per cent shall be pressed for at least five minutes onto the gridded surface and torn off perpendicular to the surface at a constant speed of 1.5 m/s ± 0.2 m/s.
quote: the tape shall be torn off at a constant speed of 1.5 m/s ± 0.2 m/s.
test_case: Review the tape test parameters; pass if tape width, adhesion force, dwell time and peel speed comply.

text: After the coating adherence test, there shall be no appreciable impairment of the gridded area; impairments at the intersections between squares or at the edges of the cuts are permitted provided that the impaired area does not exceed 15 per cent of the gridded surface.
quote: There shall be no appreciable impairment of the gridded area.
test_case: Inspect the gridded area after tape removal; pass if the impaired area is ≤ 15 % and confined to intersections and cut edges.

text: The lens of complete front fog lamp sample No. 1 shall be subjected to the mechanical deterioration test described in paragraph 3.5.1.
quote: The lens of sample No. 1 shall be subjected to the test described in paragraph 3.5.1. above.
test_case: Perform the Appendix 3 abrasion test on the lens of complete lamp No. 1; pass if the test was performed.

text: In the case of front fog lamps, after the mechanical deterioration test of the lens, the results of photometric measurements prescribed for lines 2 and 5 shall not exceed the maximum values prescribed by more than 30 per cent.
quote: In the case of fog lamps, after the test, the results of photometric measurements prescribed for lines 2 and 5 shall not exceed the maximum values
test_case: Measure photometry on lines 2 and 5 of the abraded lamp; pass if the values are ≤ 130 % of the prescribed maxima.

text: The lens of complete front fog lamp sample No. 2 shall be subjected to the coating adherence test described in paragraph 3.6.
quote: Test of adherence of coatings, if any The lens of sample No. 2 shall be subjected to the test described in paragraph 3.6.
test_case: Perform the cross-cut tape test on the lens of complete lamp No. 2; pass if the impairment is ≤ 15 % of the gridded area.

text: The tests on plastic materials (lenses or samples of material supplied pursuant to paragraph 1.2.) of the front fog lamp shall be carried out in the chronological order given in Table A8-1 (limited photometry, temperature change, transmission and diffusion measurements, atmospheric agents, chemical agents, detergents, hydrocarbons, deterioration, adherence).
quote: Chronological order of material tests A. Tests on plastic materials (lenses or samples of material supplied pursuant to paragraph 1.2.).
test_case: Review the test report to confirm the plastic lens/material samples were tested in the sequence of Table A8-1.

text: The complete front fog lamp devices, systems or parts thereof (supplied pursuant to paragraph 3.1.2.4.) shall be subjected to the deterioration, photometry and adherence tests in accordance with Table A8-2.
quote: Table A8-2 Tests on complete devices, systems or parts thereof (supplied pursuant to paragraph 3.1.2.4. of this Regulation)
test_case: Check that complete device samples No. 1 and 2 passed deterioration, photometry and adherence tests per Table A8-2.

text: For the measurement of diffusion and transmission of light, the readings T1 (incident flux), T2 and T3 (flux transmitted by the new and tested material in a field of 24°), and T4 and T5 (flux diffused by the new and tested material) shall be taken as given in Table A8-3.
quote: The following readings shall be taken: Table A8-3 Readings
test_case: Verify the test report records readings T1 to T5 for the lens material samples per Table A8-3.

text: For the spray test, the spray gun used shall be equipped with a nozzle 1.3 mm in diameter allowing a liquid flow rate of 0.24 ± 0.02 l/minute at an operating pressure of 6.0 bars -0/+0.5 bar, giving a fan pattern of 170 mm ± 50 mm in diameter at a distance of 380 mm ± 10 mm from the nozzle.
quote: The spray gun used shall be equipped with a nozzle 1.3 mm in diameter allowing a liquid flow rate of 0.24 ± 0.02 l/minute
test_case: Check spray test equipment parameters in the laboratory report against the stated nozzle, flow, pressure and pattern values.

text: The spray test mixture shall be composed of silica sand of hardness 7 on the Mohr scale, grain size between 0 and 0.2 mm, almost normal distribution, angular factor of 1.8 to 2, and water of hardness not exceeding 205 g/m3, with 25 g of sand per litre of water.
quote: The test mixture shall be composed of: (a) Silica sand of hardness 7 on the Mohr scale, with a grain size between 0 and 0.2 mm
test_case: Verify the test mixture specification recorded in the report matches the required sand and water properties.

text: The outer surface of the front fog lamp lenses shall be subjected once or more than once to the action of the sand jet, sprayed almost perpendicular to the surface to be tested.
quote: The outer surface of the lamp lenses shall be subjected once or more than once to the action of the sand jet produced as described above.
test_case: Perform the sand spray deterioration test on the lens outer surface with the jet almost perpendicular and confirm subsequent photometric compliance.

text: The deterioration of the front fog lamp lenses shall be checked by means of one or more samples of glass placed as a reference near the lenses, and the mixture shall be sprayed until the variation in the diffusion of light on the reference sample(s), measured by the method described in Appendix 2, reaches the specified value.
quote: The deterioration shall be checked by means of one or more samples of glass placed as a reference near the lenses to be tested.
test_case: Measure diffusion on glass reference samples per Appendix 2 and stop spraying when the specified diffusion variation is reached.

text: For the adhesive tape adherence test, the ambient conditions shall be at 23 °C ± 5 °C and 65 ± 15 per cent RH.
quote: The ambient conditions shall be at 23 °C ± 5 °C and 65 ± 15 per cent RH.
condition: The fog lamp has a plastic (PC hard-coated) lens subject to the coating adherence test.
test_case: Verify test atmosphere records show 23 °C ± 5 °C and 65 ± 15 % RH.

text: For the adhesive tape adherence test, the five values obtained shall be arranged in order and the median value taken as a result of the measurement, expressed in Newtons per centimetre of width of the tape.
quote: The five values obtained shall be arranged in order and the median value taken as a result of the measurement.
condition: The fog lamp has a plastic (PC hard-coated) lens subject to the coating adherence test.
test_case: Check the test report gives the median of five values in N/cm of tape width.

text: Each LED module sample submitted shall conform to the relevant requirements of this Regulation when tested with the supplied electronic light source control-gear(s), if any.
quote: Each LED module sample submitted shall conform to the relevant requirements of this Regulation when tested with the supplied electronic light source control-gear(s), if any.
condition: The LED front fog lamps use LED modules (non-replaceable vs. replaceable LED light sources not stated); control gear presence unknown.
test_case: Test each LED module sample with its supplied control gear and verify compliance with all relevant R149 requirements.

text: The LED module(s) shall be so designed as to be and to remain in good working order when in normal use.
quote: LED module(s) shall be so designed as to be and to remain in good working order when in normal use.
condition: The LED front fog lamps use LED modules.
test_case: Review design and operate the LED module under normal-use conditions; verify it works correctly throughout.

text: The LED module(s) shall exhibit no fault in design or manufacture.
quote: They shall moreover exhibit no fault in design or manufacture.
condition: The LED front fog lamps use LED modules.
test_case: Inspect LED module samples for design or manufacturing defects; pass if none found.

text: The LED(s) on the LED module shall be equipped with suitable fixation elements.
quote: The LED(s) on the LED module shall be equipped with suitable fixation elements.
condition: The LED front fog lamps use LED modules.
test_case: Visually inspect the LED module and verify each LED has suitable fixation elements.

text: The fixation elements of the LED module shall be strong and firmly secured to the LED(s) and the LED module.
quote: The fixation elements shall be strong and firmly secured to the LED(s) and the LED module.
condition: The LED front fog lamps use LED modules.
test_case: Inspect and mechanically check the fixation elements; pass if firmly secured to LEDs and module without looseness.

text: All LED module samples shall be tested as specified in paragraph 4 of Annex 9.
quote: All samples shall be tested as specified in paragraph 4.
condition: The LED front fog lamps use LED modules.
test_case: Verify the test report shows all LED module samples tested per Annex 9 paragraph 4 (colour rendering, UV).

text: All LED module samples shall be tested under the conditions as specified in paragraphs 4.6.2.1.1. and 4.6.2.2.1. of this Regulation.
quote: All samples shall be tested under the conditions as specified in paragraphs 4.6.2.1.1. and 4.6.2.2.1. of this Regulation.
condition: The LED front fog lamps use LED modules.
test_case: Check that test voltages/operating conditions applied to the LED modules match paragraphs 4.6.2.1.1. and 4.6.2.2.1.

text: For the measurement of electrical and photometric characteristics, the LED module device shall be operated in a dry and still atmosphere at an ambient temperature of 23 °C ± 5 °C.
quote: the device shall be operated in a dry and still atmosphere at an ambient temperature of 23 °C ± 5 °C.
condition: The LED front fog lamps use LED modules.
test_case: Verify the measurement environment was dry, still air at 23 °C ± 5 °C during electrical and photometric measurements.

text: Upon the request of the applicant the LED module shall be operated for 15 h and cooled down to ambient temperature before starting the tests as specified in this Regulation.
quote: Upon the request of the applicant the LED module shall be operated for 15 h and cooled down to ambient temperature before starting the tests
condition: The LED front fog lamps use LED modules and the applicant requests ageing.
test_case: If ageing requested, verify the module was operated 15 h and cooled to ambient before testing.

text: In addition to provisions as described in paragraph 4.16. of this Regulation, the minimum red content of the light of a LED module, when tested outside the device, shall be such that the specified red content formula is met.
quote: The minimum red content of the light of a LED module, when tested outside the device, shall be such that:
condition: The LED front fog lamps use LED modules.
test_case: Measure the spectral irradiance of the LED module outside the device and compute the red content; pass if the minimum value per the formula is met.

text: The red content value of the LED module light shall be calculated using intervals of one nanometre.
quote: This value shall be calculated using intervals of one nanometre.
condition: The LED front fog lamps use LED modules.
test_case: Verify the red content calculation uses 1 nm spectral intervals.

text: The UV-radiation of a low-UV-type LED module, when tested outside the device, shall be such that the specified UV-radiation formula is met.
quote: The UV-radiation of a low-UV-type LED module, when tested outside the device, shall be such that:
condition: The LED front fog lamps use LED modules of the low-UV type.
test_case: Measure the spectral distribution of the module outside the device and compute weighted UV radiation; pass if within the formula limit.

text: The UV-radiation value of a low-UV-type LED module shall be calculated using intervals of one nanometre.
quote: This value shall be calculated using intervals of one nanometre.
condition: The LED front fog lamps use LED modules of the low-UV type.
test_case: Verify the UV calculation uses 1 nm spectral intervals.

text: The luminous intensity distribution and the colour of the light emitted by the front fog lamp shall be measured and checked for compliance after photometric stability (as defined in UN Regulation No. 48).
quote: The luminous intensity distribution and the colour of the light emitted are measured and checked for compliance after photometric stability
test_case: Operate the front fog lamp until photometric stability per UN R48, then measure intensity distribution and colour; all values must be within the R149 limits.

text: The UV-radiation of a low-UV-type LED module shall be weighted according to the values as indicated in Table A9-1.
quote: The UV-radiation shall be weighted according to the values as indicated in Table A9-1:
condition: The LED front fog lamps use LED modules of the low-UV type.
test_case: Verify the UV weighting function S(λ) used matches Table A9-1 values (interpolated where needed).

text: For front fog lamps using light source technologies other than incandescent technology (LED), the luminous intensities measured after 1 min and after photometric stability shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
quote: For all other lamps, the luminous intensities measured after 1 min and after photometric stability shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
test_case: Measure the LED front fog lamp intensities after 1 min of operation (measured or calculated via the Table A10-1 ratio) and after photometric stability; all values must be within the minimum and maximum limits.

text: For the front fog lamp, the luminous intensity distribution shall additionally be checked for compliance 4 seconds after activation, using the test point V, 2.5°D, as listed in Table A10-1.
quote: Front fog 4 V, 2.5°D
test_case: Measure intensity at V, 2.5°D 4 s after switch-on and scale the stabilised distribution by the ratio; values must comply with the front fog lamp requirements.

text: In case the front fog lamp uses LED technology only, the front fog lamp is deemed to comply with the corresponding intensity requirements at all points in time if the values measured at 1 minute after activation and after photometric stability are compliant.
quote: In case a lamp (function) uses LED technology only, a lamp (function) is deemed to comply with the corresponding intensity requirements at all points in time
test_case: Verify that intensities measured 1 min after activation and after photometric stability both meet the front fog lamp limits.

text: In case the front fog lamp uses more than one light generating technology, its intensity requirements shall be tested following the strictest time requirements according to paragraphs 2.1.1. to 2.1.4. for the combination of them and checked for compliance.
quote: In case a lamp (function) uses more than one light generating technology, the corresponding intensity requirements of a lamp (function) are tested following the strictest time requirements
condition: Front fog lamp uses more than one light generating technology
test_case: Identify the light generating technologies used and test intensities at the strictest applicable points in time; all values must comply.

text: In case of doubt (e.g. unexpected run-up behaviour), the minimum intensity requirements of the front fog lamp shall additionally be tested and checked for compliance at all points in time starting at 4 seconds after activation as listed in Table A10-1.
quote: In case of doubt (e.g. unexpected run-up behaviour), the corresponding minimum intensity requirements of a lamp (function) are additionally tested and checked for compliance
condition: Doubt about run-up behaviour of the front fog lamp
test_case: Record intensity at V, 2.5°D continuously from 4 s after activation until stability; minimum values must be met at all times.

text: If the optional mark of the centre of reference is used, it shall be positioned on the lens of the front fog lamp.
quote: This optional mark of the centre of reference shall be positioned on the lens at its intersection with the reference axis
condition: Front fog lamp carries the optional centre of reference mark.
test_case: Inspect the fog lamp lens and verify that the centre of reference mark, if present, is located on the lens at the reference axis.

text: If the optional mark of the centre of reference is used on the front fog lamp lens, it shall conform to Figure A11-I with dimension a = 2 mm min.
quote: Figure A11-I Centre of reference a = 2 mm min.
condition: Front fog lamp carries the optional centre of reference mark.
test_case: Measure the centre of reference mark on the lens and verify that its shape matches Figure A11-I and that dimension a is at least 2 mm.

text: Where required by paragraph 3.3.4.6. of this Regulation, the road illumination device shall bear the voltage marking according to Figure A12 indicating the rated voltage of nn Volts.
quote: The following marking relates to the requirements of paragraph 3.3.4.6. of this Regulation. Figure A12 Voltage marking
condition: Front fog lamp falls under paragraph 3.3.4.6. (e.g. non-replaceable light source / electronic control gear requiring rated voltage marking).
test_case: Inspect the fog lamp marking and verify that the voltage marking matches the Figure A12 format and states the rated voltage.

text: If the front fog lamp uses a light source module, the light source module shall bear an identification code as shown in the example of Figure A13-VII, including the approval number of the lamp with which it was approved.
quote: The light source module bearing the identification code shown in Figure A13-VII has been approved together with a lamp
condition: Front fog lamp contains a light source module.
test_case: Inspect the light source module and verify that it carries an identification code consistent with Figure A13-VII and the lamp approval number.

text: This global technical regulation shall apply to the frontal surfaces of power driven vehicles of category 1-1 with a gross vehicle mass exceeding 500 kg, which includes the front bumper assembly of the M1 vehicle.
quote: This global technical regulation (gtr) shall apply to the frontal surfaces of power driven vehicles of category 1-1 with a gross vehicle mass exceeding 500 kg
condition: Gross vehicle mass of the target M1 (category 1-1) vehicle exceeds 500 kg
test_case: Check the target vehicle category and gross vehicle mass to confirm that the bumper frontal surfaces fall within scope.

text: When performing measurements as described in this Part, the vehicle fitted with the front bumper assembly shall be positioned in its normal ride attitude.
quote: When performing measurements as described in this Part, the vehicle shall be positioned in its normal ride attitude.
test_case: Verify in the test report that the bumper reference lines and test areas were measured with the vehicle in normal ride attitude.

text: If the vehicle is fitted with a badge, mascot or other structure (e.g. the radome emblem) which would bend back or retract under an applied load of maximum 100 N, then this load shall be applied before and/or while the measurements are taken.
quote: If the vehicle is fitted with a badge, mascot or other structure, which would bend back or retract under an applied load of maximum 100 N
condition: Radome emblem or other attachment bends back or retracts under a load of maximum 100 N
test_case: Apply up to 100 N to the emblem and other attachments and verify that measurements were taken with the load applied where they deflect or retract.

text: Any vehicle component which could change shape or position, other than suspension components or active devices to protect pedestrians (e.g. the towing eye cover), shall be set to its stowed position when performing the measurements.
quote: Any vehicle component which could change shape or position, other than suspension components or active devices to protect pedestrians, shall be set to their stowed position.
test_case: Inspect the measurement setup to confirm that movable components such as the towing eye cover are in their stowed position.

text: The top edge of the bumper shall also be regarded as the bonnet leading edge if it is contacted by the straight edge during the bonnet leading edge reference line procedure.
quote: The top edge of the bumper shall also be regarded as the bonnet leading edge if it is contacted by the straight edge during this procedure.
test_case: Traverse the 1,000 mm straight edge inclined at 50° and verify whether it contacts the bumper top edge; if it does, treat that edge as the bonnet leading edge.

text: For the determination of the corner of bumper, the external devices for indirect vision and the tyres shall not be considered.
quote: The external devices for indirect vision and the tyres shall not be considered.
test_case: Check that the corner gauge contact points used to define the bumper corners exclude mirrors and tyres.

text: For the normal ride attitude, the suspension shall be set in normal running condition as specified by the manufacturer for a speed of 40 km/h.
quote: The suspension shall be set in normal running condition as specified by the manufacturer for a speed of 40 km/h.
test_case: Verify the suspension setting during test preparation corresponds to the manufacturer's 40 km/h running condition.

text: The primary reference marks shall be within ± 25 mm of the design position in the vertical (Z) axis.
quote: The primary reference marks shall be within ± 25 mm of the design position in the vertical (Z) axis.
test_case: Measure the Z position of the primary reference marks; pass if within ± 25 mm of design position.

text: For vehicles with a lower bumper height of less than 425 mm, the requirements of paragraph 4.1.1. (lower legform to bumper) shall be applied.
quote: For vehicles with a lower bumper height of less than 425 mm the requirements of paragraph 4.1.1. shall be applied.
condition: Lower bumper height of the target vehicle is less than 425 mm (not stated)
test_case: Measure the lower bumper height in normal ride attitude per 3.27/3.28; if < 425 mm, verify the lower legform test per 4.1.1 is applied.

text: For vehicles with a lower bumper height which is greater than, or equal to 425 mm and less than 500 mm, the requirements of either paragraph 4.1.1. or 4.1.2., at the choice of the manufacturer, shall be applied.
quote: For vehicles with a lower bumper height which is greater than, or equal to 425 mm and less than 500 mm the requirements
condition: Lower bumper height of the target vehicle is ≥ 425 mm and < 500 mm (not stated)
test_case: Measure the lower bumper height; if within 425–500 mm, verify that either the lower or upper legform test chosen by the manufacturer is applied.

text: For vehicles with a lower bumper height of greater than, or equal to, 500 mm, the requirements of paragraph 4.1.2. (upper legform to bumper) shall be applied.
quote: For vehicles with a lower bumper height of greater than, or equal to, 500 mm the requirements of paragraph 4.1.2. shall be applied.
condition: Lower bumper height of the target vehicle is ≥ 500 mm (not stated)
test_case: Measure the lower bumper height; if ≥ 500 mm, verify the upper legform test per 4.1.2 is applied.

text: For the lower legform to bumper test, to verify compliance with the performance requirements as specified in paragraph 5.1.1., both the test impactor specified in paragraph 6.3.1.1. and the test procedures specified in paragraph 7.1.1. shall be used.
quote: To verify compliance with the performance requirements as specified in paragraph 5.1.1., both the test impactor specified in paragraph 6.3.1.1. and the test procedures
condition: Lower legform test applies (lower bumper height < 425 mm, or 425–500 mm by manufacturer choice)
test_case: Review the test report to confirm the FlexPLI impactor per 6.3.1.1 and procedure per 7.1.1 were used.
merged: For the upper legform to bumper test, to verify compliance with the performance requirements as specified in paragraph 5.1.2., both the test impactor specified in paragraph 6.3.1.2. and the test procedures specified in paragraph 7.1.2. shall be used.

text: When tested in accordance with paragraph 7.1.1. (flexible lower legform to bumper), the absolute value of the maximum dynamic medial collateral ligament elongation at the knee shall not exceed 22 mm.
quote: the absolute value of the maximum dynamic medial collateral ligament elongation at the knee shall not exceed 22 mm
condition: Lower legform test applies (lower bumper height < 425 mm, or 425–500 mm by manufacturer choice)
test_case: Perform FlexPLI impacts across the bumper test area per 7.1.1; pass if MCL elongation ≤ 22 mm at every test point.

text: When tested in accordance with paragraph 7.1.1. (flexible lower legform to bumper), the maximum dynamic anterior cruciate ligament and posterior cruciate ligament elongation shall not exceed 13 mm.
quote: the maximum dynamic anterior cruciate ligament and posterior cruciate ligament elongation shall not exceed 13 mm
condition: Lower legform test applies (lower bumper height < 425 mm, or 425–500 mm by manufacturer choice)
test_case: Perform FlexPLI impacts per 7.1.1; pass if ACL and PCL elongations are each ≤ 13 mm at every test point.

text: When tested in accordance with paragraph 7.1.1. (flexible lower legform to bumper), the absolute value of dynamic bending moments at the tibia shall not exceed 340 Nm.
quote: The absolute value of dynamic bending moments at the tibia shall not exceed 340 Nm.
condition: Lower legform test applies (lower bumper height < 425 mm, or 425–500 mm by manufacturer choice)
test_case: Perform FlexPLI impacts per 7.1.1; pass if the absolute tibia bending moment at all gauges is ≤ 340 Nm outside nominated relaxation zones.

text: Where the manufacturer nominates bumper test widths (relaxation zone) up to a maximum of 264 mm in total, the absolute value of the tibia bending moment in those widths shall not exceed 380 Nm, unless a Contracting Party restricts the relaxation zone in its domestic legislation.
quote: the manufacturer may nominate bumper test widths up to a maximum of 264 mm in total where the absolute value of the tibia bending moment shall not exceed 380 Nm
condition: Lower legform test applies and the manufacturer nominates a relaxation zone (not stated)
test_case: Check nominated relaxation widths total ≤ 264 mm and the tibia bending moment in those widths is ≤ 380 Nm.
