text: When tested in accordance with paragraph 7.1.2. (upper legform to bumper), the instantaneous sum of the impact forces with respect to time shall not exceed 7.5 kN.
quote: the instantaneous sum of the impact forces with respect to time shall not exceed 7.5 kN
condition: Upper legform test applies (lower bumper height ≥ 500 mm, or 425–500 mm by manufacturer choice)
test_case: Perform upper legform impacts per 7.1.2; pass if the summed impact force is ≤ 7.5 kN at all times.

text: When tested in accordance with paragraph 7.1.2. (upper legform to bumper), the bending moment on the test impactor shall not exceed 510 Nm.
quote: the bending moment on the test impactor shall not exceed 510 Nm
condition: Upper legform test applies (lower bumper height ≥ 500 mm, or 425–500 mm by manufacturer choice)
test_case: Perform upper legform impacts per 7.1.2; pass if the bending moment on the impactor is ≤ 510 Nm.

text: At the time of testing, the test facility and the vehicle or sub-system shall have a relative humidity of 40 percent ± 30 percent and stabilized temperature of 20 ± 4 ºC.
quote: the test facility and the vehicle or sub-system shall have a relative humidity of 40 percent ± 30 percent and stabilized temperature of 20 + 4 ºC
test_case: Check test records show humidity between 10 % and 70 % and stabilized temperature 16–24 °C at test time.

text: The impact test site shall consist of a flat, smooth and hard surface with a slope not exceeding 1 percent.
quote: The test site shall consist of a flat, smooth and hard surface with a slope not exceeding 1 percent.
test_case: Verify the test site surface is flat, smooth and hard with measured slope ≤ 1 %.

text: Either a complete vehicle, or a cut-body, adjusted to the conditions of paragraphs 6.2.1.1. and 6.2.1.2. shall be used for the test.
quote: Either a complete vehicle, or a cut-body, adjusted to the following conditions shall be used for the test.
test_case: Confirm the test specimen is a complete vehicle or a cut-body including the bumper assembly prepared per 6.2.1.1/6.2.1.2.

text: The vehicle shall be in its normal ride attitude, and shall be either securely mounted on raised supports or at rest on a flat horizontal surface with the parking brake applied.
quote: The vehicle shall be in its normal ride attitude, and shall be either securely mounted on raised supports or at rest on a flat horizontal surface
test_case: Verify via primary reference marks that the vehicle is in normal ride attitude and is either secured on supports or at rest with parking brake applied.

text: The cut-body shall include, in the test, all parts of the vehicle front structure, all under-bonnet components and all components behind the windscreen that may be involved in a frontal impact with a vulnerable road user.
quote: The cut-body shall include, in the test, all parts of the vehicle front structure, all under-bonnet components and all components behind the windscreen
condition: Test performed on a cut-body rather than complete vehicle
test_case: Inspect the cut-body to confirm the complete bumper assembly (fascia, absorber, beam, grille, lamps, sensors, plate holder) and other front structure parts are included.

text: The cut-body shall be securely mounted in the normal vehicle ride attitude.
quote: The cut-body shall be securely mounted in the normal vehicle ride attitude.
condition: Test performed on a cut-body rather than complete vehicle
test_case: Verify the cut-body mounting is rigid and its reference marks match the normal ride attitude.

text: All devices designed to protect vulnerable road users when impacted by the vehicle shall be correctly activated before and/or be active during the relevant test.
quote: All devices designed to protect vulnerable road users when impacted by the vehicle shall be correctly activated before and/or be active during the relevant test.
condition: Bumper assembly contains active pedestrian protection devices (none stated)
test_case: Check that any active protection devices are activated or active during the test.

text: It shall be the responsibility of the manufacturer to show that any devices designed to protect vulnerable road users will act as intended in a pedestrian impact.
quote: It shall be the responsibility of the manufacturer to show that any devices will act as intended in a pedestrian impact.
condition: Bumper assembly contains active pedestrian protection devices (none stated)
test_case: Review manufacturer evidence demonstrating the devices act as intended in a pedestrian impact.

text: For vehicle components which could change shape or position, other than active devices to protect pedestrians, and which have more than one fixed shape or position, the vehicle shall comply with the components in each fixed shape or position.
quote: For vehicle components which could change shape or position, other than active devices to protect pedestrians, and which have more than one fixed shape or position
condition: Bumper assembly contains components with more than one fixed shape or position (e.g. removable towing eye cover, movable plate holder).
test_case: Identify components with multiple fixed positions and perform the pedestrian impact tests in each fixed shape/position; pass if requirements are met in all.

text: When tested as a deployable pedestrian protection system (DPPS), the vehicle shall be adjusted as specified in the test procedure defined in Annex 1.
quote: When tested as a DPPS, the vehicle shall be adjusted as specified in the test procedure defined in Annex 1.
condition: Vehicle front end incorporates a deployable pedestrian protection system.
test_case: Check test setup records show vehicle adjusted per Annex 1 for DPPS testing.

text: The flexible lower legform impactor used for the bumper test shall consist of the flesh and skin, flexible long bone segments (representing femur and tibia), and the knee joint, and the assembled impactor shall have a total mass of 13.2 ± 0.4 kg.
quote: The assembled impactor shall have a total mass of 13.2 ± 0.4 kg.
test_case: Verify impactor build and weigh assembled impactor; pass if mass is 13.2 ± 0.4 kg.

text: The determination of all flexible lower legform impactor peak tibia bending moments and ligament elongations shall be limited to the assessment interval (AI) as defined in paragraph 3.24.
quote: The determination of all flexible lower legform impactor peak tibia bending moments and ligament elongations shall be limited to the assessment interval (AI)
test_case: Review bumper test data evaluation; pass if peak values are taken only within the assessment interval.

text: The flexible lower legform impactor used for the bumper test shall meet the performance requirements specified in paragraph 8.
quote: The flexible lower legform impactor shall meet the performance requirements specified in paragraph 8.
test_case: Check valid certification records of the impactor per paragraph 8 before testing.

text: When the upper legform to bumper test is applied, the total mass of the upper legform impactor including propulsion and guidance components effectively part of the impactor during the impact shall be 9.5 kg ± 0.1 kg.
quote: The total mass of the upper legform impactor including those propulsion and guidance components which are effectively part of the impactor during the impact shall be 9.5 kg ± 0.1 kg.
condition: Upper legform to bumper test applies (high lower bumper height).
test_case: Weigh upper legform impactor assembly; pass if 9.5 ± 0.1 kg.

text: The upper legform impactor for the bumper test shall be mounted to the propulsion system by a torque limiting joint and be insensitive to off-axis loading.
quote: The upper legform impactor for the bumper test shall be mounted to the propulsion system by a torque limiting joint and be insensitive to off-axis loading.
condition: Upper legform to bumper test applies (high lower bumper height).
test_case: Inspect test rig for torque limiting joint mounting of upper legform impactor.

text: For the flexible lower legform impactor to bumper test, each test shall be completed within two hours of when the impactor to be used is removed from the controlled storage area.
quote: Each test shall be completed within two hours of when the impactor to be used is removed from the controlled storage area.
test_case: Check the test log: the time between impactor removal from storage and test completion is at most 2 h.
merged: For the upper legform to bumper test, each test shall be completed within two hours of when the impactor to be used is removed from the controlled storage area.

text: For the flexible lower legform impactor to bumper test, the selected target points shall be in the bumper test area.
quote: The selected target points shall be in the bumper test area.
test_case: Mark the bumper test area on the vehicle and verify that all selected target points lie within it.

text: For the flexible lower legform impactor to bumper test, the direction of the impact velocity vector shall be in the horizontal plane and parallel to the longitudinal vertical plane of the vehicle.
quote: The direction of the impact velocity vector shall be in the horizontal plane and parallel to the longitudinal vertical plane of the vehicle.
test_case: Measure the impactor trajectory and verify that it is horizontal and parallel to the vehicle longitudinal plane.

text: For the flexible lower legform impactor to bumper test, the tolerance for the direction of the velocity vector in the horizontal plane and in the longitudinal plane shall be ± 2° at the time of first contact.
quote: The tolerance for the direction of the velocity vector in the horizontal plane and in the longitudinal plane shall be ± 2° at the time of first contact.
test_case: Measure the velocity vector angles at first contact and verify a deviation of no more than ± 2°.

text: For the flexible lower legform impactor to bumper test, the axis of the impactor shall be perpendicular to the horizontal plane, with a roll and pitch angle tolerance of ± 2° in the lateral and longitudinal plane.
quote: The axis of the impactor shall be perpendicular to the horizontal plane, with a roll and pitch angle tolerance of ± 2° in the lateral and longitudinal plane.
test_case: Measure the impactor roll and pitch angles at first contact and verify they are within ± 2° of vertical.

text: For the flexible lower legform impactor to bumper test, the bottom of the impactor (without parts needed for the purposes of launching and/or protection) shall be 75 mm above the ground reference plane at the time of the first contact with the bumper, with a tolerance of ± 10 mm.
quote: The bottom of the impactor (without parts needed for the purposes of launching and/or protection) shall be 75 mm above the ground reference plane
test_case: Measure the impactor bottom height at first contact with high-speed video and verify 75 ± 10 mm above the ground reference plane.

text: For the flexible lower legform impactor to bumper test, when setting the height of the propulsion system, an allowance shall be made for the influence of gravity during the period of free flight of the impactor.
quote: When setting the height of the propulsion system, an allowance shall be made for the influence of gravity during the period of free flight of the impactor.
test_case: Review the test set-up calculation and verify that a gravity drop allowance is applied to the launch height.

text: The lower legform impactor for the bumper tests shall be in 'free flight' at the moment of impact.
quote: The lower legform impactor for the bumper tests shall be in 'free flight' at the moment of impact.
test_case: Verify with high-speed video that the impactor is detached from the propulsion system at the moment of impact.

text: The lower legform impactor shall be released to free flight at such a distance from the vehicle that the test results are not influenced by contact of the impactor with the propulsion system during the rebound of the impactor.
quote: The impactor shall be released to free flight at such a distance from the vehicle that the test results are not influenced by contact
test_case: Check with high-speed video that the impactor does not contact the propulsion system during rebound within the evaluation period.

text: For the flexible lower legform impactor to bumper test, at the time of first contact the impactor shall have the intended orientation about its vertical axis, for the correct operation of its knee joint, with a yaw angle tolerance of ± 5°.
quote: At the time of first contact the impactor shall have the intended orientation about its vertical axis, for the correct operation of its knee joint
test_case: Measure the impactor yaw angle at first contact and verify it is within ± 5° of the intended orientation.

text: For the flexible lower legform impactor to bumper test, at the time of first contact the centre line of the impactor shall be within a ± 10 mm tolerance to the selected impact location.
quote: At the time of first contact the centre line of the impactor shall be within a ± 10 mm tolerance to the selected impact location.
test_case: Compare the first-contact location from video or marking with the target point and verify a deviation of no more than ± 10 mm.

text: During contact between the flexible lower legform impactor and the vehicle, the impactor shall not contact the ground or any object which is not part of the vehicle.
quote: During contact between the impactor and the vehicle, the impactor shall not contact the ground or any object which is not part of the vehicle.
test_case: Verify with high-speed video that there is no contact with the ground or any non-vehicle object during the impact.

text: The impact velocity of the flexible lower legform impactor when striking the bumper shall be 11.1 ± 0.2 m/s.
quote: The impact velocity of the impactor when striking the bumper shall be 11.1 ± 0.2 m/s.
test_case: Measure the impact velocity at first contact and verify it is 11.1 ± 0.2 m/s.
merged: The impact velocity of the upper legform impactor when striking the bumper shall be 11.1 ± 0.2 m/s.

text: For the flexible lower legform impactor to bumper test, the effect of gravity shall be taken into account when the impact velocity is obtained from measurements taken before the time of first contact.
quote: The effect of gravity shall be taken into account when the impact velocity is obtained from measurements taken before the time of first contact.
test_case: Review the velocity calculation and verify that a gravity correction is applied.

text: For the flexible lower legform impactor to bumper test, the tibia bending moments shall not exceed ± 15 Nm within an evaluation interval of 30 ms immediately prior to impact.
quote: The tibia bending moments shall not exceed ± 15 Nm within an evaluation interval of 30 ms immediately prior to impact.
test_case: Check the tibia moment channels over the 30 ms before impact and verify that |M| ≤ 15 Nm.

text: For the flexible lower legform impactor to bumper test, the offset compensation shall be done with the flexible lower legform impactor in resting position prior to the test / acceleration phase.
quote: The offset compensation shall be done with the flexible lower legform impactor in resting position prior to the test / acceleration phase.
test_case: Review the test log and verify that sensor offset zeroing was done with the impactor at rest before acceleration.

text: For the upper legform to bumper test, the selected target points shall be in the bumper test area as defined in paragraph 3.10.
